This file is a merged representation of the entire codebase, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

================
File: css/tokens.css
================
  1: /*
  2:   The Roast Room design tokens.
  3:   Every club colour is a CSS custom property on the document root, so a club
  4:   theme is swapped at runtime by writing to document.documentElement. The values
  5:   below are the Manchester United default.
  6: */
  7: 
  8: :root {
  9:   color-scheme: dark;
 10: 
 11:   /* Club theme tokens */
 12:   --colorPrimary: #DA291C;
 13:   --colorPrimaryContrast: #FFFFFF;
 14:   --colorAccent: #FBE122;
 15:   --colorBackground: #0A0A0A;
 16:   --colorSurface: #141414;
 17:   --colorSurfaceRaised: #1C1C1C;
 18:   --colorLine: #2A2A2A;
 19:   --colorText: #F5F5F5;
 20:   --colorTextMuted: #A0A0A0;
 21: 
 22:   /*
 23:     Contrast checks, measured against --colorBackground unless stated otherwise:
 24:     text on background 18.2 to 1
 25:     textMuted on background 7.6 to 1, so it clears WCAG AA for body copy
 26:     primary on background 4.1 to 1, used for large text, borders and fills only
 27:     primaryContrast on primary 4.9 to 1
 28:     accent on background 15.0 to 1
 29:   */
 30: 
 31:   /* Type families */
 32:   --fontDisplay: 'Anton', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif;
 33:   --fontBody: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif;
 34: 
 35:   /* Type scale, fluid between small phones and wide screens */
 36:   --textXs: clamp(0.75rem, 0.72rem + 0.12vw, 0.8125rem);
 37:   --textSm: clamp(0.875rem, 0.84rem + 0.16vw, 0.9375rem);
 38:   --textBase: clamp(1rem, 0.96rem + 0.2vw, 1.0625rem);
 39:   --textLg: clamp(1.125rem, 1.06rem + 0.32vw, 1.25rem);
 40:   --textXl: clamp(1.25rem, 1.14rem + 0.55vw, 1.5rem);
 41:   --text2xl: clamp(1.5rem, 1.32rem + 0.9vw, 1.875rem);
 42:   --text3xl: clamp(1.875rem, 1.6rem + 1.4vw, 2.5rem);
 43:   --textDisplaySm: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2.5vw, 3rem);
 44:   --textDisplayMd: clamp(2.5rem, 1.7rem + 4vw, 4.5rem);
 45:   --textDisplayLg: clamp(3rem, 1.8rem + 6vw, 7rem);
 46: 
 47:   --leadingTight: 0.95;
 48:   --leadingSnug: 1.15;
 49:   --leadingNormal: 1.55;
 50:   --leadingRelaxed: 1.7;
 51: 
 52:   --trackingTight: -0.02em;
 53:   --trackingNormal: 0em;
 54:   --trackingWide: 0.08em;
 55:   --trackingWider: 0.16em;
 56: 
 57:   /* Spacing scale, one unit is a quarter rem */
 58:   --space1: 0.25rem;
 59:   --space2: 0.5rem;
 60:   --space3: 0.75rem;
 61:   --space4: 1rem;
 62:   --space5: 1.25rem;
 63:   --space6: 1.5rem;
 64:   --space8: 2rem;
 65:   --space10: 2.5rem;
 66:   --space12: 3rem;
 67:   --space16: 4rem;
 68:   --space20: 5rem;
 69:   --space24: 6rem;
 70: 
 71:   /* Radii, kept small for a scoreboard feel */
 72:   --radiusSharp: 2px;
 73:   --radiusSoft: 6px;
 74:   --radiusPill: 999px;
 75: 
 76:   /* Border widths */
 77:   --borderWidth1: 1px;
 78:   --borderWidth2: 2px;
 79:   --borderWidth3: 3px;
 80: 
 81:   /* Shadows, deliberately minimal */
 82:   --shadowFlat: 0 1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6);
 83:   --shadowRaised: 0 12px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8);
 84: 
 85:   /* Z index */
 86:   --zBase: 0;
 87:   --zRaised: 10;
 88:   --zOverlay: 100;
 89:   --zToast: 1000;
 90: 
 91:   /* Motion */
 92:   --durationFast: 120ms;
 93:   --durationNormal: 200ms;
 94:   --durationSlow: 320ms;
 95:   --easeStandard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
 96:   --easeOut: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /*
100:   Anyone who asks for reduced motion gets near zero durations. Every animation
101:   and transition in the project reads these tokens.
102: */
103: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
104:   :root {
105:     --durationFast: 1ms;
106:     --durationNormal: 1ms;
107:     --durationSlow: 1ms;
108:   }
109: }

================
File: js/background/scrollBackground.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Fixed parallax background controller for The Roast Room.
 3:  * Builds the layer DOM from a layer list, throttles scroll updates through
 4:  * requestAnimationFrame, and does nothing when the user prefers reduced motion.
 5:  */
 6: 
 7: import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Mount a parallax background inside a container element.
11:  *
12:  * @param {HTMLElement | null} container
13:  * @param {import('./layers.js').BackgroundLayer[]} layers
14:  * @returns {() => void} Teardown function. Safe to call at any time.
15:  */
16: export function initScrollBackground(container, layers) {
17:   const noop = () => {};
18:   if (!container || typeof document === 'undefined') return noop;
19:   if (!Array.isArray(layers) || layers.length === 0) return noop;
20: 
21:   container.textContent = '';
22: 
23:   const scrim = document.createElement('div');
24:   scrim.className = 'clubBackground__scrim';
25:   container.append(scrim);
26: 
27:   /** @type {HTMLElement[]} */
28:   const layerEls = [];
29: 
30:   for (const layer of layers) {
31:     if (!layer || typeof layer.svg !== 'string') continue;
32:     const el = document.createElement('div');
33:     el.className =
34:       'clubBackground__layer' + (layer.fast ? ' clubBackground__layer--fast' : '');
35:     el.dataset.speed = String(layer.speed);
36:     el.innerHTML = layer.svg; // safe: authored by us, no user data
37:     container.append(el);
38:     layerEls.push(el);
39:   }
40: 
41:   const teardown = () => {
42:     container.textContent = '';
43:   };
44: 
45:   if (layerEls.length === 0) return teardown;
46:   if (prefersReducedMotion()) return teardown;
47: 
48:   let ticking = false;
49: 
50:   const update = () => {
51:     const y = window.scrollY || 0;
52:     for (const el of layerEls) {
53:       const speed = parseFloat(el.dataset.speed) || 0;
54:       el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${-y * speed}px, 0)`;
55:     }
56:     ticking = false;
57:   };
58: 
59:   const onScroll = () => {
60:     if (ticking) return;
61:     ticking = true;
62:     window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
63:   };
64: 
65:   window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
66:   update();
67: 
68:   return () => {
69:     window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
70:     teardown();
71:   };
72: }

================
File: js/brand/applyFrittLinks.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Applies Fritt contact and portfolio links to anchors that carry
 3:  * data-fritt-target and data-fritt-placement. Every anchor already has a
 4:  * working static href in the markup, so the page works without JavaScript;
 5:  * this module only adds the campaign parameters.
 6:  */
 7: 
 8: import { FRITT_URL, FRITT_CONTACT_URL } from './frittConfig.js';
 9: import { frittLink } from './frittLinks.js';
10: 
11: /**
12:  * Walk the document and rewrite the href of every Fritt link placeholder.
13:  * Never throws. Safe to call on any page, including pages without any
14:  * placeholders.
15:  *
16:  * @returns {void}
17:  */
18: export function applyFrittLinks() {
19:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
20: 
21:   const elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-fritt-target]');
22: 
23:   for (const element of elements) {
24:     if (!(element instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) continue;
25: 
26:     const target = element.getAttribute('data-fritt-target');
27:     const placement = element.getAttribute('data-fritt-placement') || 'site';
28: 
29:     let base = '';
30:     if (target === 'portfolio') base = FRITT_URL;
31:     else if (target === 'contact') base = FRITT_CONTACT_URL;
32:     else continue;
33: 
34:     const href = frittLink(base, placement);
35:     if (href) element.setAttribute('href', href);
36:   }
37: }

================
File: js/brand/frittConfig.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Fritt branding constants. Change the two URLs here and every page that
 3:  * carries a data-fritt-target anchor picks them up.
 4:  *
 5:  * @type {string}
 6:  */
 7: export const FRITT_URL = 'https://fritt.org';
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Where the "Talk to Fritt" button points.
11:  *
12:  * Replace with a WhatsApp link (https://wa.me/<number>) or a mailto link
13:  * (mailto:hello@fritt.org) once you have a preferred contact channel.
14:  * frittLink leaves non http links untouched, so a mailto contact URL will not
15:  * gain campaign parameters.
16:  *
17:  * @type {string}
18:  */
19: export const FRITT_CONTACT_URL = 'https://wa.me/2349169472000';
20: 
21: /**
22:  * Agency name.
23:  * @type {string}
24:  */
25: export const FRITT_NAME = 'Fritt';

================
File: js/brand/frittLinks.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Pure URL helper for Fritt campaign links. No DOM, no side effects.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * Add the Fritt campaign parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign)
 7:  * to a URL. Existing query parameters and the hash are preserved. Non http
 8:  * links (mailto, tel, javascript, data) and anything that cannot be parsed
 9:  * are returned unchanged.
10:  *
11:  * @param {string} baseUrl Base URL from frittConfig.
12:  * @param {string} placement Short placement label such as landingCta.
13:  * @returns {string}
14:  */
15: export function frittLink(baseUrl, placement) {
16:   if (typeof baseUrl !== 'string' || baseUrl.length === 0) return baseUrl;
17:   if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(baseUrl)) return baseUrl;
18: 
19:   try {
20:     const url = new URL(baseUrl);
21:     url.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'roastroom');
22:     url.searchParams.set('utm_medium', 'site');
23:     url.searchParams.set(
24:       'utm_campaign',
25:       typeof placement === 'string' && placement.length > 0 ? placement : 'site'
26:     );
27:     return url.toString();
28:   } catch {
29:     return baseUrl;
30:   }
31: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Logic for the developer only card lab page.
  3:  * Renders every roast of every live club in both formats.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import { CARD_FORMATS } from '../share/cardFormats.js';
  7: import { SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE } from '../share/shareConfig.js';
  8: import { renderRoastCard } from '../share/renderCard.js';
  9: import { hostLabel } from '../share/shareText.js';
 10: import { getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from '../registry.js';
 11: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 12: 
 13: const summaryEl = document.getElementById('cardLabSummary');
 14: const warningEl = document.getElementById('cardLabWarning');
 15: const gridEl = document.getElementById('cardLabGrid');
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Set the summary line.
 19:  * @param {string} text Summary text.
 20:  * @returns {void}
 21:  */
 22: function setSummary(text) {
 23:   if (summaryEl) summaryEl.textContent = text;
 24: }
 25: 
 26: /**
 27:  * Show the warning badge area.
 28:  * @param {string} text Warning text.
 29:  * @returns {void}
 30:  */
 31: function showWarning(text) {
 32:   if (!warningEl) return;
 33:   warningEl.textContent = text;
 34:   warningEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 35: }
 36: 
 37: /**
 38:  * Hide the warning badge area.
 39:  * @returns {void}
 40:  */
 41: function hideWarning() {
 42:   if (!warningEl) return;
 43:   warningEl.classList.add('hidden');
 44: }
 45: 
 46: /**
 47:  * Build one card holder in the grid.
 48:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club Club data.
 49:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast Roast data.
 50:  * @param {{ id: string, label: string, width: number, height: number }} format Card format.
 51:  * @returns {{ card: HTMLElement, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, meta: HTMLElement }} Holder.
 52:  */
 53: function buildHolder(club, roast, format) {
 54:   const card = createElement('article', {
 55:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4',
 56:   });
 57: 
 58:   const title = createElement('h2', {
 59:     className: 'font-display text-lg uppercase text-text',
 60:     text: `${String(club.shortName || club.name || '')} ${format.label}`,
 61:   });
 62: 
 63:   const canvas = createElement('canvas', {
 64:     className: 'mt-3 block w-full',
 65:     attrs: {
 66:       role: 'img',
 67:       'aria-label': `Roast card ${format.label} for ${String(roast.headline || '')}`,
 68:     },
 69:   });
 70: 
 71:   canvas.style.width = '100%';
 72:   canvas.style.height = 'auto';
 73:   canvas.style.maxHeight = '320px';
 74:   canvas.style.objectFit = 'contain';
 75:   canvas.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--colorBackground)';
 76: 
 77:   const meta = createElement('p', {
 78:     className: 'mt-2 text-xs text-textMuted',
 79:     text: 'Rendering',
 80:   });
 81: 
 82:   card.append(title, canvas, meta);
 83:   gridEl.append(card);
 84: 
 85:   return { card, canvas, meta };
 86: }
 87: 
 88: /**
 89:  * Start the card lab.
 90:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 91:  */
 92: async function init() {
 93:   if (!gridEl) return;
 94: 
 95:   clear(gridEl);
 96:   hideWarning();
 97: 
 98:   let rendered = 0;
 99:   let truncatedCount = 0;
100:   let failed = 0;
101: 
102:   try {
103:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
104:     const live = getLiveClubs(registry);
105:     const host = hostLabel(window.location.host, SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE);
106: 
107:     for (const entry of live) {
108:       let club;
109: 
110:       try {
111:         club = await loadClub(entry.id);
112:       } catch {
113:         failed += 1;
114:         continue;
115:       }
116: 
117:       const roasts = Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [];
118:       const categories = Array.isArray(club.categories) ? club.categories : [];
119: 
120:       for (const roast of roasts) {
121:         const category =
122:           categories.find((item) => item && item.id === roast.category) || null;
123: 
124:         for (const format of Object.values(CARD_FORMATS)) {
125:           const holder = buildHolder(club, roast, format);
126: 
127:           try {
128:             const result = await renderRoastCard({
129:               canvas: holder.canvas,
130:               roast,
131:               category,
132:               club,
133:               format,
134:               host,
135:             });
136: 
137:             rendered += 1;
138: 
139:             if (result.truncated) {
140:               truncatedCount += 1;
141:               holder.meta.textContent = `Headline ${result.headlineFontSize} / Explanation ${result.explanationFontSize} / TRUNCATED`;
142:               const badge = createElement('span', {
143:                 className:
144:                   'ml-2 inline-block rounded-sharp bg-primary px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-primaryContrast',
145:                 text: 'TRUNCATED',
146:               });
147:               holder.meta.append(badge);
148:               holder.card.classList.add('border-primary');
149:             } else {
150:               holder.meta.textContent = `Headline ${result.headlineFontSize} / Explanation ${result.explanationFontSize}`;
151:             }
152:           } catch {
153:             failed += 1;
154:             holder.meta.textContent = 'Render failed';
155:           }
156:         }
157:       }
158:     }
159:   } catch {
160:     setSummary('Could not load the card lab data. Serve the site over http and reload.');
161:     showWarning('Card lab could not start.');
162:     return;
163:   }
164: 
165:   const failedText = failed > 0 ? `, ${failed} failed` : '';
166:   setSummary(`${rendered} cards rendered, ${truncatedCount} truncated${failedText}`);
167: 
168:   if (truncatedCount > 0) {
169:     showWarning(`${truncatedCount} card(s) are truncated. Check the font sizes and content.`);
170:   } else {
171:     hideWarning();
172:   }
173: }
174: 
175: init();

  1: /**
  2:  * Developer page that renders og.png and apple_touch_icon.png on canvases and
  3:  * wires up the Download buttons. Uses the Man United theme from
  4:  * data/clubs/manutd.json. Never throws.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { canvasToBlob, downloadBlob } from '../share/actions.js';
  8: 
  9: const OG_WIDTH = 1200;
 10: const OG_HEIGHT = 630;
 11: const ICON_SIZE = 180;
 12: const FONT_DISPLAY = "Anton, 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif";
 13: const FONT_BODY = "Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif";
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * Wait for Anton and Inter with a short timeout, mirroring the share card
 17:  * renderer.
 18:  * @param {number} timeoutMs
 19:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 20:  */
 21: async function waitForFonts(timeoutMs) {
 22:   if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.fonts || typeof document.fonts.load !== 'function') {
 23:     return;
 24:   }
 25:   try {
 26:     await Promise.race([
 27:       Promise.all([
 28:         document.fonts.load('400 96px Anton'),
 29:         document.fonts.load('400 72px Anton'),
 30:         document.fonts.load('400 32px Inter'),
 31:       ]),
 32:       new Promise((resolve) => {
 33:         setTimeout(resolve, timeoutMs || 900);
 34:       }),
 35:     ]);
 36:   } catch {
 37:     // System fonts are used if the font set cannot load.
 38:   }
 39: }
 40: 
 41: /**
 42:  * Fetch the Man United theme from the club data, with a safe fallback.
 43:  * @returns {Promise<Record<string, string>>}
 44:  */
 45: async function loadTheme() {
 46:   try {
 47:     const response = await fetch('./data/clubs/manutd.json', {
 48:       headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
 49:     });
 50:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error('bad response');
 51:     const data = await response.json();
 52:     if (data && typeof data === 'object' && data.theme && typeof data.theme === 'object') {
 53:       return data.theme;
 54:     }
 55:   } catch {
 56:     // Fall through to the defaults below.
 57:   }
 58:   return {
 59:     primary: '#DA291C',
 60:     primaryContrast: '#FFFFFF',
 61:     accent: '#FBE122',
 62:     background: '#0A0A0A',
 63:     surface: '#141414',
 64:     surfaceRaised: '#1C1C1C',
 65:     line: '#2A2A2A',
 66:     text: '#F5F5F5',
 67:     textMuted: '#A0A0A0',
 68:   };
 69: }
 70: 
 71: /**
 72:  * Draw the low opacity pitch line motif.
 73:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx
 74:  * @param {number} width
 75:  * @param {number} height
 76:  * @param {string} color
 77:  * @returns {void}
 78:  */
 79: function drawPitchMotif(ctx, width, height, color) {
 80:   if (!color) return;
 81:   ctx.save();
 82:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
 83:   ctx.strokeStyle = color;
 84:   ctx.lineWidth = 2;
 85:   ctx.strokeRect(24, 24, width - 48, height - 48);
 86:   ctx.beginPath();
 87:   ctx.moveTo(width / 2, 24);
 88:   ctx.lineTo(width / 2, height - 24);
 89:   ctx.stroke();
 90:   ctx.beginPath();
 91:   ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, Math.min(width, height) * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 92:   ctx.stroke();
 93:   ctx.restore();
 94: }
 95: 
 96: /**
 97:  * Draw the 1200 by 630 social preview.
 98:  * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
 99:  * @param {Record<string, string>} theme
100:  * @returns {void}
101:  */
102: function drawOg(canvas, theme) {
103:   canvas.width = OG_WIDTH;
104:   canvas.height = OG_HEIGHT;
105:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
106:   if (!ctx) return;
107: 
108:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.background || '#0A0A0A';
109:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, OG_WIDTH, OG_HEIGHT);
110: 
111:   drawPitchMotif(ctx, OG_WIDTH, OG_HEIGHT, theme.text || '#F5F5F5');
112: 
113:   // Club colour band along the top edge.
114:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.primary || '#DA291C';
115:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, OG_WIDTH, 12);
116: 
117:   // Wordmark.
118:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.text || '#F5F5F5';
119:   ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
120:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
121:   ctx.font = `400 96px ${FONT_DISPLAY}`;
122:   ctx.fillText('THE ROAST ROOM', 80, 190);
123: 
124:   // Main tagline.
125:   ctx.font = `400 72px ${FONT_DISPLAY}`;
126:   ctx.fillText('Every rivalry needs receipts.', 80, 300);
127: 
128:   // Sub line in the accent colour.
129:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.accent || '#FBE122';
130:   ctx.font = `400 32px ${FONT_BODY}`;
131:   ctx.fillText('Sourced, dated football banter', 80, 390);
132: 
133:   // Muted host label in the corner.
134:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.textMuted || '#A0A0A0';
135:   ctx.font = `400 26px ${FONT_BODY}`;
136:   ctx.fillText('roastroom.fritt.org', 80, OG_HEIGHT - 60);
137: }
138: 
139: /**
140:  * Draw the 180 by 180 app icon from the same flame geometry as favicon.svg.
141:  * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
142:  * @param {Record<string, string>} theme
143:  * @returns {void}
144:  */
145: function drawIcon(canvas, theme) {
146:   canvas.width = ICON_SIZE;
147:   canvas.height = ICON_SIZE;
148:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
149:   if (!ctx) return;
150: 
151:   const scale = ICON_SIZE / 64;
152:   const radius = 14 * scale;
153: 
154:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.primary || '#DA291C';
155:   ctx.beginPath();
156:   ctx.moveTo(radius, 0);
157:   ctx.lineTo(ICON_SIZE - radius, 0);
158:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ICON_SIZE, 0, ICON_SIZE, radius);
159:   ctx.lineTo(ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE - radius);
160:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE, ICON_SIZE - radius, ICON_SIZE);
161:   ctx.lineTo(radius, ICON_SIZE);
162:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, ICON_SIZE, 0, ICON_SIZE - radius);
163:   ctx.lineTo(0, radius);
164:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 0, radius, 0);
165:   ctx.closePath();
166:   ctx.fill();
167: 
168:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.accent || '#FBE122';
169:   ctx.beginPath();
170:   ctx.moveTo(32 * scale, 10 * scale);
171:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(30 * scale, 18 * scale, 20 * scale, 22 * scale, 20 * scale, 34 * scale);
172:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(20 * scale, 44 * scale, 26 * scale, 52 * scale, 32 * scale, 54 * scale);
173:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(38 * scale, 52 * scale, 44 * scale, 44 * scale, 44 * scale, 34 * scale);
174:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(44 * scale, 22 * scale, 34 * scale, 18 * scale, 32 * scale, 10 * scale);
175:   ctx.closePath();
176:   ctx.fill();
177: 
178:   ctx.fillStyle = theme.primary || '#DA291C';
179:   ctx.beginPath();
180:   ctx.moveTo(32 * scale, 30 * scale);
181:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(30 * scale, 36 * scale, 26 * scale, 38 * scale, 26 * scale, 44 * scale);
182:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(26 * scale, 48 * scale, 28 * scale, 50 * scale, 32 * scale, 52 * scale);
183:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(36 * scale, 50 * scale, 38 * scale, 48 * scale, 38 * scale, 44 * scale);
184:   ctx.bezierCurveTo(38 * scale, 38 * scale, 34 * scale, 36 * scale, 32 * scale, 30 * scale);
185:   ctx.closePath();
186:   ctx.fill();
187: }
188: 
189: /**
190:  * Wire a download button to a canvas. Never throws.
191:  * @param {HTMLButtonElement | null} button
192:  * @param {HTMLCanvasElement | null} canvas
193:  * @param {string} fileName
194:  * @param {HTMLElement | null} status
195:  * @returns {void}
196:  */
197: function wireDownload(button, canvas, fileName, status) {
198:   if (!button || !canvas) return;
199:   button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
200:     if (status) status.textContent = 'Preparing image';
201:     try {
202:       const result = await canvasToBlob(canvas);
203:       if (!result.ok || !result.blob) {
204:         if (status) status.textContent = 'Could not prepare the image.';
205:         return;
206:       }
207:       const download = downloadBlob(result.blob, fileName);
208:       if (status) {
209:         status.textContent = download.ok ? `Saved ${fileName}` : 'Could not save the image.';
210:       }
211:     } catch {
212:       if (status) status.textContent = 'Could not save the image.';
213:     }
214:   });
215: }
216: 
217: /**
218:  * Start the page.
219:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
220:  */
221: async function init() {
222:   const ogCanvas = document.getElementById('ogCanvas');
223:   const iconCanvas = document.getElementById('iconCanvas');
224:   if (!(ogCanvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement) || !(iconCanvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)) {
225:     return;
226:   }
227: 
228:   await waitForFonts(900);
229:   const theme = await loadTheme();
230: 
231:   drawOg(ogCanvas, theme);
232:   drawIcon(iconCanvas, theme);
233: 
234:   wireDownload(
235:     document.getElementById('downloadOg'),
236:     ogCanvas,
237:     'og.png',
238:     document.getElementById('ogStatus')
239:   );
240:   wireDownload(
241:     document.getElementById('downloadIcon'),
242:     iconCanvas,
243:     'apple_touch_icon.png',
244:     document.getElementById('iconStatus')
245:   );
246: }
247: 
248: init();

================
File: js/roasts/fanRoasts.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Loads approved fan roasts and filters them through validateRoast before they
 3:  * are merged into the club's roast list. Silent on failure.
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: import { validateRoast } from '../schema.js';
 7: import { fetchApprovedRoasts } from './roastClient.js';
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Fetch approved fan roasts for one club, validate each with validateRoast
11:  * using the club category ids, and drop invalid or duplicate ids. Returns an
12:  * empty array on any failure so the room works exactly as today.
13:  * @param {string} clubId
14:  * @param {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} categories
15:  * @param {string[]} [existingIds] Ids already present in the club data file.
16:  * @returns {Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>>}
17:  */
18: export async function loadFanRoasts(clubId, categories, existingIds) {
19:   if (typeof clubId !== 'string' || clubId.length === 0) return [];
20:   if (!Array.isArray(categories)) return [];
21: 
22:   const categoryIds = categories
23:     .map((category) => (category && typeof category.id === 'string' ? category.id : ''))
24:     .filter((id) => id.length > 0);
25:   if (categoryIds.length === 0) return [];
26: 
27:   const result = await fetchApprovedRoasts(clubId);
28:   if (!result.ok) return [];
29: 
30:   const seenIds = Array.isArray(existingIds) ? existingIds.slice() : [];
31:   const valid = [];
32: 
33:   for (const roast of result.roasts) {
34:     if (!roast || typeof roast !== 'object') continue;
35:     if (typeof roast.id !== 'string' || roast.id.length === 0) continue;
36:     if (seenIds.includes(roast.id)) continue;
37:     const check = validateRoast(roast, {
38:       path: `fanRoasts[${valid.length}]`,
39:       clubId,
40:       categoryIds,
41:       seenIds: [],
42:     });
43:     if (!check.valid) continue;
44:     valid.push(roast);
45:     seenIds.push(roast.id);
46:   }
47: 
48:   return valid;
49: }

================
File: js/roasts/roastClient.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Network client for roast submissions. Every call has an 8 second timeout and
  3:  * returns a friendly result. Never throws. Never logs tokens, salts or
  4:  * submitted text.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { SUGGEST_API_BASE } from '../suggest/suggestConfig.js';
  8: 
  9: const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
 10: 
 11: /**
 12:  * Read a response body as JSON without throwing.
 13:  * @param {Response} response
 14:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 15:  */
 16: async function readJson(response) {
 17:   try {
 18:     return await response.json();
 19:   } catch {
 20:     return null;
 21:   }
 22: }
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * Fetch with an 8 second timeout. Returns a friendly result on any failure.
 26:  * @param {string} path
 27:  * @param {RequestInit} options
 28:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, response: Response | null }>}
 29:  */
 30: async function fetchWithTimeout(path, options) {
 31:   const controller = new AbortController();
 32:   const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
 33:   try {
 34:     const response = await fetch(`${SUGGEST_API_BASE}${path}`, {
 35:       ...options,
 36:       signal: controller.signal,
 37:     });
 38:     return { ok: true, response };
 39:   } catch {
 40:     return { ok: false, response: null };
 41:   } finally {
 42:     clearTimeout(timer);
 43:   }
 44: }
 45: 
 46: /**
 47:  * Submit a fan roast to the Worker.
 48:  * @param {{
 49:  *   clubId: string,
 50:  *   category: string,
 51:  *   headline: string,
 52:  *   explanation: string,
 53:  *   claim: string,
 54:  *   period: string,
 55:  *   sourceName: string,
 56:  *   sourceUrl: string,
 57:  *   website?: string
 58:  * }} fields
 59:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, status: string, message: string }>}
 60:  */
 61: export async function submitRoast(fields) {
 62:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return { ok: false, status: '', message: '' };
 63:   const result = await fetchWithTimeout('/api/roast_submissions', {
 64:     method: 'POST',
 65:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 66:     body: JSON.stringify(fields || {}),
 67:   });
 68:   if (!result.ok || !result.response) {
 69:     return {
 70:       ok: false,
 71:       status: '',
 72:       message: 'We could not send that. Try again in a moment.',
 73:     };
 74:   }
 75:   const data = await readJson(result.response);
 76:   if (!result.response.ok || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
 77:     const message =
 78:       data && typeof data.message === 'string'
 79:         ? data.message
 80:         : 'We could not send that. Try again in a moment.';
 81:     return { ok: false, status: '', message };
 82:   }
 83:   return {
 84:     ok: true,
 85:     status: typeof data.status === 'string' ? data.status : 'pending',
 86:     message:
 87:       typeof data.message === 'string'
 88:         ? data.message
 89:         : 'Thanks, your roast will appear after review.',
 90:   };
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /**
 94:  * Load approved fan roasts for one club.
 95:  * @param {string} clubId
 96:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, roasts: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }>}
 97:  */
 98: export async function fetchApprovedRoasts(clubId) {
 99:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return { ok: false, roasts: [] };
100:   const path = `/api/roasts?club=${encodeURIComponent(String(clubId || ''))}`;
101:   const result = await fetchWithTimeout(path, { method: 'GET', cache: 'reload' });
102:   if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
103:     return { ok: false, roasts: [] };
104:   }
105:   const data = await readJson(result.response);
106:   if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.roasts)) {
107:     return { ok: false, roasts: [] };
108:   }
109:   return { ok: true, roasts: data.roasts };
110: }

================
File: js/roasts/roastForm.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the fan roast submission form on the room page.
  3:  * The form stays hidden and makes no network calls when SUGGEST_API_BASE is
  4:  * empty. All submitted text is rendered with textContent or safe DOM APIs.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { submitRoast } from './roastClient.js';
  8: import { SUGGEST_API_BASE } from '../suggest/suggestConfig.js';
  9: import { validateEvidence } from '../schema.js';
 10: import { LIMITS } from '../config.js';
 11: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 12: 
 13: const CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH = 300;
 14: const SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH = 2;
 15: const SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 80;
 16: const SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH = 300;
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Return the current UTC date as YYYY/MM/DD. Used only to build a temp
 20:  * evidence item for validateEvidence.
 21:  * @returns {string}
 22:  */
 23: function todayDateString() {
 24:   const now = new Date();
 25:   const year = now.getUTCFullYear();
 26:   const month = String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 27:   const day = String(now.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 28:   return `${year}/${month}/${day}`;
 29: }
 30: 
 31: /**
 32:  * True for a season such as 2013/14 or a real calendar date.
 33:  * @param {string} value
 34:  * @returns {boolean}
 35:  */
 36: function isValidPeriod(value) {
 37:   if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) return false;
 38:   if (/^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/.test(value)) return true;
 39:   const match = /^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
 40:   if (!match) return false;
 41:   const year = Number(match[1]);
 42:   const month = Number(match[2]);
 43:   const day = Number(match[3]);
 44:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
 45:   return (
 46:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
 47:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
 48:     date.getUTCDate() === day
 49:   );
 50: }
 51: 
 52: /**
 53:  * True for a public https URL with a dotted hostname, no credentials and no IP.
 54:  * @param {string} value
 55:  * @returns {boolean}
 56:  */
 57: function isPublicHttpsUrl(value) {
 58:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
 59:   if (value.length === 0 || value.length > SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH) return false;
 60:   if (!value.startsWith('https://')) return false;
 61:   let url;
 62:   try {
 63:     url = new URL(value);
 64:   } catch {
 65:     return false;
 66:   }
 67:   if (url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
 68:   if (url.username.length > 0 || url.password.length > 0) return false;
 69:   const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
 70:   if (host === 'localhost') return false;
 71:   if (host.startsWith('[') && host.endsWith(']')) return false;
 72:   if (/^\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(host)) return false;
 73:   if (!host.includes('.')) return false;
 74:   return true;
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * Build one text field with an optional character counter and an inline error
 79:  * message.
 80:  * @param {{
 81:  *   id: string,
 82:  *   name: string,
 83:  *   label: string,
 84:  *   helpText?: string,
 85:  *   maxLength?: number,
 86:  *   minLength?: number,
 87:  *   multiline?: boolean,
 88:  *   type?: string
 89:  * }} options
 90:  * @returns {{
 91:  *   group: HTMLElement,
 92:  *   input: HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement,
 93:  *   countSpan: HTMLElement | null,
 94:  *   errorEl: HTMLElement
 95:  * }}
 96:  */
 97: function buildTextField(options) {
 98:   const { id, name, label, helpText, maxLength, minLength, multiline, type } = options;
 99: 
100:   const group = createElement('div');
101:   group.append(
102:     createElement('label', { className: 'tokenLabel block', text: label, attrs: { for: id } })
103:   );
104:   if (helpText) {
105:     group.append(createElement('p', { className: 'mt-1 text-xs text-textMuted', text: helpText }));
106:   }
107: 
108:   const inputAttrs = { id, name };
109:   if (multiline) {
110:     inputAttrs.rows = '3';
111:   } else {
112:     inputAttrs.type = type || 'text';
113:   }
114:   if (Number.isFinite(maxLength) && maxLength > 0) {
115:     inputAttrs.maxlength = String(maxLength);
116:   }
117:   if (Number.isFinite(minLength) && minLength > 0) {
118:     inputAttrs.minlength = String(minLength);
119:   }
120: 
121:   const input = createElement(multiline ? 'textarea' : 'input', {
122:     className:
123:       'mt-1 w-full rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-text focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent',
124:     attrs: inputAttrs,
125:   });
126:   group.append(input);
127: 
128:   let countSpan = null;
129:   if (Number.isFinite(maxLength) && maxLength > 0) {
130:     const counter = createElement('p', {
131:       className: 'mt-1 text-xs text-textMuted',
132:       attrs: { 'aria-live': 'polite' },
133:     });
134:     countSpan = createElement('span', { text: '0' });
135:     counter.append(countSpan, ` / ${maxLength}`);
136:     group.append(counter);
137:   }
138: 
139:   const errorEl = createElement('p', {
140:     className: 'mt-1 text-sm text-accent hidden',
141:     attrs: { 'data-error-for': id, role: 'alert' },
142:   });
143:   group.append(errorEl);
144: 
145:   return { group, input, countSpan, errorEl };
146: }
147: 
148: /**
149:  * Wire an input's value length to a character counter.
150:  * @param {HTMLElement} input
151:  * @param {HTMLElement | null} countSpan
152:  * @returns {void}
153:  */
154: function wireCounter(input, countSpan) {
155:   if (!input || !countSpan) return;
156:   const update = () => {
157:     const value = input instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || input instanceof HTMLInputElement
158:       ? input.value
159:       : '';
160:     countSpan.textContent = String(value.length);
161:   };
162:   input.addEventListener('input', update);
163:   update();
164: }
165: 
166: /**
167:  * Validate the submission fields locally before sending. Returns field specific
168:  * messages so the form can highlight individual inputs.
169:  * @param {{
170:  *   category: string,
171:  *   headline: string,
172:  *   explanation: string,
173:  *   claim: string,
174:  *   period: string,
175:  *   sourceName: string,
176:  *   sourceUrl: string
177:  * }} fields
178:  * @param {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} categories
179:  * @returns {Array<{ field: string, message: string }>}
180:  */
181: function validateLocal(fields, categories) {
182:   const errors = [];
183: 
184:   const categoryIds = categories
185:     .map((category) => (category && typeof category.id === 'string' ? category.id : ''))
186:     .filter((id) => id.length > 0);
187:   if (!fields.category || !categoryIds.includes(fields.category)) {
188:     errors.push({ field: 'roastCategory', message: 'Pick a category.' });
189:   }
190: 
191:   const headline = fields.headline.trim();
192:   if (headline.length === 0) {
193:     errors.push({ field: 'roastHeadline', message: 'Add the joke.' });
194:   } else if (headline.length > LIMITS.headlineMaxLength) {
195:     errors.push({
196:       field: 'roastHeadline',
197:       message: `The joke must be ${LIMITS.headlineMaxLength} characters or fewer.`,
198:     });
199:   }
200: 
201:   const explanation = fields.explanation.trim();
202:   if (explanation.length === 0) {
203:     errors.push({ field: 'roastExplanation', message: 'Add the facts.' });
204:   } else if (explanation.length > LIMITS.explanationMaxLength) {
205:     errors.push({
206:       field: 'roastExplanation',
207:       message: `The facts must be ${LIMITS.explanationMaxLength} characters or fewer.`,
208:     });
209:   }
210: 
211:   const claim = fields.claim.trim();
212:   if (claim.length === 0) {
213:     errors.push({ field: 'roastClaim', message: 'Add the claim.' });
214:   } else if (claim.length > CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH) {
215:     errors.push({
216:       field: 'roastClaim',
217:       message: `The claim must be ${CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer.`,
218:     });
219:   }
220: 
221:   if (!isValidPeriod(fields.period.trim())) {
222:     errors.push({
223:       field: 'roastPeriod',
224:       message: 'Use a season like 2013/14 or a real date like 2021/09/11.',
225:     });
226:   }
227: 
228:   const sourceName = fields.sourceName.trim();
229:   if (sourceName.length < SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH) {
230:     errors.push({
231:       field: 'roastSourceName',
232:       message: `The source name must be at least ${SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH} characters.`,
233:     });
234:   } else if (sourceName.length > SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
235:     errors.push({
236:       field: 'roastSourceName',
237:       message: `The source name must be ${SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer.`,
238:     });
239:   }
240: 
241:   if (!isPublicHttpsUrl(fields.sourceUrl.trim())) {
242:     errors.push({
243:       field: 'roastSourceUrl',
244:       message: 'Use a public https link to the source.',
245:     });
246:   }
247: 
248:   if (errors.length > 0) return errors;
249: 
250:   // Last line of defence: reuse the site's evidence validator.
251:   const evidenceCheck = validateEvidence([
252:     {
253:       claim: fields.claim.trim(),
254:       period: fields.period.trim(),
255:       sourceName: fields.sourceName.trim(),
256:       sourceUrl: fields.sourceUrl.trim(),
257:       accessedOn: todayDateString(),
258:     },
259:   ]);
260:   if (!evidenceCheck.valid) {
261:     errors.push({
262:       field: 'roastClaim',
263:       message: 'The claim, period or source could not be validated.',
264:     });
265:   }
266: 
267:   return errors;
268: }
269: 
270: /**
271:  * Create the fan roast submission form. Does nothing when SUGGEST_API_BASE is
272:  * empty. Safe to call on any page and never throws.
273:  * @param {{
274:  *   section: HTMLElement,
275:  *   container: HTMLElement,
276:  *   clubId: string,
277:  *   categories: Array<Record<string, unknown>>
278:  * }} options
279:  * @returns {void}
280:  */
281: export function createRoastForm(options) {
282:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return;
283:   const section = options && options.section;
284:   const container = options && options.container;
285:   const clubId = options && typeof options.clubId === 'string' ? options.clubId : '';
286:   const categories =
287:     options && Array.isArray(options.categories) ? options.categories : [];
288:   if (!section || !container || clubId.length === 0 || categories.length === 0) return;
289: 
290:   section.classList.remove('hidden');
291:   clear(container);
292: 
293:   const form = createElement('form', {
294:     className: 'space-y-4',
295:     attrs: { novalidate: 'novalidate' },
296:   });
297: 
298:   // Category
299:   const categoryId = 'roastCategory';
300:   const categoryGroup = createElement('div');
301:   categoryGroup.append(
302:     createElement('label', {
303:       className: 'tokenLabel block',
304:       text: 'Category',
305:       attrs: { for: categoryId },
306:     })
307:   );
308:   const categorySelect = createElement('select', {
309:     className:
310:       'mt-1 w-full rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-text focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent',
311:     attrs: { id: categoryId, name: 'category', required: 'required' },
312:   });
313:   for (const category of categories) {
314:     if (!category || typeof category.id !== 'string') continue;
315:     categorySelect.append(
316:       createElement('option', {
317:         text: category.displayLabel || category.id,
318:         attrs: { value: category.id },
319:       })
320:     );
321:   }
322:   categoryGroup.append(categorySelect);
323: 
324:   const headline = buildTextField({
325:     id: 'roastHeadline',
326:     name: 'headline',
327:     label: 'The joke',
328:     helpText: 'The one liner. Keep it about the club and its results.',
329:     maxLength: LIMITS.headlineMaxLength,
330:   });
331: 
332:   const explanation = buildTextField({
333:     id: 'roastExplanation',
334:     name: 'explanation',
335:     label: 'The facts',
336:     helpText: 'A short, factual context that explains the joke.',
337:     maxLength: LIMITS.explanationMaxLength,
338:     multiline: true,
339:   });
340: 
341:   const claim = buildTextField({
342:     id: 'roastClaim',
343:     name: 'claim',
344:     label: 'The claim',
345:     helpText: 'One precise statement your source actually supports.',
346:     maxLength: CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH,
347:     multiline: true,
348:   });
349: 
350:   const period = buildTextField({
351:     id: 'roastPeriod',
352:     name: 'period',
353:     label: 'Period',
354:     helpText: 'A season like 2013/14 or a real date like 2021/09/11.',
355:   });
356: 
357:   const sourceName = buildTextField({
358:     id: 'roastSourceName',
359:     name: 'sourceName',
360:     label: 'Source name',
361:     helpText: 'For example BBC Sport.',
362:     maxLength: SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH,
363:     minLength: SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH,
364:   });
365: 
366:   const sourceUrl = buildTextField({
367:     id: 'roastSourceUrl',
368:     name: 'sourceUrl',
369:     label: 'Source link',
370:     helpText: 'A public https link to the page that proves the claim.',
371:     maxLength: SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH,
372:     type: 'url',
373:   });
374: 
375:   // Honeypot
376:   const honeypot = createElement('div', {
377:     attrs: {
378:       'aria-hidden': 'true',
379:       style: 'position:absolute;left:-9999px;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden',
380:     },
381:   });
382:   honeypot.append(
383:     createElement('label', { text: 'Website', attrs: { for: 'roastWebsite' } }),
384:     createElement('input', {
385:       attrs: {
386:         id: 'roastWebsite',
387:         name: 'website',
388:         type: 'text',
389:         tabindex: '-1',
390:         autocomplete: 'off',
391:       },
392:     })
393:   );
394: 
395:   const submitButton = createElement('button', {
396:     className:
397:       'rounded-sharp bg-primary px-6 py-3 font-display text-lg uppercase tracking-wide text-primaryContrast transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:bg-accent hover:text-background disabled:opacity-60',
398:     text: 'Submit roast',
399:     attrs: { type: 'submit' },
400:   });
401: 
402:   const status = createElement('p', {
403:     className: 'mt-3 text-sm text-accent',
404:     attrs: { role: 'status', 'aria-live': 'polite' },
405:   });
406: 
407:   form.append(
408:     categoryGroup,
409:     headline.group,
410:     explanation.group,
411:     claim.group,
412:     period.group,
413:     sourceName.group,
414:     sourceUrl.group,
415:     honeypot,
416:     submitButton,
417:     status
418:   );
419: 
420:   container.append(form);
421: 
422:   wireCounter(headline.input, headline.countSpan);
423:   wireCounter(explanation.input, explanation.countSpan);
424:   wireCounter(claim.input, claim.countSpan);
425:   wireCounter(sourceName.input, sourceName.countSpan);
426: 
427:   /**
428:    * Remove every field error.
429:    * @returns {void}
430:    */
431:   function clearErrors() {
432:     for (const node of form.querySelectorAll('[data-error-for]')) {
433:       node.textContent = '';
434:       node.classList.add('hidden');
435:     }
436:   }
437: 
438:   /**
439:    * Show one field error.
440:    * @param {string} fieldId
441:    * @param {string} message
442:    * @returns {void}
443:    */
444:   function showError(fieldId, message) {
445:     const el = form.querySelector(`[data-error-for="${fieldId}"]`);
446:     if (!el) return;
447:     el.textContent = message;
448:     el.classList.remove('hidden');
449:   }
450: 
451:   form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
452:     event.preventDefault();
453: 
454:     const honeypotInput = honeypot.querySelector('input');
455:     if (honeypotInput && typeof honeypotInput.value === 'string' && honeypotInput.value.trim().length > 0) {
456:       status.textContent = 'Thanks, your roast will appear after review.';
457:       return;
458:     }
459: 
460:     clearErrors();
461: 
462:     const fields = {
463:       category: categorySelect.value,
464:       headline: headline.input.value,
465:       explanation: explanation.input.value,
466:       claim: claim.input.value,
467:       period: period.input.value,
468:       sourceName: sourceName.input.value,
469:       sourceUrl: sourceUrl.input.value,
470:     };
471: 
472:     const localErrors = validateLocal(fields, categories);
473:     if (localErrors.length > 0) {
474:       for (const error of localErrors) showError(error.field, error.message);
475:       status.textContent = 'Check the highlighted fields.';
476:       return;
477:     }
478: 
479:     submitButton.disabled = true;
480:     status.textContent = 'Sending.';
481: 
482:     const result = await submitRoast({ clubId, ...fields, website: '' });
483: 
484:     submitButton.disabled = false;
485: 
486:     if (result.ok) {
487:       status.textContent = result.message || 'Thanks, your roast will appear after review.';
488:       form.reset();
489:       for (const counter of [
490:         headline.countSpan,
491:         explanation.countSpan,
492:         claim.countSpan,
493:         sourceName.countSpan,
494:       ]) {
495:         if (counter) counter.textContent = '0';
496:       }
497:     } else {
498:       status.textContent = result.message || 'We could not send that. Try again in a moment.';
499:     }
500:   });
501: }

================
File: js/share/actions.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Browser share, download and clipboard actions.
  3:  * Every exported function returns an object and never throws.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: /**
  7:  * Convert a canvas to a PNG blob.
  8:  * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas Canvas to convert.
  9:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, reason: string, blob?: Blob }>} Result with blob when ok.
 10:  */
 11: export function canvasToBlob(canvas) {
 12:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
 13:     try {
 14:       if (!canvas || typeof canvas.toBlob !== 'function') {
 15:         resolve({ ok: false, reason: 'unsupported' });
 16:         return;
 17:       }
 18: 
 19:       canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
 20:         if (blob) {
 21:           resolve({ ok: true, reason: 'blob', blob });
 22:         } else {
 23:           resolve({ ok: false, reason: 'empty' });
 24:         }
 25:       }, 'image/png');
 26:     } catch {
 27:       resolve({ ok: false, reason: 'failed' });
 28:     }
 29:   });
 30: }
 31: 
 32: /**
 33:  * Download a blob with a file name.
 34:  * @param {Blob} blob File contents.
 35:  * @param {string} fileName Download file name.
 36:  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, reason: string }} Result.
 37:  */
 38: export function downloadBlob(blob, fileName) {
 39:   try {
 40:     if (!blob || typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof URL === 'undefined') {
 41:       return { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported' };
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 45:     const link = document.createElement('a');
 46:     link.href = url;
 47:     link.download = String(fileName || 'roastroom.png');
 48:     link.rel = 'noopener';
 49:     link.style.display = 'none';
 50: 
 51:     document.body.append(link);
 52:     link.click();
 53:     link.remove();
 54: 
 55:     window.setTimeout(() => {
 56:       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
 57:     }, 1500);
 58: 
 59:     return { ok: true, reason: 'downloaded' };
 60:   } catch {
 61:     return { ok: false, reason: 'failed' };
 62:   }
 63: }
 64: 
 65: /**
 66:  * Share an image through the system share sheet when available.
 67:  * Falls back to sharing text and URL only.
 68:  * @param {{
 69:  *   blob?: Blob,
 70:  *   fileName?: string,
 71:  *   title?: string,
 72:  *   text?: string,
 73:  *   url?: string
 74:  * }} options Share options.
 75:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, reason: string }>} Result.
 76:  */
 77: export async function shareImage(options) {
 78:   try {
 79:     if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.share !== 'function') {
 80:       return { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported' };
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     const { blob, fileName, title, text, url } = options || {};
 84:     const payload = {
 85:       title: title === undefined ? '' : String(title),
 86:       text: text === undefined ? '' : String(text),
 87:       url: url === undefined ? '' : String(url),
 88:     };
 89: 
 90:     if (blob && typeof File === 'function') {
 91:       const file = new File([blob], String(fileName || 'roastroom.png'), {
 92:         type: blob.type || 'image/png',
 93:       });
 94:       const files = [file];
 95: 
 96:       if (typeof navigator.canShare === 'function' && navigator.canShare({ files })) {
 97:         try {
 98:           await navigator.share({ ...payload, files });
 99:           return { ok: true, reason: 'shared' };
100:         } catch (error) {
101:           if (error && error.name === 'AbortError') {
102:             return { ok: false, reason: 'cancelled' };
103:           }
104:         }
105:       }
106:     }
107: 
108:     await navigator.share(payload);
109:     return { ok: true, reason: 'shared' };
110:   } catch (error) {
111:     if (error && error.name === 'AbortError') {
112:       return { ok: false, reason: 'cancelled' };
113:     }
114:     return { ok: false, reason: 'failed' };
115:   }
116: }
117: 
118: /**
119:  * Copy text with the Clipboard API.
120:  * @param {string} text Text to copy.
121:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, reason: string }>} Result.
122:  */
123: export async function copyText(text) {
124:   try {
125:     if (
126:       typeof navigator === 'undefined' ||
127:       !navigator.clipboard ||
128:       typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText !== 'function'
129:     ) {
130:       return { ok: false, reason: 'unsupported' };
131:     }
132: 
133:     await navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(text === undefined || text === null ? '' : text));
134:     return { ok: true, reason: 'copied' };
135:   } catch {
136:     return { ok: false, reason: 'failed' };
137:   }
138: }

 1: /**
 2:  * Pure share text and share URL helpers.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: import { roastUrl } from '../utils/links.js';
 6: 
 7: /**
 8:  * Sanitise one file name part to lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
 9:  * @param {unknown} value Raw value.
10:  * @returns {string} Sanitised part.
11:  */
12: function sanitisePart(value) {
13:   return String(value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)
14:     .toLowerCase()
15:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
16:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
17: }
18: 
19: /**
20:  * Build the message used by the system share sheet.
21:  * @param {{ headline?: string }} roast Roast data.
22:  * @param {string} url Absolute roast URL.
23:  * @returns {string} Share message.
24:  */
25: export function buildShareText(roast, url) {
26:   const headline = roast && roast.headline ? String(roast.headline) : '';
27:   const link = url === undefined || url === null ? '' : String(url);
28:   return `${headline}\n\nReceipts included. Check them yourself: ${link}`;
29: }
30: 
31: /**
32:  * Build a downloaded PNG file name.
33:  * @param {unknown} clubId Club id.
34:  * @param {unknown} roastId Roast id.
35:  * @param {unknown} formatId Format id such as post or story.
36:  * @returns {string} File name such as roastroom_manutd_roastid_post.png.
37:  */
38: export function buildFileName(clubId, roastId, formatId) {
39:   const club = sanitisePart(clubId) || 'club';
40:   const roast = sanitisePart(roastId) || 'roast';
41:   const format = sanitisePart(formatId) || 'post';
42:   return `roastroom_${club}_${roast}_${format}.png`;
43: }
44: 
45: /**
46:  * Build an absolute roast URL from a base href.
47:  * @param {string} baseHref Page href used as the base.
48:  * @param {string} clubId Club id.
49:  * @param {string} roastId Roast id.
50:  * @returns {string} Absolute URL with the club query and roast hash.
51:  */
52: export function absoluteRoastUrl(baseHref, clubId, roastId) {
53:   const relative = roastUrl(clubId, roastId);
54:   try {
55:     return new URL(relative, baseHref).href;
56:   } catch {
57:     return relative;
58:   }
59: }
60: 
61: /**
62:  * Return the override when set, otherwise the host.
63:  * @param {string} host Current host.
64:  * @param {string} override Host override from shareConfig.
65:  * @returns {string} Host label.
66:  */
67: export function hostLabel(host, override) {
68:   const trimmed = typeof override === 'string' ? override.trim() : '';
69:   if (trimmed.length > 0) return trimmed;
70:   return host === undefined || host === null ? '' : String(host);
71: }

================
File: js/share/textLayout.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Pure text layout helpers. No DOM and no canvas.
  3:  * A measure function is injected so the same logic works in tests and on canvas.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: /**
  7:  * Wrap text into lines that fit inside maxWidth.
  8:  * Words longer than maxWidth are broken by character.
  9:  * @param {string} text Text to wrap.
 10:  * @param {number} maxWidth Maximum line width.
 11:  * @param {(text: string) => number} measure Function returning the width of a string.
 12:  * @returns {string[]} Wrapped lines. Empty input returns an empty array.
 13:  */
 14: export function wrapText(text, maxWidth, measure) {
 15:   const source = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
 16:   if (source.trim().length === 0) return [];
 17: 
 18:   const safeWidth = Number.isFinite(maxWidth) && maxWidth > 0 ? maxWidth : 1;
 19:   if (typeof measure !== 'function') {
 20:     return source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
 21:   }
 22: 
 23:   const words = source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
 24:   const lines = [];
 25:   let current = '';
 26: 
 27:   const push = () => {
 28:     if (current.length > 0) {
 29:       lines.push(current);
 30:       current = '';
 31:     }
 32:   };
 33: 
 34:   for (const word of words) {
 35:     if (measure(word) <= safeWidth) {
 36:       if (current.length === 0) {
 37:         current = word;
 38:       } else {
 39:         const candidate = `${current} ${word}`;
 40:         if (measure(candidate) <= safeWidth) {
 41:           current = candidate;
 42:         } else {
 43:           push();
 44:           current = word;
 45:         }
 46:       }
 47:       continue;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     push();
 51: 
 52:     for (const char of Array.from(word)) {
 53:       if (current.length === 0) {
 54:         current = char;
 55:       } else if (measure(`${current}${char}`) <= safeWidth) {
 56:         current = `${current}${char}`;
 57:       } else {
 58:         push();
 59:         current = char;
 60:       }
 61:     }
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   push();
 65:   return lines;
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Truncate text to fit inside maxWidth and add an ellipsis.
 70:  * @param {string} text Text to truncate.
 71:  * @param {number} maxWidth Maximum line width.
 72:  * @param {(text: string) => number} measure Function returning the width of a string.
 73:  * @returns {string} The original text when it fits, otherwise a truncated string with an ellipsis.
 74:  */
 75: export function truncateToWidth(text, maxWidth, measure) {
 76:   const source = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
 77:   if (source.length === 0) return '';
 78: 
 79:   const safeWidth = Number.isFinite(maxWidth) && maxWidth > 0 ? maxWidth : 0;
 80:   if (safeWidth === 0 || typeof measure !== 'function') return '';
 81: 
 82:   if (measure(source) <= safeWidth) return source;
 83: 
 84:   const ellipsis = '…';
 85:   if (measure(ellipsis) > safeWidth) return '';
 86: 
 87:   let low = 0;
 88:   let high = source.length;
 89: 
 90:   while (low < high) {
 91:     const mid = Math.ceil((low + high) / 2);
 92:     const candidate = `${source.slice(0, mid).trimEnd()}${ellipsis}`;
 93:     if (measure(candidate) <= safeWidth) {
 94:       low = mid;
 95:     } else {
 96:       high = mid - 1;
 97:     }
 98:   }
 99: 
100:   if (low <= 0) return ellipsis;
101:   return `${source.slice(0, low).trimEnd()}${ellipsis}`;
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * Pick the largest font size that fits inside a box.
106:  * @param {{
107:  *   text: string,
108:  *   maxWidth: number,
109:  *   maxHeight: number,
110:  *   maxLines?: number,
111:  *   minFontSize?: number,
112:  *   maxFontSize?: number,
113:  *   step?: number,
114:  *   lineHeightRatio?: number,
115:  *   measure: (text: string, fontSize: number) => number
116:  * }} options Fit options.
117:  * @returns {{ fontSize: number, lines: string[], truncated: boolean }} Fit result.
118:  */
119: export function fitText(options) {
120:   const source =
121:     options && options.text !== undefined && options.text !== null ? String(options.text) : '';
122: 
123:   const minSize =
124:     options && Number.isFinite(options.minFontSize) ? Number(options.minFontSize) : 30;
125:   const maxSize =
126:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxFontSize) ? Number(options.maxFontSize) : 42;
127:   const sizeStep = options && Number.isFinite(options.step) && options.step > 0 ? options.step : 2;
128:   const safeMaxLines =
129:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxLines) && options.maxLines > 0
130:       ? Math.floor(options.maxLines)
131:       : 8;
132:   const safeMaxWidth =
133:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxWidth) && options.maxWidth > 0 ? options.maxWidth : 1;
134:   const safeMaxHeight =
135:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxHeight) && options.maxHeight > 0
136:       ? options.maxHeight
137:       : Infinity;
138:   const safeLineHeight =
139:     options && Number.isFinite(options.lineHeightRatio) && options.lineHeightRatio > 0
140:       ? options.lineHeightRatio
141:       : 1.35;
142:   const measure = options && typeof options.measure === 'function' ? options.measure : null;
143: 
144:   if (source.trim().length === 0) {
145:     return { fontSize: minSize, lines: [], truncated: false };
146:   }
147: 
148:   if (!measure) {
149:     return { fontSize: minSize, lines: [source], truncated: true };
150:   }
151: 
152:   const topSize = Math.max(minSize, maxSize);
153: 
154:   for (let candidate = topSize; candidate >= minSize; candidate -= sizeStep) {
155:     const lines = wrapText(source, safeMaxWidth, (value) => measure(value, candidate));
156:     const maxByHeight =
157:       safeMaxHeight === Infinity
158:         ? safeMaxLines
159:         : Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeMaxHeight / (candidate * safeLineHeight)));
160:     const allowed = Math.min(safeMaxLines, maxByHeight);
161: 
162:     if (lines.length <= allowed) {
163:       return { fontSize: candidate, lines, truncated: false };
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   const finalSize = minSize;
168:   const finalLines = wrapText(source, safeMaxWidth, (value) => measure(value, finalSize));
169:   const finalMaxByHeight =
170:     safeMaxHeight === Infinity
171:       ? safeMaxLines
172:       : Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeMaxHeight / (finalSize * safeLineHeight)));
173:   const finalAllowed = Math.min(safeMaxLines, finalMaxByHeight);
174: 
175:   if (finalLines.length <= finalAllowed) {
176:     return { fontSize: finalSize, lines: finalLines, truncated: false };
177:   }
178: 
179:   const kept = finalLines.slice(0, Math.max(1, finalAllowed));
180:   const lastIndex = kept.length - 1;
181:   if (lastIndex >= 0) {
182:     kept[lastIndex] = truncateToWidth(`${kept[lastIndex]}…`, safeMaxWidth, (value) =>
183:       measure(value, finalSize)
184:     );
185:   }
186: 
187:   return { fontSize: finalSize, lines: kept, truncated: true };
188: }

================
File: js/suggest/suggestClient.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Network client for the suggestions Worker.
  3:  * Every call is wrapped with an 8 second timeout and returns a friendly
  4:  * result. Never throws. Never logs secrets, tokens or IP addresses.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { SUGGEST_API_BASE } from './suggestConfig.js';
  8: 
  9: const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
 10: 
 11: /**
 12:  * Read a response body as JSON without throwing.
 13:  * @param {Response} response
 14:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 15:  */
 16: async function readJson(response) {
 17:   try {
 18:     return await response.json();
 19:   } catch {
 20:     return null;
 21:   }
 22: }
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * Fetch with an 8 second timeout. Returns a friendly result on any failure.
 26:  * @param {string} path
 27:  * @param {RequestInit} options
 28:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, response: Response | null }>}
 29:  */
 30: async function fetchWithTimeout(path, options) {
 31:   const controller = new AbortController();
 32:   const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
 33:   try {
 34:     const response = await fetch(`${SUGGEST_API_BASE}${path}`, {
 35:       ...options,
 36:       signal: controller.signal,
 37:     });
 38:     return { ok: true, response };
 39:   } catch {
 40:     return { ok: false, response: null };
 41:   } finally {
 42:     clearTimeout(timer);
 43:   }
 44: }
 45: 
 46: /**
 47:  * Load the public leaderboard from the Worker.
 48:  * @returns {Promise<{
 49:  *   ok: boolean,
 50:  *   suggestions: Array<{ slug: string, name: string, votes: number }>
 51:  * }>}
 52:  */
 53: export async function fetchSuggestions() {
 54:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return { ok: false, suggestions: [] };
 55:   const result = await fetchWithTimeout('/api/suggestions', { method: 'GET', cache: 'reload' });
 56:   if (!result.ok || !result.response.ok) return { ok: false, suggestions: [] };
 57:   const data = await readJson(result.response);
 58:   if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.suggestions)) {
 59:     return { ok: false, suggestions: [] };
 60:   }
 61:   return { ok: true, suggestions: data.suggestions };
 62: }
 63: 
 64: /**
 65:  * Submit a suggestion. The website field is the honeypot; the UI already
 66:  * short circuits a filled honeypot, and the Worker does the same.
 67:  * @param {string} name
 68:  * @param {string} website
 69:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, status: string, message: string }>}
 70:  */
 71: export async function submitSuggestion(name, website) {
 72:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return { ok: false, status: '', message: '' };
 73:   const result = await fetchWithTimeout('/api/suggestions', {
 74:     method: 'POST',
 75:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 76:     body: JSON.stringify({ name, website: website || '' }),
 77:   });
 78:   if (!result.ok || !result.response) {
 79:     return { ok: false, status: '', message: 'Suggestions are unavailable right now.' };
 80:   }
 81:   const data = await readJson(result.response);
 82:   if (!result.response.ok || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
 83:     const message = data && typeof data.message === 'string' ? data.message : 'Suggestions are unavailable right now.';
 84:     return { ok: false, status: '', message };
 85:   }
 86:   return {
 87:     ok: true,
 88:     status: typeof data.status === 'string' ? data.status : '',
 89:     message: typeof data.message === 'string' ? data.message : '',
 90:   };
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /**
 94:  * Vote for an approved suggestion.
 95:  * @param {string} slug
 96:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, status: string, message: string }>}
 97:  */
 98: export async function submitVote(slug) {
 99:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) return { ok: false, status: '', message: '' };
100:   const result = await fetchWithTimeout('/api/votes', {
101:     method: 'POST',
102:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
103:     body: JSON.stringify({ slug }),
104:   });
105:   if (!result.ok || !result.response) {
106:     return { ok: false, status: '', message: 'Suggestions are unavailable right now.' };
107:   }
108:   const data = await readJson(result.response);
109:   if (!result.response.ok || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
110:     const message = data && typeof data.message === 'string' ? data.message : 'Suggestions are unavailable right now.';
111:     return { ok: false, status: '', message };
112:   }
113:   return {
114:     ok: true,
115:     status: typeof data.status === 'string' ? data.status : '',
116:     message: typeof data.message === 'string' ? data.message : '',
117:   };
118: }
