================
File: worker/src/roastLogic.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Pure logic for the fan roast submission Worker routes.
  3:  * No Cloudflare APIs, no fetch, no KV. Runs unchanged in the Worker and in
  4:  * the Node test runner.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { CATEGORY_IDS, LIMITS } from '../../js/config.js';
  8: import { RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY, normaliseRateRecord } from './logic.js';
  9: 
 10: /** @type {string} */
 11: export const ROASTS_KEY = 'roastboard';
 12: /** @type {number} */
 13: export const ROASTS_VERSION = 1;
 14: /** @type {number} */
 15: export const MAX_ROAST_SUBMISSIONS = 200;
 16: /** @type {number} */
 17: export const ROAST_SUBMISSIONS_PER_DAY = 2;
 18: /** @type {number} */
 19: export const HEADLINE_MAX_LENGTH = LIMITS.headlineMaxLength;
 20: /** @type {number} */
 21: export const EXPLANATION_MAX_LENGTH = LIMITS.explanationMaxLength;
 22: /** @type {number} */
 23: export const CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH = 300;
 24: /** @type {number} */
 25: export const SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH = 2;
 26: /** @type {number} */
 27: export const SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 80;
 28: /** @type {number} */
 29: export const SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH = 300;
 30: /** @type {number} */
 31: export const ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES = 4096;
 32: 
 33: const SEASON_PATTERN = /^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/;
 34: const DATE_PATTERN = /^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})$/;
 35: const IPV4_PATTERN = /^\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$/;
 36: const BASE36_ALPHABET = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
 37: 
 38: /**
 39:  * Strip control characters, replace them with a single space, collapse runs of
 40:  * whitespace to one space and trim. Anything that is not a string becomes an
 41:  * empty string.
 42:  * @param {unknown} raw
 43:  * @returns {string}
 44:  */
 45: export function normaliseText(raw) {
 46:   if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
 47:   let out = '';
 48:   for (const char of raw) {
 49:     const code = char.codePointAt(0);
 50:     if (code === undefined) continue;
 51:     if (code < 0x20 || code === 0x7f) {
 52:       out += ' ';
 53:       continue;
 54:     }
 55:     out += char;
 56:   }
 57:   return out.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
 58: }
 59: 
 60: /**
 61:  * True for a season such as 2013/14 or a real calendar date such as 2021/09/11.
 62:  * @param {unknown} value
 63:  * @returns {boolean}
 64:  */
 65: export function validateRoastPeriod(value) {
 66:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
 67:   if (SEASON_PATTERN.test(value)) return true;
 68:   const match = DATE_PATTERN.exec(value);
 69:   if (!match) return false;
 70:   const year = Number(match[1]);
 71:   const month = Number(match[2]);
 72:   const day = Number(match[3]);
 73:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
 74:   return (
 75:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
 76:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
 77:     date.getUTCDate() === day
 78:   );
 79: }
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * True for a public https URL with a dotted hostname, no credentials and no
 83:  * IP address. Rejects anything longer than SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH.
 84:  * @param {unknown} value
 85:  * @returns {boolean}
 86:  */
 87: export function validatePublicSourceUrl(value) {
 88:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
 89:   if (value.length === 0 || value.length > SOURCE_URL_MAX_LENGTH) return false;
 90:   if (!value.startsWith('https://')) return false;
 91:   let url;
 92:   try {
 93:     url = new URL(value);
 94:   } catch {
 95:     return false;
 96:   }
 97:   if (url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
 98:   if (url.username.length > 0 || url.password.length > 0) return false;
 99:   const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
100:   if (host.length === 0) return false;
101:   if (host === 'localhost') return false;
102:   if (host.startsWith('[') && host.endsWith(']')) return false;
103:   if (IPV4_PATTERN.test(host)) return false;
104:   if (!host.includes('.')) return false;
105:   return true;
106: }
107: 
108: /**
109:  * @typedef {Object} RoastSubmissionFields
110:  * @property {string} clubId
111:  * @property {string} category
112:  * @property {string} headline
113:  * @property {string} explanation
114:  * @property {string} claim
115:  * @property {string} period
116:  * @property {string} sourceName
117:  * @property {string} sourceUrl
118:  */
119: 
120: /**
121:  * Validate the text fields of one roast submission.
122:  * @param {unknown} raw
123:  * @param {string[]} liveClubIds
124:  * @returns {{ valid: boolean, errors: string[], value: RoastSubmissionFields }}
125:  */
126: export function validateRoastFields(raw, liveClubIds) {
127:   const errors = [];
128:   const value = {
129:     clubId: '',
130:     category: '',
131:     headline: '',
132:     explanation: '',
133:     claim: '',
134:     period: '',
135:     sourceName: '',
136:     sourceUrl: '',
137:   };
138: 
139:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
140:     return { valid: false, errors: ['fields must be an object'], value };
141:   }
142: 
143:   const clubId = normaliseText(raw.clubId);
144:   if (clubId.length === 0) {
145:     errors.push('clubId must be a non empty string');
146:   } else if (!Array.isArray(liveClubIds) || !liveClubIds.includes(clubId)) {
147:     errors.push('clubId is not a live club');
148:   } else {
149:     value.clubId = clubId;
150:   }
151: 
152:   const category = normaliseText(raw.category);
153:   if (category.length === 0) {
154:     errors.push('category must be a non empty string');
155:   } else if (!CATEGORY_IDS.includes(category)) {
156:     errors.push('category is not a known category');
157:   } else {
158:     value.category = category;
159:   }
160: 
161:   const headline = normaliseText(raw.headline);
162:   if (headline.length === 0) {
163:     errors.push('headline must be a non empty string');
164:   } else if (headline.length > HEADLINE_MAX_LENGTH) {
165:     errors.push(`headline must be ${HEADLINE_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
166:   } else {
167:     value.headline = headline;
168:   }
169: 
170:   const explanation = normaliseText(raw.explanation);
171:   if (explanation.length === 0) {
172:     errors.push('explanation must be a non empty string');
173:   } else if (explanation.length > EXPLANATION_MAX_LENGTH) {
174:     errors.push(`explanation must be ${EXPLANATION_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
175:   } else {
176:     value.explanation = explanation;
177:   }
178: 
179:   const claim = normaliseText(raw.claim);
180:   if (claim.length === 0) {
181:     errors.push('claim must be a non empty string');
182:   } else if (claim.length > CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH) {
183:     errors.push(`claim must be ${CLAIM_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
184:   } else {
185:     value.claim = claim;
186:   }
187: 
188:   const period = normaliseText(raw.period);
189:   if (!validateRoastPeriod(period)) {
190:     errors.push('period must be a season such as 2013/14 or a real date such as 2021/09/11');
191:   } else {
192:     value.period = period;
193:   }
194: 
195:   const sourceName = normaliseText(raw.sourceName);
196:   if (sourceName.length < SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH) {
197:     errors.push(`sourceName must be at least ${SOURCE_NAME_MIN_LENGTH} characters`);
198:   } else if (sourceName.length > SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
199:     errors.push(`sourceName must be ${SOURCE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
200:   } else {
201:     value.sourceName = sourceName;
202:   }
203: 
204:   const sourceUrlRaw = typeof raw.sourceUrl === 'string' ? raw.sourceUrl.trim() : '';
205:   if (!validatePublicSourceUrl(sourceUrlRaw)) {
206:     errors.push('sourceUrl must be a public https url with a hostname');
207:   } else {
208:     value.sourceUrl = sourceUrlRaw;
209:   }
210: 
211:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, value };
212: }
213: 
214: /**
215:  * Read a roast board safely. Missing or malformed boards become empty boards.
216:  * @param {unknown} board
217:  * @returns {{ version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> }}
218:  */
219: export function normaliseRoastBoard(board) {
220:   if (
221:     !board ||
222:     typeof board !== 'object' ||
223:     !board.submissions ||
224:     typeof board.submissions !== 'object' ||
225:     Array.isArray(board.submissions)
226:   ) {
227:     return { version: ROASTS_VERSION, submissions: {} };
228:   }
229:   return { version: ROASTS_VERSION, submissions: board.submissions };
230: }
231: 
232: /**
233:  * Count the submissions in a roast board.
234:  * @param {unknown} board
235:  * @returns {number}
236:  */
237: export function countRoastSubmissions(board) {
238:   return Object.keys(normaliseRoastBoard(board).submissions).length;
239: }
240: 
241: /**
242:  * Read the roast rate record, adding the roast submission count.
243:  * @param {unknown} record
244:  * @returns {{ actions: number, voted: string[], roasts: number }}
245:  */
246: export function normaliseRoastRate(record) {
247:   const base = normaliseRateRecord(record);
248:   const roasts = Number.isInteger(base.roasts) && base.roasts >= 0 ? base.roasts : 0;
249:   return { actions: base.actions, voted: base.voted.slice(), roasts };
250: }
251: 
252: /**
253:  * Build a lowercase base 36 string of the given length from an injected
254:  * random source.
255:  * @param {() => number} rng
256:  * @param {number} length
257:  * @returns {string}
258:  */
259: function randomBase36(rng, length) {
260:   let out = '';
261:   for (let i = 0; i < length; i += 1) {
262:     const n = rng();
263:     const safe = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
264:     const index = Math.floor(safe * BASE36_ALPHABET.length);
265:     const bounded = Math.max(0, Math.min(BASE36_ALPHABET.length - 1, index));
266:     out += BASE36_ALPHABET[bounded];
267:   }
268:   return out;
269: }
270: 
271: /**
272:  * Generate a unique id of the shape fan_ followed by a short lowercase base 36
273:  * string. The id matches the roast id pattern in js/schema.js and is at most
274:  * 64 characters. The random source is injected so tests stay deterministic.
275:  * @param {unknown} board
276:  * @param {() => number} [random]
277:  * @returns {string}
278:  */
279: export function generateRoastId(board, random) {
280:   const safe = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
281:   const rng = typeof random === 'function' ? random : Math.random;
282:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt += 1) {
283:     const suffix = attempt > 0 ? attempt.toString(36) : '';
284:     const id = `fan_${randomBase36(rng, 8)}${suffix}`;
285:     if (!safe.submissions[id]) return id;
286:   }
287:   return `fan_${randomBase36(rng, 8)}${Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4)}`;
288: }
289: 
290: /**
291:  * Format an ISO timestamp as a UTC date string in YYYY/MM/DD shape. Returns an
292:  * empty string when the input cannot be parsed.
293:  * @param {string} isoString
294:  * @returns {string}
295:  */
296: function utcDateString(isoString) {
297:   const date = new Date(isoString);
298:   if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
299:   const year = date.getUTCFullYear();
300:   const month = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
301:   const day = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
302:   return `${year}/${month}/${day}`;
303: }
304: 
305: /**
306:  * True when the board already holds a pending or approved submission with the
307:  * same club and normalised headline.
308:  * @param {{ version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> }} board
309:  * @param {string} clubId
310:  * @param {string} headline
311:  * @returns {boolean}
312:  */
313: function hasDuplicateHeadline(board, clubId, headline) {
314:   for (const entry of Object.values(board.submissions)) {
315:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
316:     if (entry.status !== 'pending' && entry.status !== 'approved') continue;
317:     if (entry.clubId === clubId && entry.headline === headline) return true;
318:   }
319:   return false;
320: }
321: 
322: /**
323:  * Build a pending submission object.
324:  * @param {{ id: string, fields: RoastSubmissionFields, now: string }} options
325:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown>}
326:  */
327: function buildPendingSubmission(options) {
328:   const { id, fields, now } = options;
329:   return {
330:     id,
331:     clubId: fields.clubId,
332:     category: fields.category,
333:     headline: fields.headline,
334:     explanation: fields.explanation,
335:     claim: fields.claim,
336:     period: fields.period,
337:     sourceName: fields.sourceName,
338:     sourceUrl: fields.sourceUrl,
339:     status: 'pending',
340:     createdAt: now,
341:     updatedAt: now,
342:     verifiedOn: '',
343:   };
344: }
345: 
346: /**
347:  * Apply a roast submission. On success performs exactly two KV writes (rate
348:  * record and roast board). Rejected submissions perform none.
349:  * @param {{
350:  *   board: unknown,
351:  *   rateRecord: unknown,
352:  *   fields: unknown,
353:  *   now: string,
354:  *   liveClubIds: string[],
355:  *   random?: () => number
356:  * }} options
357:  * @returns {{
358:  *   outcome: 'pending' | 'invalid' | 'rateLimited' | 'full' | 'duplicate',
359:  *   board: { version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> },
360:  *   rateRecord: { actions: number, voted: string[], roasts: number },
361:  *   value: RoastSubmissionFields,
362:  *   errors: string[]
363:  * }}
364:  */
365: export function applyRoastSubmission(options) {
366:   const { board, rateRecord, fields, now, liveClubIds, random } = options || {};
367:   const safeBoard = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
368:   const safeRate = normaliseRoastRate(rateRecord);
369: 
370:   const validation = validateRoastFields(fields, liveClubIds);
371:   if (!validation.valid) {
372:     return {
373:       outcome: 'invalid',
374:       board: safeBoard,
375:       rateRecord: safeRate,
376:       value: validation.value,
377:       errors: validation.errors,
378:     };
379:   }
380: 
381:   if (safeRate.actions >= RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY) {
382:     return {
383:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
384:       board: safeBoard,
385:       rateRecord: safeRate,
386:       value: validation.value,
387:       errors: ['You have reached the daily limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
388:     };
389:   }
390:   if (safeRate.roasts >= ROAST_SUBMISSIONS_PER_DAY) {
391:     return {
392:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
393:       board: safeBoard,
394:       rateRecord: safeRate,
395:       value: validation.value,
396:       errors: ['You have reached the daily roast submission limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
397:     };
398:   }
399: 
400:   if (hasDuplicateHeadline(safeBoard, validation.value.clubId, validation.value.headline)) {
401:     return {
402:       outcome: 'duplicate',
403:       board: safeBoard,
404:       rateRecord: safeRate,
405:       value: validation.value,
406:       errors: ['That headline is already on the list.'],
407:     };
408:   }
409: 
410:   if (countRoastSubmissions(safeBoard) >= MAX_ROAST_SUBMISSIONS) {
411:     return {
412:       outcome: 'full',
413:       board: safeBoard,
414:       rateRecord: safeRate,
415:       value: validation.value,
416:       errors: ['The submission list is full right now.'],
417:     };
418:   }
419: 
420:   const id = generateRoastId(safeBoard, random);
421:   const submission = buildPendingSubmission({ id, fields: validation.value, now });
422:   const nextBoard = {
423:     version: safeBoard.version,
424:     submissions: { ...safeBoard.submissions, [id]: submission },
425:   };
426:   const nextRate = {
427:     actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
428:     voted: safeRate.voted.slice(),
429:     roasts: safeRate.roasts + 1,
430:   };
431:   return {
432:     outcome: 'pending',
433:     board: nextBoard,
434:     rateRecord: nextRate,
435:     value: validation.value,
436:     errors: [],
437:   };
438: }
439: 
440: /**
441:  * Approve one roast submission. checkedSource must be exactly true.
442:  * @param {{ board: unknown, id: string, checkedSource: boolean, now: string }} options
443:  * @returns {{ outcome: 'approved' | 'notFound' | 'notChecked', board: { version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> } }}
444:  */
445: export function applyRoastApprove(options) {
446:   const { board, id, checkedSource, now } = options || {};
447:   const safeBoard = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
448:   const safeId = typeof id === 'string' ? id : '';
449:   if (!safeId || !safeBoard.submissions[safeId]) {
450:     return { outcome: 'notFound', board: safeBoard };
451:   }
452:   if (checkedSource !== true) {
453:     return { outcome: 'notChecked', board: safeBoard };
454:   }
455:   const existing = safeBoard.submissions[safeId];
456:   const nextBoard = {
457:     version: safeBoard.version,
458:     submissions: {
459:       ...safeBoard.submissions,
460:       [safeId]: {
461:         ...existing,
462:         status: 'approved',
463:         updatedAt: now,
464:         verifiedOn: utcDateString(now),
465:       },
466:     },
467:   };
468:   return { outcome: 'approved', board: nextBoard };
469: }
470: 
471: /**
472:  * Reject one roast submission.
473:  * @param {{ board: unknown, id: string, now: string }} options
474:  * @returns {{ outcome: 'rejected' | 'notFound', board: { version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> } }}
475:  */
476: export function applyRoastReject(options) {
477:   const { board, id, now } = options || {};
478:   const safeBoard = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
479:   const safeId = typeof id === 'string' ? id : '';
480:   if (!safeId || !safeBoard.submissions[safeId]) {
481:     return { outcome: 'notFound', board: safeBoard };
482:   }
483:   const existing = safeBoard.submissions[safeId];
484:   const nextBoard = {
485:     version: safeBoard.version,
486:     submissions: {
487:       ...safeBoard.submissions,
488:       [safeId]: { ...existing, status: 'rejected', updatedAt: now, verifiedOn: '' },
489:     },
490:   };
491:   return { outcome: 'rejected', board: nextBoard };
492: }
493: 
494: /**
495:  * Remove one roast submission.
496:  * @param {{ board: unknown, id: string }} options
497:  * @returns {{ outcome: 'removed' | 'notFound', board: { version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> } }}
498:  */
499: export function applyRoastRemove(options) {
500:   const { board, id } = options || {};
501:   const safeBoard = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
502:   const safeId = typeof id === 'string' ? id : '';
503:   if (!safeId || !safeBoard.submissions[safeId]) {
504:     return { outcome: 'notFound', board: safeBoard };
505:   }
506:   const next = { ...safeBoard.submissions };
507:   delete next[safeId];
508:   return { outcome: 'removed', board: { version: safeBoard.version, submissions: next } };
509: }
510: 
511: /**
512:  * Edit the text fields of one submission with the same validation rules.
513:  * @param {{ board: unknown, id: string, fields: unknown, now: string, liveClubIds: string[] }} options
514:  * @returns {{ outcome: 'updated' | 'notFound' | 'invalid', board: { version: number, submissions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> }, errors: string[] }}
515:  */
516: export function applyRoastEdit(options) {
517:   const { board, id, fields, now, liveClubIds } = options || {};
518:   const safeBoard = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
519:   const safeId = typeof id === 'string' ? id : '';
520:   if (!safeId || !safeBoard.submissions[safeId]) {
521:     return { outcome: 'notFound', board: safeBoard, errors: [] };
522:   }
523:   const validation = validateRoastFields(fields, liveClubIds);
524:   if (!validation.valid) {
525:     return { outcome: 'invalid', board: safeBoard, errors: validation.errors };
526:   }
527:   const existing = safeBoard.submissions[safeId];
528:   const nextBoard = {
529:     version: safeBoard.version,
530:     submissions: {
531:       ...safeBoard.submissions,
532:       [safeId]: {
533:         ...existing,
534:         clubId: validation.value.clubId,
535:         category: validation.value.category,
536:         headline: validation.value.headline,
537:         explanation: validation.value.explanation,
538:         claim: validation.value.claim,
539:         period: validation.value.period,
540:         sourceName: validation.value.sourceName,
541:         sourceUrl: validation.value.sourceUrl,
542:         updatedAt: now,
543:       },
544:     },
545:   };
546:   return { outcome: 'updated', board: nextBoard, errors: [] };
547: }
548: 
549: /**
550:  * Map an approved submission to the site's roast schema. Returns null when the
551:  * submission is not approved or has no verifiedOn date.
552:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} submission
553:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown> | null}
554:  */
555: export function toRoastSchema(submission) {
556:   if (!submission || typeof submission !== 'object') return null;
557:   if (submission.status !== 'approved') return null;
558:   const verifiedOn =
559:     typeof submission.verifiedOn === 'string' && submission.verifiedOn.length > 0
560:       ? submission.verifiedOn
561:       : '';
562:   if (verifiedOn.length === 0) return null;
563:   return {
564:     id: submission.id,
565:     clubId: submission.clubId,
566:     category: submission.category,
567:     headline: submission.headline,
568:     explanation: submission.explanation,
569:     evidence: [
570:       {
571:         claim: submission.claim,
572:         period: submission.period,
573:         sourceName: submission.sourceName,
574:         sourceUrl: submission.sourceUrl,
575:         accessedOn: verifiedOn,
576:       },
577:     ],
578:     verified: true,
579:     verifiedOn,
580:     tags: ['fan'],
581:   };
582: }
583: 
584: /**
585:  * Build the public roast view. Approved submissions only, mapped to the roast
586:  * schema. Never includes pending or rejected items or timestamps beyond
587:  * verifiedOn.
588:  * @param {unknown} board
589:  * @param {string} clubId
590:  * @returns {{ roasts: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }}
591:  */
592: export function publicRoastsView(board, clubId) {
593:   const safe = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
594:   const safeClub = typeof clubId === 'string' ? clubId : '';
595:   if (safeClub.length === 0) return { roasts: [] };
596:   const roasts = [];
597:   for (const entry of Object.values(safe.submissions)) {
598:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
599:     if (entry.status !== 'approved') continue;
600:     if (entry.clubId !== safeClub) continue;
601:     const roast = toRoastSchema(entry);
602:     if (roast) roasts.push(roast);
603:   }
604:   return { roasts };
605: }
606: 
607: /**
608:  * Build the admin roast view. Every submission, pending first, then newest
609:  * first by createdAt.
610:  * @param {unknown} board
611:  * @returns {{ submissions: Array<Record<string, string>> }}
612:  */
613: export function adminRoastsView(board) {
614:   const safe = normaliseRoastBoard(board);
615:   const submissions = Object.values(safe.submissions)
616:     .filter((entry) => entry && typeof entry === 'object')
617:     .map((entry) => ({
618:       id: String(entry.id || ''),
619:       clubId: String(entry.clubId || ''),
620:       category: String(entry.category || ''),
621:       headline: String(entry.headline || ''),
622:       explanation: String(entry.explanation || ''),
623:       claim: String(entry.claim || ''),
624:       period: String(entry.period || ''),
625:       sourceName: String(entry.sourceName || ''),
626:       sourceUrl: String(entry.sourceUrl || ''),
627:       status: String(entry.status || ''),
628:       createdAt: String(entry.createdAt || ''),
629:       updatedAt: String(entry.updatedAt || ''),
630:       verifiedOn: String(entry.verifiedOn || ''),
631:     }));
632:   submissions.sort((a, b) => {
633:     const rankA = a.status === 'pending' ? 0 : 1;
634:     const rankB = b.status === 'pending' ? 0 : 1;
635:     if (rankA !== rankB) return rankA - rankB;
636:     if (a.createdAt > b.createdAt) return -1;
637:     if (a.createdAt < b.createdAt) return 1;
638:     return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
639:   });
640:   return { submissions };
641: }

271:       <section aria-labelledby="clubsHeading" class="mb-12">
272:         <h2 id="clubsHeading" class="text-2xl text-text">Clubs</h2>
273:         <p class="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm text-textMuted">
274:           Read from data/clubs.json through the real registry module. The registry is the
275:           single source of truth for which clubs exist.
276:         </p>
277:         <p id="registryStatus" role="status" class="mt-3 text-sm text-accent">
278:           Loading the club registry.
279:         </p>
280: 
281:         <div class="mt-4 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
282:           <div>
283:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Live</h3>
284:             <ul id="liveClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>
285:           </div>
286:           <div>
287:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Coming soon</h3>
288:             <ul id="comingSoonClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>
289:           </div>

293: 
294:     <footer class="border-t border-line bg-surface">
295:       <div class="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 py-10">
296:         <p class="text-sm text-textMuted">
297:           The Roast Room, stage 1 foundations. Built by Fritt. Every claim on the finished
298:           site must be sourced, dated and verified before it can be published.
299:         </p>
300:       </div>
301:     </footer>
302: 
303:     <script type="module">
304:       import { getComingSoonClubs, getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from './js/registry.js';
305:       import { applyTheme } from './js/theme.js';
306: 
307:       const registryStatus = document.getElementById('registryStatus');
308:       const liveClubsList = document.getElementById('liveClubs');
309:       const comingSoonClubsList = document.getElementById('comingSoonClubs');
310:       const themeButton = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
311:       const themeName = document.getElementById('currentTheme');
312:       const overridesEl = document.getElementById('themeOverrides');
313:       const tokenValues = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-token]'));
314: 
315:       const themeCycle = [];
316:       let themeIndex = 0;
317: 
318:       /**
319:        * Read the live value of every colour token and print it under the swatch.
320:        * @returns {void}
321:        */
322:       function refreshTokenValues() {
323:         const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
324: 
325:         for (const element of tokenValues) {
326:           const variable = element.getAttribute('data-token');
327:           const value = styles.getPropertyValue(variable).trim();
328:           element.textContent = value || 'not set';
329:         }
330:       }
331: 
332:       /**
333:        * Print which tokens the currently applied theme overrides. Because
334:        * applyTheme clears every property before applying a new theme, this list
335:        * is exactly the set of keys in the active theme object.
336:        * @returns {void}
337:        */
338:       function updateOverrideLine() {
339:         if (!overridesEl) return;
340: 
341:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) {
342:           overridesEl.textContent = '';
343:           return;
344:         }
345: 
346:         const current = themeCycle[themeIndex];
347:         const keys = current.theme ? Object.keys(current.theme) : [];
348:         const list = keys.length > 0 ? keys.join(', ') : 'none';
349:         overridesEl.textContent = `Tokens currently overridden by ${current.label}: ${list}`;
350:       }
351: 
352:       /**
353:        * Build one club card for the registry lists.
354:        * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club
355:        * @returns {HTMLLIElement}
356:        */
357:       function createClubItem(club) {
358:         const item = document.createElement('li');
359:         item.className = 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4';
360: 
361:         const name = document.createElement('p');
362:         name.className = 'font-display text-xl uppercase text-text';
363:         name.textContent = String(club.name);
364: 
365:         const meta = document.createElement('p');
366:         meta.className = 'mt-2 text-sm text-textMuted';
367:         meta.textContent = `id: ${club.id} | status: ${club.status} | themeKey: ${club.themeKey}`;
368: 
369:         item.append(name, meta);
370: 
371:         if (typeof club.dataFile === 'string') {
372:           const file = document.createElement('p');
373:           file.className = 'mt-1 text-xs text-textMuted';
374:           file.textContent = `dataFile: ${club.dataFile}`;
375:           item.append(file);
376:         }
377: 
378:         return item;
379:       }
380: 
381:       /**
382:        * Replace the contents of a list with the given clubs.
383:        * @param {HTMLUListElement} list
384:        * @param {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} clubs
385:        * @returns {void}
386:        */
387:       function renderClubList(list, clubs) {
388:         list.textContent = '';
389:         for (const club of clubs) {
390:           list.append(createClubItem(club));
391:         }
392:       }
393: 
394:       /**
395:        * Load the registry and the live club, then wire up the theme button.
396:        * The cycle is deliberately Manchester United, Arsenal, Manchester United.
397:        * @returns {Promise<void>}
398:        */
399:       async function start() {
400:         try {
401:           const registry = await loadRegistry();
402:           renderClubList(liveClubsList, getLiveClubs(registry));
403:           renderClubList(comingSoonClubsList, getComingSoonClubs(registry));
404:           registryStatus.textContent = `Registry version ${registry.version} loaded with ${registry.clubs.length} clubs.`;
405: 
406:           const liveClub = await loadClub('manutd');
407:           themeCycle.push({ label: liveClub.name, theme: liveClub.theme });
408: 
409:           const comingSoonWithTheme = getComingSoonClubs(registry).filter((club) => club.theme);
410:           for (const club of comingSoonWithTheme) {
411:             themeCycle.push({ label: club.name, theme: club.theme });
412:           }
413: 
414:           themeButton.disabled = themeCycle.length < 2;
415:         } catch (error) {
416:           registryStatus.textContent =
417:             'Could not load the club registry. Serve the site over http, for example with npx serve, then reload. ' +
418:             String(error.message);
419:         }
420: 
421:         refreshTokenValues();
422:         updateOverrideLine();
423:       }
424: 
425:       themeButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
426:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) return;
427: 
428:         themeIndex = (themeIndex + 1) % themeCycle.length;
429:         const next = themeCycle[themeIndex];
430: 
431:         applyTheme(next.theme);
432:         themeName.textContent = next.label;
433:         refreshTokenValues();
434:         updateOverrideLine();
435:       });
436: 
437:       await start();
438:     </script>
439:   </body>
440: </html>

================
File: css/base.css
================
  1: /*
  2:   Reset, typography, focus styles and the handful of shared component classes.
  3:   Everything sits in a Tailwind layer so utility classes always win.
  4: */
  5: 
  6: @layer base {
  7:   *,
  8:   *::before,
  9:   *::after {
 10:     box-sizing: border-box;
 11:   }
 12: 
 13:   html {
 14:     background-color: var(--colorBackground);
 15:     text-size-adjust: 100%;
 16:     scroll-behavior: smooth;
 17:   }
 18: 
 19:     body {
 20:     margin: 0;
 21:     min-height: 100vh;

File: js/background/layers.js

 1: /**
 2:  * Background SVG layers for The Roast Room.
 3:  *
 4:  * All artwork is original, abstract and drawn with plain SVG shapes.
 5:  * Nothing here reproduces a club crest, player likeness, sponsor or logo.
 6:  * Colours read from the active club theme via CSS custom properties, so the
 7:  * same layers recolour when applyTheme() runs on the room page.
 8:  *
 9:  * @typedef {Object} BackgroundLayer
10:  * @property {number} speed Parallax speed. 0 = static, 1 = scrolls with page.
11:  * @property {string} svg Inline SVG string.
12:  * @property {boolean} [fast] True for the nearest layer, hidden on small screens.
13:  */
14: 
15: const VIEW_BOX = '0 0 1200 800';
16: 
17: /**
18:  * Wrap SVG inner markup in a root svg element.
19:  * @param {string} inner
20:  * @returns {string}
21:  */
22: function wrap(inner) {
23:   return (
24:     `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="${VIEW_BOX}" ` +
25:     `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true">` +
26:     inner +
27:     `</svg>`
28:   );
29: }
30: 
31: // Far layer: pitch lines and a big downward arrow (decline, no numbers, no claims).
32: const PITCH_AND_ARROW = wrap(`
33:   <g fill="none" stroke="var(--colorText)" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.18">
34:     <rect x="60" y="60" width="1080" height="680" />
35:     <line x1="600" y1="60" x2="600" y2="740" />
36:     <circle cx="600" cy="400" r="120" />
37:     <rect x="60" y="220" width="150" height="360" />
38:     <rect x="990" y="220" width="150" height="360" />
39:   </g>
40:   <g fill="var(--colorText)" opacity="0.06"><path d="M420 260 L600 420 L780 260 L720 260 L600 340 L480 260 Z"/><path d="M420 440 L600 600 L780 440 L720 440 L600 520 L480 440 Z"/></g>
41: `);
42: 
43: // Mid layer: a stylised broken trophy cup.
44: const BROKEN_TROPHY = wrap(`
45:   <g fill="var(--colorPrimary)" opacity="0.28">
46:     <path d="M480 160 L720 160 L700 340
47:              C700 430 650 490 600 510
48:              L600 590 L680 610 L680 630 L520 630 L520 610 L600 590
49:              L600 510 C550 490 500 430 500 340 Z" />
50:     <path d="M440 180 C400 180 390 230 410 270
51:              C430 310 470 330 500 320"
52:           fill="none" stroke="var(--colorPrimary)" stroke-width="14" />
53:     <path d="M760 180 C800 180 810 230 790 270
54:              C770 310 730 330 700 320"
55:           fill="none" stroke="var(--colorPrimary)" stroke-width="14" />
56:   </g>
57:   <path d="M600 210 L558 340 L612 362 L566 480"
58:         fill="none" stroke="var(--colorBackground)" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.9" />
59: `);
60: 
61: // Near layer: floating receipt and ticket stubs (on-brand with "receipts included").
62: const RECEIPTS = wrap(`
63:   <g fill="var(--colorText)" opacity="0.10">
64:     <rect x="120" y="120" width="120" height="160" rx="2" />
65:     <rect x="900" y="240" width="140" height="180" rx="2" />
66:     <rect x="200" y="560" width="100" height="140" rx="2" />
67:     <rect x="820" y="560" width="160" height="120" rx="2" />
68:   </g>
69:   <g fill="none" stroke="var(--colorText)" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.18">
70:     <line x1="130" y1="150" x2="230" y2="150" />
71:     <line x1="130" y1="170" x2="220" y2="170" />
72:     <line x1="130" y1="190" x2="200" y2="190" />
73:     <line x1="910" y1="270" x2="1030" y2="270" />
74:     <line x1="910" y1="290" x2="1010" y2="290" />
75:     <line x1="910" y1="310" x2="1040" y2="310" />
76:   </g>
77: `);
78: 
79: /** @type {Record<string, BackgroundLayer[]>} */
80: export const BACKGROUND_LAYERS = {
81:   manutd: [
82:     { speed: 0.05, svg: PITCH_AND_ARROW },
83:     { speed: 0.15, svg: BROKEN_TROPHY },
84:     { speed: 0.30, svg: RECEIPTS, fast: true },
85:   ],
86: };
87: 
88: /**
89:  * Return the background layers for a club id, falling back to Man Utd.
90:  * @param {string} [clubId]
91:  * @returns {BackgroundLayer[]}
92:  */
93: export function backgroundLayersFor(clubId) {
94:   return BACKGROUND_LAYERS[clubId] || BACKGROUND_LAYERS.manutd;
95: }

================
File: js/dev/adminLab.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Logic for the developer only suggestions admin page.
  3:  * The admin token lives in memory only and is never stored or logged.
  4:  * Every network call is wrapped with an 8 second timeout and returns a
  5:  * friendly result. Never throws.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import { SUGGEST_API_BASE } from '../suggest/suggestConfig.js';
  9: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 10: 
 11: const formEl = document.getElementById('adminForm');
 12: const tokenEl = document.getElementById('adminToken');
 13: const statusEl = document.getElementById('adminStatus');
 14: const bodyEl = document.getElementById('adminBody');
 15: const roastBodyEl = document.getElementById('roastAdminBody');
 16: const roastStatusEl = document.getElementById('roastAdminStatus');
 17: const roastPendingCountEl = document.getElementById('roastPendingCount');
 18: 
 19: let adminToken = '';
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * Set the live status message.
 23:  * @param {string} message
 24:  * @returns {void}
 25:  */
 26: function setStatus(message) {
 27:   if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = message || '';
 28: }
 29: 
 30: /**
 31:  * Fetch a Worker admin endpoint with a bearer token and an 8 second timeout.
 32:  * @param {string} path
 33:  * @param {RequestInit} options
 34:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean, response: Response | null }>}
 35:  */
 36: async function adminFetch(path, options) {
 37:   const controller = new AbortController();
 38:   const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
 39:   try {
 40:     const response = await fetch(`${SUGGEST_API_BASE}${path}`, {
 41:       ...options,
 42:       headers: {
 43:         ...(options && options.headers ? options.headers : {}),
 44:         Authorization: `Bearer ${adminToken}`,
 45:       },
 46:       signal: controller.signal,
 47:     });
 48:     return { ok: true, response };
 49:   } catch {
 50:     return { ok: false, response: null };
 51:   } finally {
 52:     clearTimeout(timer);
 53:   }
 54: }
 55: 
 56: /**
 57:  * Load every suggestion from the Worker.
 58:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 59:  */
 60: async function loadSuggestions() {
 61:   setStatus('Loading.');
 62:   const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/suggestions', { method: 'GET' });
 63:   if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
 64:     setStatus('Could not load. Check the token and try again.');
 65:     return;
 66:   }
 67:   let data = null;
 68:   try {
 69:     data = await result.response.json();
 70:   } catch {
 71:     data = null;
 72:   }
 73:   if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.suggestions)) {
 74:     setStatus('Could not load. The response was not what we expected.');
 75:     return;
 76:   }
 77:   renderTable(data.suggestions);
 78:   setStatus(`${data.suggestions.length} suggestions loaded.`);
 79: }
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * Approve or hide one suggestion.
 83:  * @param {string} slug
 84:  * @param {boolean} approved
 85:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 86:  */
 87: async function setApproved(slug, approved) {
 88:   const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/approve', {
 89:     method: 'POST',
 90:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 91:     body: JSON.stringify({ slug, approved }),
 92:   });
 93:   if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
 94:     setStatus('Could not update that suggestion.');
 95:     return;
 96:   }
 97:   await loadSuggestions();
 98:   setStatus(approved ? 'Approved.' : 'Hidden.');
 99: }
100: 
101: /**
102:  * Remove one suggestion.
103:  * @param {string} slug
104:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
105:  */
106: async function removeSuggestion(slug) {
107:   const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/remove', {
108:     method: 'POST',
109:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
110:     body: JSON.stringify({ slug }),
111:   });
112:   if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
113:     setStatus('Could not remove that suggestion.');
114:     return;
115:   }
116:   await loadSuggestions();
117:   setStatus('Removed.');
118: }
119: 
120: /**
121:  * Render the suggestion table.
122:  * @param {Array<{
123:  *   slug: string, name: string, votes: number, approved: boolean,
124:  *   createdAt: string, updatedAt: string
125:  * }>} suggestions
126:  * @returns {void}
127:  */
128: function renderTable(suggestions) {
129:   if (!bodyEl) return;
130:   bodyEl.textContent = '';
131: 
132:   for (const suggestion of suggestions) {
133:     const row = document.createElement('tr');
134: 
135:     const cell = (value) => {
136:       const td = document.createElement('td');
137:       td.className = 'border border-line p-2 text-sm';
138:       td.textContent = value;
139:       return td;
140:     };
141: 
142:     row.append(
143:       cell(suggestion.name),
144:       cell(suggestion.slug),
145:       cell(String(suggestion.votes)),
146:       cell(suggestion.approved ? 'Yes' : 'No'),
147:       cell(suggestion.createdAt),
148:       cell(suggestion.updatedAt)
149:     );
150: 
151:     const actions = document.createElement('td');
152:     actions.className = 'border border-line p-2';
153: 
154:     const toggle = document.createElement('button');
155:     toggle.type = 'button';
156:     toggle.textContent = suggestion.approved ? 'Hide' : 'Approve';
157:     toggle.className =
158:       'mr-2 rounded-sharp border border-primary bg-primary px-2 py-1 text-xs text-primaryContrast';
159:     toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
160:       setApproved(suggestion.slug, !suggestion.approved);
161:     });
162: 
163:     const remove = document.createElement('button');
164:     remove.type = 'button';
165:     remove.textContent = 'Remove';
166:     remove.className = 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-xs text-text';
167:     remove.addEventListener('click', () => {
168:       if (window.confirm(`Remove ${suggestion.name}?`)) {
169:         removeSuggestion(suggestion.slug);
170:       }
171:     });
172: 
173:     actions.append(toggle, remove);
174:     row.append(actions);
175:     bodyEl.append(row);
176:   }
177: }
178: 
179: /**
180:  * Set the live status message for the roast panel.
181:  * @param {string} message
182:  * @returns {void}
183:  */
184: function setRoastStatus(message) {
185:   if (roastStatusEl) roastStatusEl.textContent = message || '';
186: }
187: 
188: /**
189:  * Build one editable roast submission item.
190:  * @param {Record<string, string>} submission
191:  * @returns {HTMLElement}
192:  */
193: function buildRoastItem(submission) {
194:   const wrap = createElement('article', {
195:     className: 'mt-4 rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surfaceRaised p-4',
196:   });
197: 
198:   const heading = createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2' });
199:   heading.append(
200:     createElement('p', {
201:       className: 'font-display text-lg uppercase text-text',
202:       text: submission.headline || '(no headline)',
203:     }),
204:     createElement('span', {
205:       className:
206:         'rounded-pill border border-line px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-textMuted',
207:       text: submission.status || 'unknown',
208:     })
209:   );
210:   wrap.append(heading);
211: 
212:   /** @type {Record<string, HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>} */
213:   const fieldInputs = {};
214:   const fieldDefs = [
215:     ['clubId', 'Club'],
216:     ['category', 'Category'],
217:     ['headline', 'The joke'],
218:     ['explanation', 'The facts'],
219:     ['claim', 'The claim'],
220:     ['period', 'Period'],
221:     ['sourceName', 'Source name'],
222:     ['sourceUrl', 'Source link'],
223:   ];
224: 
225:   for (const [key, label] of fieldDefs) {
226:     const fieldId = `roastField_${submission.id}_${key}`;
227:     const group = createElement('div', { className: 'mt-2' });
228:     group.append(
229:       createElement('label', {
230:         className: 'tokenLabel block',
231:         text: label,
232:         attrs: { for: fieldId },
233:       })
234:     );
235:     const isMultiline = key === 'explanation' || key === 'claim';
236:     const input = createElement(isMultiline ? 'textarea' : 'input', {
237:       className:
238:         'mt-1 w-full rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-sm text-text focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent',
239:       attrs: isMultiline
240:         ? { id: fieldId, rows: '3' }
241:         : { id: fieldId, type: 'text' },
242:     });
243:     if (input instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement || input instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
244:       input.value = submission[key] || '';
245:     }
246:     fieldInputs[key] = input;
247:     group.append(input);
248:     wrap.append(group);
249:   }
250: 
251:   const sourceLinkRow = createElement('p', { className: 'mt-2 text-xs' });
252:   sourceLinkRow.append(
253:     createElement('span', { text: 'Open source: ' }),
254:     createElement('a', {
255:       className: 'text-accent underline',
256:       text: submission.sourceUrl || '(none)',
257:       attrs: {
258:         href: submission.sourceUrl || '#',
259:         target: '_blank',
260:         rel: 'noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc',
261:       },
262:     })
263:   );
264:   wrap.append(sourceLinkRow);
265: 
266:   wrap.append(
267:     createElement('p', {
268:       className: 'mt-2 text-xs text-textMuted',
269:       text: `Created ${submission.createdAt || ''} · Updated ${submission.updatedAt || ''}`,
270:     })
271:   );
272:   if (submission.verifiedOn) {
273:     wrap.append(
274:       createElement('p', {
275:         className: 'text-xs text-textMuted',
276:         text: `Verified ${submission.verifiedOn}`,
277:       })
278:     );
279:   }
280: 
281:   const checkboxId = `roastChecked_${submission.id}`;
282:   const checkboxRow = createElement('div', { className: 'mt-3 flex items-center gap-2' });
283:   const checkbox = createElement('input', {
284:     attrs: { id: checkboxId, type: 'checkbox' },
285:   });
286:   const checkboxLabel = createElement('label', {
287:     text: 'I checked the source',
288:     attrs: { for: checkboxId },
289:   });
290:   checkboxRow.append(checkbox, checkboxLabel);
291:   wrap.append(checkboxRow);
292: 
293:   const actions = createElement('div', { className: 'mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2' });
294:   const saveBtn = createElement('button', {
295:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-1 text-sm',
296:     text: 'Save edits',
297:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
298:   });
299:   const approveBtn = createElement('button', {
300:     className:
301:       'rounded-sharp border border-primary bg-primary px-3 py-1 text-sm text-primaryContrast disabled:opacity-60',
302:     text: 'Approve',
303:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
304:   });
305:   const rejectBtn = createElement('button', {
306:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-1 text-sm',
307:     text: 'Reject',
308:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
309:   });
310:   const removeBtn = createElement('button', {
311:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-1 text-sm',
312:     text: 'Remove',
313:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
314:   });
315: 
316:   approveBtn.disabled = true;
317:   checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
318:     if (checkbox instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
319:       approveBtn.disabled = !checkbox.checked;
320:     }
321:   });
322: 
323:   const localStatus = createElement('p', {
324:     className: 'mt-2 text-xs text-accent',
325:     attrs: { role: 'status', 'aria-live': 'polite' },
326:   });
327: 
328:   /**
329:    * @param {string} msg
330:    * @returns {void}
331:    */
332:   const setLocalStatus = (msg) => {
333:     localStatus.textContent = msg || '';
334:   };
335: 
336:   saveBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
337:     setLocalStatus('Saving.');
338:     const body = {
339:       id: submission.id,
340:       clubId: fieldInputs.clubId ? fieldInputs.clubId.value : '',
341:       category: fieldInputs.category ? fieldInputs.category.value : '',
342:       headline: fieldInputs.headline ? fieldInputs.headline.value : '',
343:       explanation: fieldInputs.explanation ? fieldInputs.explanation.value : '',
344:       claim: fieldInputs.claim ? fieldInputs.claim.value : '',
345:       period: fieldInputs.period ? fieldInputs.period.value : '',
346:       sourceName: fieldInputs.sourceName ? fieldInputs.sourceName.value : '',
347:       sourceUrl: fieldInputs.sourceUrl ? fieldInputs.sourceUrl.value : '',
348:     };
349:     const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/roast_submissions/update', {
350:       method: 'POST',
351:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
352:       body: JSON.stringify(body),
353:     });
354:     if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
355:       setLocalStatus('Could not save.');
356:       return;
357:     }
358:     setLocalStatus('Saved.');
359:     await loadRoastSubmissions();
360:   });
361: 
362:   approveBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
363:     setLocalStatus('Approving.');
364:     const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/roast_submissions/approve', {
365:       method: 'POST',
366:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
367:       body: JSON.stringify({ id: submission.id, checkedSource: true }),
368:     });
369:     if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
370:       setLocalStatus('Could not approve.');
371:       return;
372:     }
373:     setLocalStatus('Approved.');
374:     await loadRoastSubmissions();
375:   });
376: 
377:   rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
378:     setLocalStatus('Rejecting.');
379:     const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/roast_submissions/reject', {
380:       method: 'POST',
381:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
382:       body: JSON.stringify({ id: submission.id }),
383:     });
384:     if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
385:       setLocalStatus('Could not reject.');
386:       return;
387:     }
388:     setLocalStatus('Rejected.');
389:     await loadRoastSubmissions();
390:   });
391: 
392:   removeBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
393:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove ${submission.headline || submission.id}?`)) return;
394:     setLocalStatus('Removing.');
395:     const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/roast_submissions/remove', {
396:       method: 'POST',
397:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
398:       body: JSON.stringify({ id: submission.id }),
399:     });
400:     if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
401:       setLocalStatus('Could not remove.');
402:       return;
403:     }
404:     setLocalStatus('Removed.');
405:     await loadRoastSubmissions();
406:   });
407: 
408:   actions.append(saveBtn, approveBtn, rejectBtn, removeBtn);
409:   wrap.append(actions, localStatus);
410: 
411:   return wrap;
412: }
413: 
414: /**
415:  * Load every roast submission from the Worker and render the roast panel.
416:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
417:  */
418: async function loadRoastSubmissions() {
419:   if (!roastBodyEl) return;
420:   setRoastStatus('Loading roast submissions.');
421:   const result = await adminFetch('/api/admin/roast_submissions', { method: 'GET' });
422:   if (!result.ok || !result.response || !result.response.ok) {
423:     setRoastStatus('Could not load roast submissions. Check the token and try again.');
424:     return;
425:   }
426:   let data = null;
427:   try {
428:     data = await result.response.json();
429:   } catch {
430:     data = null;
431:   }
432:   if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.submissions)) {
433:     setRoastStatus('Could not load roast submissions.');
434:     return;
435:   }
436:   clear(roastBodyEl);
437:   let pending = 0;
438:   for (const submission of data.submissions) {
439:     if (submission.status === 'pending') pending += 1;
440:     roastBodyEl.append(buildRoastItem(submission));
441:   }
442:   if (roastPendingCountEl) roastPendingCountEl.textContent = String(pending);
443:   setRoastStatus(`${data.submissions.length} roast submissions loaded. ${pending} pending.`);
444: }
445: 
446: if (formEl) {
447:   formEl.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
448:     event.preventDefault();
449:     if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) {
450:       setStatus('SUGGEST_API_BASE is empty. Set it to the deployed Worker URL first.');
451:       return;
452:     }
453:     adminToken = tokenEl && typeof tokenEl.value === 'string' ? tokenEl.value : '';
454:     if (!adminToken) {
455:       setStatus('Enter the admin token first.');
456:       return;
457:     }
458:     loadSuggestions();
459:     loadRoastSubmissions();
460:   });
461: }

================
File: js/ui/reveal.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Reveal animation for a roast card.
 3:  * Runs a short slot machine style reel on the headline, then fades the facts,
 4:  * receipts and verified line in. Under prefers reduced motion everything is
 5:  * skipped and the roast appears immediately.
 6:  */
 7: 
 8: import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 9: 
10: const REEL_DURATION_MS = 600;
11: const REEL_INTERVAL_MS = 80;
12: 
13: /**
14:  * Reveal a roast inside an already mounted card.
15:  *
16:  * The headline cycles through random entries from the pool for about 600 ms
17:  * with aria hidden set so screen readers do not narrate the churn. When the
18:  * reel settles, the final headline is written, aria hidden is removed, and the
19:  * hidden elements are shown by adding the isVisible class.
20:  *
21:  * @param {{
22:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
23:  *   finalHeadline: string,
24:  *   reelPool: string[],
25:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
26:  * }} options
27:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
28:  */
29: export async function revealRoast(options) {
30:   const { headlineElement, finalHeadline, reelPool, hiddenElements, forceAnimate } = options;
31: 
32:   if (!headlineElement) return;
33: 
34:   const hidden = Array.isArray(hiddenElements) ? hiddenElements.filter(Boolean) : [];
35:   const pool = Array.isArray(reelPool) ? reelPool : [];
36: 
37:   const finish = () => {
38:     headlineElement.textContent = finalHeadline;
39:     for (const el of hidden) {
40:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
41:     }
42:   };
43: 
44:   if (pool.length < 2 || (prefersReducedMotion() && !forceAnimate)) {
45:     finish();
46:     return;
47:   }
48: 
49:   headlineElement.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
50:   headlineElement.textContent = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
51: 
52:   const start = Date.now();
53: 
54:   await new Promise((resolve) => {
55:     const tick = () => {
56:       const elapsed = Date.now() - start;
57:       if (elapsed >= REEL_DURATION_MS) {
58:         resolve();
59:         return;
60:       }
61:       const pick = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
62:       headlineElement.textContent = pick;
63:       window.setTimeout(tick, REEL_INTERVAL_MS);
64:     };
65:     tick();
66:   });
67: 
68:   headlineElement.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
69:   finish();
70: }

File: worker/src/logic.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Pure logic for The Roast Room suggestions Worker.
  3:  * No Cloudflare APIs, no fetch, no KV. Everything here runs unchanged in the
  4:  * Worker and in the Node test runner.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: export const BOARD_KEY = 'board';
  8: export const BOARD_VERSION = 1;
  9: export const MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 300;
 10: export const RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY = 6;
 11: export const RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS = 172800;
 12: export const RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH = 32;
 13: export const NAME_MIN_LENGTH = 2;
 14: export const NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 40;
 15: export const BODY_LIMIT_BYTES = 2048;
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Normalise a raw club name. Trim and collapse runs of whitespace to a single
 19:  * space. Anything that is not a string becomes an empty string.
 20:  * @param {unknown} raw
 21:  * @returns {string}
 22:  */
 23: export function normaliseName(raw) {
 24:   if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
 25:   return raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
 26: }
 27: 
 28: /**
 29:  * Validate a club name against the published rules.
 30:  * Allowed characters are letters in any language, digits, spaces, apostrophe,
 31:  * full stop and ampersand. Urls, the at sign and digits only are rejected.
 32:  * @param {unknown} raw
 33:  * @returns {{ valid: boolean, errors: string[], name: string }}
 34:  */
 35: export function validateName(raw) {
 36:   const name = normaliseName(raw);
 37:   const errors = [];
 38: 
 39:   if (name.length < NAME_MIN_LENGTH) {
 40:     errors.push(`name must be at least ${NAME_MIN_LENGTH} characters`);
 41:   }
 42:   if (name.length > NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
 43:     errors.push(`name must be ${NAME_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   const lower = name.toLowerCase();
 47:   if (lower.includes('http')) errors.push('name cannot contain a url');
 48:   if (lower.includes('www')) errors.push('name cannot contain a url');
 49:   if (name.includes('@')) errors.push('name cannot contain an at sign');
 50:   if (name.length > 0 && /^[0-9]+$/.test(name)) {
 51:     errors.push('name cannot be digits only');
 52:   }
 53:   if (name.length > 0 && !/^[\p{L}0-9 .'&]+$/u.test(name)) {
 54:     errors.push('name contains disallowed characters');
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, name };
 58: }
 59: 
 60: /**
 61:  * Slugify a normalised name. Output is lowercase a to z, digits and
 62:  * underscores only. Accented letters are stripped of diacritics first so
 63:  * Atlético becomes atletico. Anything that cannot be turned into a slug
 64:  * becomes an empty string, which the caller treats as a validation error.
 65:  * @param {unknown} name
 66:  * @returns {string}
 67:  */
 68: export function slugify(name) {
 69:   return String(name === undefined || name === null ? '' : name)
 70:     .normalize('NFD')
 71:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
 72:     .toLowerCase()
 73:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
 74:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * Read a rate record safely. Missing or malformed records become empty.
 79:  * @param {unknown} record
 80:  * @returns {{ actions: number, voted: string[], roasts: number }}
 81:  */
 82: export function normaliseRateRecord(record) {
 83:   if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
 84:     return { actions: 0, voted: [], roasts: 0 };
 85:   }
 86:   const actions = Number.isInteger(record.actions) && record.actions >= 0 ? record.actions : 0;
 87:   const voted = Array.isArray(record.voted)
 88:     ? record.voted.filter((entry) => typeof entry === 'string')
 89:     : [];
 90:   const roasts = Number.isInteger(record.roasts) && record.roasts >= 0 ? record.roasts : 0;
 91:   return { actions, voted, roasts };
 92: }
 93: 
 94: /**
 95:  * Read a board safely. Missing or malformed boards become empty boards.
 96:  * @param {unknown} board
 97:  * @returns {{ version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> }}
 98:  */
 99: export function normaliseBoard(board) {
100:   if (
101:     !board ||
102:     typeof board !== 'object' ||
103:     !board.suggestions ||
104:     typeof board.suggestions !== 'object' ||
105:     Array.isArray(board.suggestions)
106:   ) {
107:     return { version: BOARD_VERSION, suggestions: {} };
108:   }
109:   return { version: BOARD_VERSION, suggestions: board.suggestions };
110: }
111: 
112: /**
113:  * Count the suggestions in a board.
114:  * @param {unknown} board
115:  * @returns {number}
116:  */
117: export function countSuggestions(board) {
118:   return Object.keys(normaliseBoard(board).suggestions).length;
119: }
120: 
121: /**
122:  * Decide whether a client can perform another action today.
123:  * @param {{ actions: number }} record
124:  * @returns {{ allowed: boolean, reason: string }}
125:  */
126: export function canAct(record) {
127:   const safe = normaliseRateRecord(record);
128:   if (safe.actions >= RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY) {
129:     return { allowed: false, reason: 'rateLimited' };
130:   }
131:   return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
132: }
133: 
134: /**
135:  * Decide whether a client can vote for a slug today.
136:  * @param {{ voted: string[] }} record
137:  * @param {string} slug
138:  * @returns {{ allowed: boolean, reason: string }}
139:  */
140: export function canVote(record, slug) {
141:   const safe = normaliseRateRecord(record);
142:   if (safe.voted.includes(slug)) {
143:     return { allowed: false, reason: 'alreadyVoted' };
144:   }
145:   return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
146: }
147: 
148: /**
149:  * Apply a suggestion. A slug that already exists merges into a vote on the
150:  * existing record. A brand new slug creates a pending suggestion and counts
151:  * the submitter as the first vote. Returns the new board and rate record so
152:  * the caller can perform exactly two KV writes when the outcome is accepted.
153:  * @param {{
154:  *   board: unknown,
155:  *   name: unknown,
156:  *   rateRecord: unknown,
157:  *   now: string
158:  * }} options
159:  * @returns {{
160:  *   outcome: 'voted' | 'pending' | 'full' | 'invalid' | 'rateLimited',
161:  *   board: { version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> },
162:  *   rateRecord: { actions: number, voted: string[] },
163:  *   slug: string,
164:  *   errors: string[]
165:  * }}
166:  */
167: export function applySuggestion(options) {
168:   const { board, name, rateRecord, now } = options || {};
169:   const safeBoard = normaliseBoard(board);
170:   const safeRate = normaliseRateRecord(rateRecord);
171: 
172:   const validation = validateName(name);
173:   if (!validation.valid) {
174:     return {
175:       outcome: 'invalid',
176:       board: safeBoard,
177:       rateRecord: safeRate,
178:       slug: '',
179:       errors: validation.errors,
180:     };
181:   }
182: 
183:   const slug = slugify(validation.name);
184:   if (!slug) {
185:     return {
186:       outcome: 'invalid',
187:       board: safeBoard,
188:       rateRecord: safeRate,
189:       slug: '',
190:       errors: ['name cannot be turned into a slug'],
191:     };
192:   }
193: 
194:   if (!canAct(safeRate).allowed) {
195:     return {
196:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
197:       board: safeBoard,
198:       rateRecord: safeRate,
199:       slug,
200:       errors: ['You have reached the daily limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
201:     };
202:   }
203: 
204:   // Vote path: the slug already exists.
205:   const existing = safeBoard.suggestions[slug];
206:   if (existing) {
207:     if (!canVote(safeRate, slug).allowed) {
208:       return {
209:         outcome: 'rateLimited',
210:         board: safeBoard,
211:         rateRecord: safeRate,
212:         slug,
213:         errors: ['You have already voted for this club today.'],
214:       };
215:     }
216:     const nextBoard = {
217:       version: safeBoard.version,
218:       suggestions: {
219:         ...safeBoard.suggestions,
220:         [slug]: {
221:           ...existing,
222:           votes: (Number.isInteger(existing.votes) ? existing.votes : 0) + 1,
223:           updatedAt: now,
224:         },
225:       },
226:     };
227:     const nextRate = {
228:       actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
229:       voted: safeRate.voted.concat(slug),
230:       roasts: safeRate.roasts,
231:     };
232:     return { outcome: 'voted', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, slug, errors: [] };
233:   }
234: 
235:   // New suggestion path.
236:   if (countSuggestions(safeBoard) >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS) {
237:     return {
238:       outcome: 'full',
239:       board: safeBoard,
240:       rateRecord: safeRate,
241:       slug,
242:       errors: ['The suggestion list is full right now.'],
243:     };
244:   }
245: 
246:   const nextBoard = {
247:     version: safeBoard.version,
248:     suggestions: {
249:       ...safeBoard.suggestions,
250:       [slug]: {
251:         name: validation.name,
252:         votes: 1,
253:         approved: false,
254:         createdAt: now,
255:         updatedAt: now,
256:       },
257:     },
258:   };
259:   const nextRate = {
260:     actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
261:     voted: safeRate.voted.concat(slug),
262:   };
263:   return { outcome: 'pending', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, slug, errors: [] };
264: }
265: 
266: /**
267:  * Apply a vote to an existing approved suggestion.
268:  * @param {{
269:  *   board: unknown,
270:  *   slug: unknown,
271:  *   rateRecord: unknown,
272:  *   now: string
273:  * }} options
274:  * @returns {{
275:  *   outcome: 'voted' | 'notFound' | 'notApproved' | 'rateLimited',
276:  *   board: { version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> },
277:  *   rateRecord: { actions: number, voted: string[] },
278:  *   errors: string[]
279:  * }}
280:  */
281: export function applyVote(options) {
282:   const { board, slug, rateRecord, now } = options || {};
283:   const safeBoard = normaliseBoard(board);
284:   const safeRate = normaliseRateRecord(rateRecord);
285:   const safeSlug = typeof slug === 'string' ? slug : '';
286: 
287:   if (!safeSlug || !safeBoard.suggestions[safeSlug]) {
288:     return {
289:       outcome: 'notFound',
290:       board: safeBoard,
291:       rateRecord: safeRate,
292:       errors: ['That suggestion is not available.'],
293:     };
294:   }
295: 
296:   const existing = safeBoard.suggestions[safeSlug];
297:   if (!existing.approved) {
298:     return {
299:       outcome: 'notApproved',
300:       board: safeBoard,
301:       rateRecord: safeRate,
302:       errors: ['That suggestion is not approved yet.'],
303:     };
304:   }
305: 
306:   if (!canAct(safeRate).allowed) {
307:     return {
308:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
309:       board: safeBoard,
310:       rateRecord: safeRate,
311:       errors: ['You have reached the daily limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
312:     };
313:   }
314: 
315:   if (!canVote(safeRate, safeSlug).allowed) {
316:     return {
317:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
318:       board: safeBoard,
319:       rateRecord: safeRate,
320:       errors: ['You have already voted for this club today.'],
321:     };
322:   }
323: 
324:   const nextBoard = {
325:     version: safeBoard.version,
326:     suggestions: {
327:       ...safeBoard.suggestions,
328:       [safeSlug]: {
329:         ...existing,
330:         votes: (Number.isInteger(existing.votes) ? existing.votes : 0) + 1,
331:         updatedAt: now,
332:       },
333:     },
334:   };
335:   const nextRate = {
336:     actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
337:     voted: safeRate.voted.concat(safeSlug),
338:     roasts: safeRate.roasts,
339:   };
340:   return { outcome: 'voted', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, errors: [] };
341: }
342: 
343: /**
344:  * Build the public leaderboard. Approved suggestions only, sorted by votes
345:  * descending then name ascending. Timestamps are stripped.
346:  * @param {unknown} board
347:  * @returns {{ suggestions: Array<{ slug: string, name: string, votes: number }> }}
348:  */
349: export function publicView(board) {
350:   const safe = normaliseBoard(board);
351:   const suggestions = Object.entries(safe.suggestions)
352:     .filter(([, value]) => value && value.approved === true)
353:     .map(([slug, value]) => ({
354:       slug,
355:       name: String(value.name || ''),
356:       votes: Number.isInteger(value.votes) ? value.votes : 0,
357:     }));
358:   suggestions.sort((a, b) => {
359:     if (b.votes !== a.votes) return b.votes - a.votes;
360:     return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
361:   });
362:   return { suggestions };
363: }
364: 
365: /**
366:  * Build the admin view. Every suggestion with timestamps, sorted by votes
367:  * descending then name ascending.
368:  * @param {unknown} board
369:  * @returns {{ suggestions: Array<{
370:  *   slug: string, name: string, votes: number, approved: boolean,
371:  *   createdAt: string, updatedAt: string
372:  * }> }}
373:  */
374: export function adminView(board) {
375:   const safe = normaliseBoard(board);
376:   const suggestions = Object.entries(safe.suggestions).map(([slug, value]) => ({
377:     slug,
378:     name: String(value.name || ''),
379:     votes: Number.isInteger(value.votes) ? value.votes : 0,
380:     approved: value.approved === true,
381:     createdAt: String(value.createdAt || ''),
382:     updatedAt: String(value.updatedAt || ''),
383:   }));
384:   suggestions.sort((a, b) => {
385:     if (b.votes !== a.votes) return b.votes - a.votes;
386:     return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
387:   });
388:   return { suggestions };
389: }
390: 
391: /**
392:  * Return the origin when it is in the allowed list, otherwise an empty string.
393:  * Comparison is case sensitive and exact, so trailing slashes matter.
394:  * @param {string} origin
395:  * @param {string} allowedList Comma separated list of allowed origins.
396:  * @returns {string}
397:  */
398: export function pickOrigin(origin, allowedList) {
399:   if (typeof origin !== 'string' || origin.length === 0) return '';
400:   if (typeof allowedList !== 'string' || allowedList.length === 0) return '';
401:   const allowed = allowedList
402:     .split(',')
403:     .map((entry) => entry.trim())
404:     .filter((entry) => entry.length > 0);
405:   return allowed.includes(origin) ? origin : '';
406: }
407: 
408: /**
409:  * Compare two strings in constant time. Returns false when either is not a
410:  * string. Differing lengths return false early, which leaks only the length
411:  * of the admin token, not its content.
412:  * @param {unknown} a
413:  * @param {unknown} b
414:  * @returns {boolean}
415:  */
416: export function constantTimeEquals(a, b) {
417:   if (typeof a !== 'string' || typeof b !== 'string') return false;
418:   if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
419:   let result = 0;
420:   for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 1) {
421:     result |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
422:   }
423:   return result === 0;
424: }

================
File: worker/README.md
================
  1: # Roast Room Suggestions Worker
  2: 
  3: Cloudflare Worker that backs the audience participation section on the
  4: landing page: suggestions and voting. Built with plain JavaScript ES modules
  5: and Workers KV. No frameworks.
  6: 
  7: ## Layout
  8: 
  9: ```text
 10: worker/
 11:   package.json
 12:   wrangler.toml
 13:   src/
 14:     index.js    routing and KV access
 15:     logic.js    pure logic, no Cloudflare APIs
 16:   README.md
 17: ```
 18: 
 19: ## Endpoints
 20: 
 21: All responses are JSON encoded as UTF 8. Errors are shaped `{ error, message }`
 22: with no stack traces.
 23: 
 24: | Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
 25: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 26: | GET | /api/suggestions | none | Public leaderboard. Approved only, sorted by votes then name, cached for 30 seconds. |
 27: | POST | /api/suggestions | origin | Submit a suggestion or merge into a vote. Body `{ name, website }`. |
 28: | POST | /api/votes | origin | Vote for an approved suggestion. Body `{ slug }`. |
 29: | GET | /api/admin/suggestions | Bearer | Every suggestion with timestamps. |
 30: | POST | /api/admin/approve | Bearer | Body `{ slug, approved }`. |
 31: | POST | /api/admin/remove | Bearer | Body `{ slug }`. |
 32: | OPTIONS | any route | none | CORS preflight, 204. |
 33: 
 34: `Bearer` means the `Authorization` header must equal `Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>` and
 35: the token is compared in constant time. A failed comparison returns 401 with
 36: no detail. An unset `ADMIN_TOKEN` rejects every admin request.
 37: 
 38: An unknown route returns 404 JSON.
 39: 
 40: ## Storage
 41: 
 42: Two kinds of key in the `SUGGESTIONS` namespace.
 43: 
 44: - `board` holds
 45:   `{ version: 1, suggestions: { [slug]: { name, votes, approved, createdAt, updatedAt } } }`.
 46:   The board is capped at 300 suggestions. A full board returns a friendly
 47:   message and writes nothing.
 48: - `rl:<hash>:<YYYYMMDD>` holds `{ actions, voted: [slug] }` for one client per
 49:   UTC day, expiring after 172800 seconds (two days). `hash` is the first 32
 50:   hex characters of `SHA-256(HASH_SALT + CF-Connecting-IP)`. The raw IP
 51:   address is never stored and never logged.
 52: 
 53: Limits:
 54: 
 55: - 6 actions per day per client. Suggestions and votes both count as actions.
 56: - One vote per slug per day per client.
 57: - An accepted action performs exactly two KV writes: the rate record and the
 58:   board. A rejected action performs no writes.
 59: 
 60: The Workers KV free plan allows about 1000 writes per day. Because every
 61: accepted action is two writes, that is about 500 accepted actions per day on
 62: the free plan. Plan accordingly.
 63: 
 64: ## Roast submissions
 65: 
 66: Fan roast submissions use a second KV key, `roastboard`, holding
 67: `{ version: 1, submissions: { [id]: { ... } } }`. Ids are `fan_` plus a short
 68: lowercase base 36 string. The board is capped at 200 submissions.
 69: 
 70: Each submission records `status` as `pending`, `approved` or `rejected`. Only
 71: approved submissions are returned by `GET /api/roasts`, and only after the
 72: admin ticked the source check. Approved submissions become roasts that pass
 73: `validateRoast` from `js/schema.js` on the client.
 74: 
 75: Endpoints:
 76: 
 77: | Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
 78: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 79: | POST | /api/roast_submissions | origin | Submit a roast. Body `{ clubId, category, headline, explanation, claim, period, sourceName, sourceUrl, website }`. |
 80: | GET | /api/roasts?club=<id> | none | Approved roasts for one club, cached for 60 seconds. |
 81: | GET | /api/admin/roast_submissions | Bearer | Every submission, pending first. |
 82: | POST | /api/admin/roast_submissions/update | Bearer | Edit the text fields of one submission. |
 83: | POST | /api/admin/roast_submissions/approve | Bearer | Body `{ id, checkedSource: true }`. |
 84: | POST | /api/admin/roast_submissions/reject | Bearer | Body `{ id }`. |
 85: | POST | /api/admin/roast_submissions/remove | Bearer | Body `{ id }`. |
 86: 
 87: Rate limit: at most 2 roast submissions per client per UTC day, and roast
 88: submissions also count toward the existing 6 actions per day limit. An accepted
 89: submission performs exactly two KV writes (rate record and `roastboard`).
 90: 
 91: `LIVE_CLUB_IDS` in `wrangler.toml` is a comma separated list of club ids that
 92: accept submissions. It defaults to `manutd` when unset.
 93: 
 94: ## Consistency
 95: 
 96: KV is eventually consistent. Two simultaneous writes can lose a vote. This is
 97: accepted for stage 4. If exact counts ever matter, replace KV with Durable
 98: Objects. Nothing in this Worker depends on exact counts for correctness.
 99: 
100: ## Origin allow list
101: 
102: `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `wrangler.toml` is a comma separated string of allowed
103: origins. A request that carries an `Origin` header not on the list is rejected
104: with 403 on POST routes and receives no CORS headers on any route. Requests
105: without an `Origin` header, such as `curl`, are allowed; CSRF protection comes
106: from the browser sending an `Origin` header on cross origin POSTs.
107: 
108: ## Name and slug rules
109: 
110: - Trim and collapse runs of whitespace to one space.
111: - 2 to 40 characters.
112: - Allowed characters are letters in any language, digits, spaces, apostrophe,
113:   full stop and ampersand.
114: - Reject anything containing `http`, `www` or an at sign.
115: - Reject digits only.
116: - The slug is lowercase a to z, digits and underscores. Accented letters are
117:   stripped of diacritics first, so `Atlético` becomes `atletico`.
118: 
119: ## Local development
120: 
121: ```bash
122: cd worker
123: npm install
124: npx wrangler login
125: npx wrangler dev
126: ```
127: 
128: `wrangler dev` runs the Worker locally against a development KV namespace.
129: Replace the `id` placeholder in `wrangler.toml` after you create the real
130: namespace.
131: 
132: ## Deployment
133: 
134: 1. `cd worker`
135: 2. `npm install`
136: 3. `npx wrangler login`
137: 4. `npx wrangler kv namespace create SUGGESTIONS`
138:    Copy the `id` from the output and paste it over the placeholder in
139:    `wrangler.toml`.
140: 5. `npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN`
141:    Paste a long random value, for example the output of
142:    `openssl rand -hex 32`. This is the password you type on `adminlab.html`.
143: 6. `npx wrangler secret put HASH_SALT`
144:    Paste another long random value, for example the output of
145:    `openssl rand -hex 32`. This salts the client hash used for rate limiting.
146:    Rotate it only if you accept that rate limits reset for everyone.
147: 7. `npx wrangler deploy`
148:    The output prints the deployed URL, for example
149:    `https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev`.
150: 8. Paste that URL into `js/suggest/suggestConfig.js` as `SUGGEST_API_BASE`.
151: 9. Update `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `wrangler.toml` with your real site origins,
152:    replacing the Netlify placeholder, and run `npx wrangler deploy` again.
153: 
154: ## Manual smoke test
155: 
156: ```bash
157: # Public leaderboard
158: curl -s https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
159: 
160: # Submit a suggestion
161: curl -s -X POST \
162:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
163:   -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" \
164:   -d '{"name":"Arsenal","website":""}' \
165:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
166: 
167: # Vote
168: curl -s -X POST \
169:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
170:   -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" \
171:   -d '{"slug":"arsenal"}' \
172:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/votes
173: 
174: # Admin list
175: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
176:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/admin/suggestions
177: 
178: # Admin approve
179: curl -s -X POST \
180:   -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
181:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
182:   -d '{"slug":"arsenal","approved":true}' \
183:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/admin/approve
184: 
185: # Wrong origin is blocked
186: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST \
187:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
188:   -H "Origin: https://evil.example" \
189:   -d '{"name":"Arsenal","website":""}' \
190:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
191: # Expect 403
192: ```

  1: /**
  2:  * Tailwind reads its colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, z index and motion
  3:  * scales straight from the CSS custom properties in css/tokens.css. That is
  4:  * what lets a club theme swap without a rebuild or a class change.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: const colors = {
  8:   transparent: 'transparent',
  9:   current: 'currentColor',
 10:   inherit: 'inherit',
 11:   white: '#FFFFFF',
 12:   black: '#000000',
 13:   background: 'var(--colorBackground)',
 14:   surface: 'var(--colorSurface)',
 15:   surfaceRaised: 'var(--colorSurfaceRaised)',
 16:   line: 'var(--colorLine)',
 17:   text: 'var(--colorText)',
 18:   textMuted: 'var(--colorTextMuted)',
 19:   primary: 'var(--colorPrimary)',
 20:   primaryContrast: 'var(--colorPrimaryContrast)',
 21:   accent: 'var(--colorAccent)',
 22: };
 23:
