================
File: js/share/renderCard.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Draws a branded roast card with the Canvas 2D API.
  3:  * Colours come from club.theme. No images and no remote assets are used.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import { CARD_FORMATS } from './cardFormats.js';
  7: import { fitText, truncateToWidth } from './textLayout.js';
  8: 
  9: const MARGIN = 72;
 10: const TOP_BAND_HEIGHT = 120;
 11: const FOOTER_HEIGHT = 112;
 12: const PANEL_INSET = 36;
 13: const PANEL_RADIUS = 24;
 14: const NOTCH_RADIUS = 28;
 15: const FONT_DISPLAY = "Anton, 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif";
 16: const FONT_BODY = "Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif";
 17: 
 18: const THEME_VARIABLES = Object.freeze({
 19:   primary: '--colorPrimary',
 20:   primaryContrast: '--colorPrimaryContrast',
 21:   accent: '--colorAccent',
 22:   background: '--colorBackground',
 23:   surface: '--colorSurface',
 24:   surfaceRaised: '--colorSurfaceRaised',
 25:   line: '--colorLine',
 26:   text: '--colorText',
 27:   textMuted: '--colorTextMuted',
 28: });
 29: 
 30: /**
 31:  * Resolve a theme colour from the club theme, then from CSS tokens.
 32:  * @param {Record<string, string>} theme Club theme.
 33:  * @param {string} key Theme key.
 34:  * @returns {string} Colour value or empty string.
 35:  */
 36: function resolveColor(theme, key) {
 37:   const direct = theme && typeof theme[key] === 'string' ? theme[key].trim() : '';
 38:   if (direct.length > 0) return direct;
 39: 
 40:   if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof getComputedStyle === 'function') {
 41:     const variable = THEME_VARIABLES[key];
 42:     if (variable) {
 43:       const value = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(variable).trim();
 44:       if (value.length > 0) return value;
 45:     }
 46:   }
 47: 
 48:   return '';
 49: }
 50: 
 51: /**
 52:  * Wait for Anton and Inter with a short timeout.
 53:  * @param {number} timeoutMs Timeout in milliseconds.
 54:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 55:  */
 56: async function waitForFonts(timeoutMs) {
 57:   if (
 58:     typeof document === 'undefined' ||
 59:     !document.fonts ||
 60:     typeof document.fonts.load !== 'function'
 61:   ) {
 62:     return;
 63:   }
 64: 
 65:   const loads = [];
 66: 
 67:   try {
 68:     loads.push(document.fonts.load('400 64px Anton'));
 69:     loads.push(document.fonts.load('400 32px Inter'));
 70:     loads.push(document.fonts.load('600 32px Inter'));
 71: 
 72:     await Promise.race([
 73:       Promise.allSettled(loads),
 74:       new Promise((resolve) => {
 75:         setTimeout(resolve, timeoutMs || 900);
 76:       }),
 77:     ]);
 78:   } catch {
 79:     // System fonts are used when the font set cannot load.
 80:   }
 81: }
 82: 
 83: /**
 84:  * Draw the low contrast pitch line motif behind the card.
 85:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
 86:  * @param {number} width Canvas width.
 87:  * @param {number} height Canvas height.
 88:  * @param {string} color Stroke colour.
 89:  * @returns {void}
 90:  */
 91: function drawPitchTexture(ctx, width, height, color) {
 92:   if (!color) return;
 93: 
 94:   ctx.save();
 95:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
 96:   ctx.strokeStyle = color;
 97:   ctx.lineWidth = 2;
 98: 
 99:   const pad = 36;
100:   ctx.strokeRect(pad, pad, width - pad * 2, height - pad * 2);
101: 
102:   ctx.beginPath();
103:   ctx.moveTo(width / 2, pad);
104:   ctx.lineTo(width / 2, height - pad);
105:   ctx.stroke();
106: 
107:   ctx.beginPath();
108:   ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, Math.min(width, height) * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
109:   ctx.stroke();
110: 
111:   ctx.beginPath();
112:   ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
113:   ctx.fillStyle = color;
114:   ctx.fill();
115: 
116:   const boxWidth = width * 0.12;
117:   const boxHeight = height * 0.24;
118:   ctx.strokeRect(pad, (height - boxHeight) / 2, boxWidth, boxHeight);
119:   ctx.strokeRect(width - pad - boxWidth, (height - boxHeight) / 2, boxWidth, boxHeight);
120: 
121:   ctx.restore();
122: }
123: 
124: /**
125:  * Trace a rounded rectangle path on the context.
126:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx
127:  * @param {number} x
128:  * @param {number} y
129:  * @param {number} w
130:  * @param {number} h
131:  * @param {number} r
132:  * @returns {void}
133:  */
134: function roundedRectPath(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
135:   const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
136:   ctx.beginPath();
137:   ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
138:   ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
139:   ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius, radius);
140:   ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
141:   ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h, radius);
142:   ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
143:   ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius, radius);
144:   ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
145:   ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + radius, y, radius);
146:   ctx.closePath();
147: }
148: 
149: /**
150:  * Draw the ticket panel that carries the club band, the content and the
151:  * footer.
152:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx
153:  * @param {{ width: number, height: number, safeTop: number, safeBottom: number, theme: Record<string, string> }} options
154:  * @returns {void}
155:  */
156: function drawTicketPanel(ctx, options) {
157:   const { width, height, safeTop, safeBottom, theme } = options;
158:   const surface = resolveColor(theme, 'surface');
159:   const line = resolveColor(theme, 'line');
160: 
161:   const x = PANEL_INSET;
162:   const y = safeTop + PANEL_INSET;
163:   const w = width - PANEL_INSET * 2;
164:   const h = height - safeTop - safeBottom - PANEL_INSET * 2;
165: 
166:   ctx.save();
167:   roundedRectPath(ctx, x, y, w, h, PANEL_RADIUS);
168:   if (surface) {
169:     ctx.fillStyle = surface;
170:     ctx.fill();
171:   }
172:   if (line) {
173:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
174:     ctx.strokeStyle = line;
175:     ctx.stroke();
176:   }
177:   ctx.restore();
178: }
179: 
180: /**
181:  * Draw the top club band inside the panel, clipped to the panel's rounded
182:  * top corners.
183:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
184:  * @param {{
185:  *   width: number,
186:  *   safeTop: number,
187:  *   theme: Record<string, string>,
188:  *   club: Record<string, unknown>,
189:  *   category: Record<string, unknown> | null,
190:  *   panelHeight: number
191:  * }} options Band options.
192:  * @returns {void}
193:  */
194: function drawTopBand(ctx, options) {
195:   const { width, safeTop, theme, club, category, panelHeight } = options;
196:   const primary = resolveColor(theme, 'primary');
197:   const contrast = resolveColor(theme, 'primaryContrast');
198: 
199:   const panelX = PANEL_INSET;
200:   const panelY = safeTop + PANEL_INSET;
201:   const panelWidth = width - PANEL_INSET * 2;
202: 
203:   ctx.save();
204:   roundedRectPath(ctx, panelX, panelY, panelWidth, panelHeight, PANEL_RADIUS);
205:   ctx.clip();
206: 
207:   if (primary) {
208:     ctx.fillStyle = primary;
209:     ctx.fillRect(panelX, panelY, panelWidth, TOP_BAND_HEIGHT);
210:   }
211: 
212:   if (contrast) {
213:     const baseline = panelY + TOP_BAND_HEIGHT / 2;
214:     const maxWidth = (width - MARGIN * 2) / 2 - 24;
215: 
216:     ctx.fillStyle = contrast;
217:     ctx.font = `600 28px ${FONT_BODY}`;
218:     ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
219:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
220: 
221:     const clubName =
222:       club && (club.shortName || club.name) ? String(club.shortName || club.name) : '';
223:     const clubText = clubName.toUpperCase();
224:     const clubLine = truncateToWidth(clubText, maxWidth, (value) => ctx.measureText(value).width);
225:     ctx.fillText(clubLine, MARGIN, baseline);
226: 
227:     const categoryText =
228:       category && category.displayLabel ? String(category.displayLabel).toUpperCase() : '';
229: 
230:     if (categoryText.length > 0) {
231:       ctx.textAlign = 'right';
232:       const categoryLine = truncateToWidth(categoryText, maxWidth, (value) =>
233:         ctx.measureText(value).width
234:       );
235:       ctx.fillText(categoryLine, width - MARGIN, baseline);
236:     }
237:   }
238: 
239:   ctx.restore();
240: }
241: 
242: /**
243:  * Draw a small uppercase label.
244:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
245:  * @param {string} text Label text.
246:  * @param {number} x X position.
247:  * @param {number} y Y position.
248:  * @param {string} color Text colour.
249:  * @returns {void}
250:  */
251: function drawLabel(ctx, text, x, y, color) {
252:   if (!color) return;
253: 
254:   ctx.save();
255:   ctx.fillStyle = color;
256:   ctx.font = `600 24px ${FONT_BODY}`;
257:   ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
258:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
259:   ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
260:   ctx.restore();
261: }
262: 
263: /**
264:  * Draw fitted headline lines.
265:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
266:  * @param {{ fontSize: number, lines: string[] }} fit Fitted text.
267:  * @param {number} top Top position.
268:  * @param {string} color Text colour.
269:  * @returns {void}
270:  */
271: function drawHeadline(ctx, fit, top, color) {
272:   if (!color) return;
273: 
274:   ctx.save();
275:   ctx.fillStyle = color;
276:   ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
277:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
278:   ctx.font = `400 ${fit.fontSize}px ${FONT_DISPLAY}`;
279: 
280:   let y = top;
281:   for (const line of fit.lines) {
282:     ctx.fillText(line, MARGIN, y);
283:     y += fit.fontSize;
284:   }
285: 
286:   ctx.restore();
287: }
288: 
289: /**
290:  * Draw fitted explanation lines.
291:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
292:  * @param {{ fontSize: number, lines: string[] }} fit Fitted text.
293:  * @param {number} top Top position.
294:  * @param {string} color Text colour.
295:  * @returns {void}
296:  */
297: function drawExplanation(ctx, fit, top, color) {
298:   if (!color) return;
299: 
300:   ctx.save();
301:   ctx.fillStyle = color;
302:   ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
303:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
304:   ctx.font = `400 ${fit.fontSize}px ${FONT_BODY}`;
305: 
306:   let y = top;
307:   for (const line of fit.lines) {
308:     ctx.fillText(line, MARGIN, y);
309:     y += fit.fontSize * 1.35;
310:   }
311: 
312:   ctx.restore();
313: }
314: 
315: /**
316:  * Draw the dashed perforation and the two punched notches at the panel edges.
317:  * The notches are cut with the page background colour and outlined with the
318:  * line colour so they read as real holes.
319:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
320:  * @param {number} width Canvas width.
321:  * @param {number} y Perforation y position.
322:  * @param {Record<string, string>} theme Club theme.
323:  * @returns {void}
324:  */
325: function drawPerforation(ctx, width, y, theme) {
326:   const line = resolveColor(theme, 'line');
327:   const background = resolveColor(theme, 'background');
328: 
329:   const panelLeft = PANEL_INSET;
330:   const panelRight = width - PANEL_INSET;
331: 
332:   if (line) {
333:     ctx.save();
334:     ctx.strokeStyle = line;
335:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
336:     ctx.setLineDash([16, 12]);
337:     ctx.beginPath();
338:     ctx.moveTo(panelLeft, y);
339:     ctx.lineTo(panelRight, y);
340:     ctx.stroke();
341:     ctx.restore();
342:   }
343: 
344:   if (background) {
345:     ctx.save();
346:     ctx.beginPath();
347:     ctx.arc(panelLeft, y, NOTCH_RADIUS, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
348:     ctx.closePath();
349:     ctx.fillStyle = background;
350:     ctx.fill();
351:     if (line) {
352:       ctx.strokeStyle = line;
353:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
354:       ctx.stroke();
355:     }
356:     ctx.restore();
357: 
358:     ctx.save();
359:     ctx.beginPath();
360:     ctx.arc(panelRight, y, NOTCH_RADIUS, Math.PI / 2, (3 * Math.PI) / 2);
361:     ctx.closePath();
362:     ctx.fillStyle = background;
363:     ctx.fill();
364:     if (line) {
365:       ctx.strokeStyle = line;
366:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
367:       ctx.stroke();
368:     }
369:     ctx.restore();
370:   }
371: }
372: 
373: /**
374:  * Read the hostname from an evidence source URL.
375:  * @param {{ sourceUrl?: string } | null} evidence Evidence item.
376:  * @returns {string} Hostname or empty string.
377:  */
378: function sourceHost(evidence) {
379:   if (!evidence || typeof evidence.sourceUrl !== 'string') return '';
380:   try {
381:     return new URL(evidence.sourceUrl).hostname;
382:   } catch {
383:     return '';
384:   }
385: }
386: 
387: /**
388:  * Draw the source line and hostname.
389:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
390:  * @param {{ sourceName?: string, period?: string, sourceUrl?: string } | null} evidence First evidence item.
391:  * @param {number} top Top position.
392:  * @param {number} width Canvas width.
393:  * @param {Record<string, string>} theme Club theme.
394:  * @returns {void}
395:  */
396: function drawSource(ctx, evidence, top, width, theme) {
397:   const muted = resolveColor(theme, 'textMuted');
398:   if (!evidence || !muted) return;
399: 
400:   ctx.save();
401:   ctx.fillStyle = muted;
402:   ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
403:   ctx.textAlign = 'left';
404: 
405:   ctx.font = `600 26px ${FONT_BODY}`;
406:   const sourceText = `Source: ${String(evidence.sourceName || '')}, ${String(
407:     evidence.period || ''
408:   )}`;
409:   const sourceLine = truncateToWidth(sourceText, width - MARGIN * 2, (value) =>
410:     ctx.measureText(value).width
411:   );
412:   ctx.fillText(sourceLine, MARGIN, top);
413: 
414:   const host = sourceHost(evidence);
415:   if (host.length > 0) {
416:     ctx.font = `400 22px ${FONT_BODY}`;
417:     const hostLine = truncateToWidth(host, width - MARGIN * 2, (value) =>
418:       ctx.measureText(value).width
419:     );
420:     ctx.fillText(hostLine, MARGIN, top + 38);
421:   }
422: 
423:   ctx.restore();
424: }
425: 
426: /**
427:  * Draw the footer wordmark, host and checked date.
428:  * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx Canvas context.
429:  * @param {{
430:  *   width: number,
431:  *   top: number,
432:  *   theme: Record<string, string>,
433:  *   host: string,
434:  *   verifiedOn: string
435:  * }} options Footer options.
436:  * @returns {void}
437:  */
438: function drawFooter(ctx, options) {
439:   const { width, top, theme, host, verifiedOn } = options;
440:   const text = resolveColor(theme, 'text');
441:   const muted = resolveColor(theme, 'textMuted');
442: 
443:   if (text) {
444:     ctx.save();
445:     ctx.fillStyle = text;
446:     ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
447:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
448:     ctx.font = `400 42px ${FONT_DISPLAY}`;
449:     ctx.fillText('THE ROAST ROOM', MARGIN, top);
450:     ctx.restore();
451:   }
452: 
453:   if (muted) {
454:     ctx.save();
455:     ctx.fillStyle = muted;
456:     ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
457: 
458:     ctx.textAlign = 'right';
459:     ctx.font = `600 24px ${FONT_BODY}`;
460:     const hostText = truncateToWidth(String(host || ''), width * 0.4, (value) =>
461:       ctx.measureText(value).width
462:     );
463:     ctx.fillText(hostText, width - MARGIN, top + 8);
464: 
465:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
466:     ctx.font = `400 22px ${FONT_BODY}`;
467:     const checked = `Checked ${String(verifiedOn || '')}`.trim();
468:     if (checked.length > 0) {
469:       ctx.fillText(checked, MARGIN, top + 56);
470:     }
471: 
472:     ctx.restore();
473:   }
474: }
475: 
476: /**
477:  * Render one roast card into a canvas.
478:  * Never throws. Returns font sizes and whether text was truncated.
479:  * @param {{
480:  *   canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
481:  *   roast: Record<string, unknown>,
482:  *   category: Record<string, unknown> | null,
483:  *   club: Record<string, unknown>,
484:  *   format: { id: string, label: string, width: number, height: number, safeTop: number, safeBottom: number },
485:  *   host: string
486:  * }} options Render options.
487:  * @returns {Promise<{ truncated: boolean, headlineFontSize: number, explanationFontSize: number }>} Render result.
488:  */
489: export async function renderRoastCard(options) {
490:   const fallback = { truncated: true, headlineFontSize: 0, explanationFontSize: 0 };
491: 
492:   try {
493:     const { canvas, roast, category, club, format, host } = options || {};
494: 
495:     if (!canvas || typeof canvas.getContext !== 'function' || !roast) return fallback;
496: 
497:     const chosen =
498:       format && Number.isFinite(format.width) && Number.isFinite(format.height)
499:         ? format
500:         : CARD_FORMATS.post;
501: 
502:     canvas.width = chosen.width;
503:     canvas.height = chosen.height;
504: 
505:     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
506:     if (!ctx) return fallback;
507: 
508:     await waitForFonts(900);
509: 
510:     const theme = club && club.theme ? club.theme : {};
511:     const background = resolveColor(theme, 'background');
512:     const text = resolveColor(theme, 'text');
513:     const accent = resolveColor(theme, 'accent');
514: 
515:     if (background) {
516:       ctx.fillStyle = background;
517:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, chosen.width, chosen.height);
518:     }
519: 
520:         drawPitchTexture(ctx, chosen.width, chosen.height, text);
521: 
522:         const panelHeight =
523:           chosen.height - chosen.safeTop - chosen.safeBottom - PANEL_INSET * 2;
524:         drawTicketPanel(ctx, {
525:           width: chosen.width,
526:           height: chosen.height,
527:           safeTop: chosen.safeTop,
528:           safeBottom: chosen.safeBottom,
529:           theme,
530:         });
531:         drawTopBand(ctx, {
532:           width: chosen.width,
533:           safeTop: chosen.safeTop,
534:           theme,
535:           club,
536:           category,
537:           panelHeight,
538:         });
539: 
540:     const contentBottom = chosen.height - chosen.safeBottom - MARGIN;
541:     const contentTop = chosen.safeTop + TOP_BAND_HEIGHT + 48;
542: 
543:     drawLabel(ctx, 'THE JOKE', MARGIN, contentTop, accent);
544: 
545:     const headlineTop = contentTop + 48;
546:     const headlineBoxHeight = chosen.height * (chosen.id === 'story' ? 0.28 : 0.38);
547:     const measureAnton = (value, size) => {
548:       ctx.font = `400 ${size}px ${FONT_DISPLAY}`;
549:       return ctx.measureText(value).width;
550:     };
551: 
552:     const headlineFit = fitText({
553:       text: String(roast.headline || '').toUpperCase(),
554:       maxWidth: chosen.width - MARGIN * 2,
555:       maxHeight: headlineBoxHeight,
556:       maxLines: 8,
557:       minFontSize: 64,
558:       maxFontSize: 140,
559:       step: 4,
560:       lineHeightRatio: 1,
561:       measure: measureAnton,
562:     });
563: 
564:     drawHeadline(ctx, headlineFit, headlineTop, text);
565: 
566:     const headlineHeight = headlineFit.lines.length * headlineFit.fontSize;
567:     const perforationY = headlineTop + headlineHeight + 48;
568: 
569:     drawPerforation(ctx, chosen.width, perforationY, theme);
570: 
571:     const receiptLabelY = perforationY + 48;
572:     drawLabel(ctx, 'THE RECEIPT', MARGIN, receiptLabelY, accent);
573: 
574:     const footerTop = contentBottom - FOOTER_HEIGHT;
575:     const explanationTop = receiptLabelY + 48;
576:     const sourceReserve = 26 + 12 + 22 + 32;
577:     const explanationMaxHeight = Math.max(60, footerTop - explanationTop - sourceReserve);
578:     const measureInter = (value, size) => {
579:       ctx.font = `400 ${size}px ${FONT_BODY}`;
580:       return ctx.measureText(value).width;
581:     };
582: 
583:     const explanationFit = fitText({
584:       text: String(roast.explanation || ''),
585:       maxWidth: chosen.width - MARGIN * 2,
586:       maxHeight: explanationMaxHeight,
587:       maxLines: 8,
588:       minFontSize: 30,
589:       maxFontSize: 42,
590:       step: 2,
591:       lineHeightRatio: 1.35,
592:       measure: measureInter,
593:     });
594: 
595:     drawExplanation(ctx, explanationFit, explanationTop, text);
596: 
597:     const explanationHeight = explanationFit.lines.length * explanationFit.fontSize * 1.35;
598:     const evidence =
599:       Array.isArray(roast.evidence) && roast.evidence.length > 0 ? roast.evidence[0] : null;
600: 
601:     drawSource(ctx, evidence, explanationTop + explanationHeight + 24, chosen.width, theme);
602: 
603:     drawFooter(ctx, {
604:       width: chosen.width,
605:       top: footerTop,
606:       theme,
607:       host,
608:       verifiedOn: roast.verifiedOn,
609:     });
610: 
611:     return {
612:       truncated: headlineFit.truncated || explanationFit.truncated,
613:       headlineFontSize: headlineFit.fontSize,
614:       explanationFontSize: explanationFit.fontSize,
615:     };
616:   } catch (error) {
617:     if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && typeof console.warn === 'function') {
618:       console.warn('[roastRoom] could not render the share card', error);
619:     }
620:     return fallback;
621:   }
622: }

================
File: js/ui/roastCard.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the DOM for one roast card. Never uses innerHTML with data, so every
  3:  * piece of evidence is inserted as text or as a safe attribute value.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import { createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Build a roast card element.
 10:  *
 11:  * The headline is left empty on purpose. The caller decides whether to run the
 12:  * reel and set the final headline, or to set it immediately for a deep link.
 13:  * The facts block, the receipts block and the verified line start hidden and
 14:  * are revealed by the reveal helper.
 15:  *
 16:  * @param {import('../schema.js').Roast} roast Roast data.
 17:  * @param {import('../schema.js').ClubCategory | null} category Category the roast belongs to.
 18:  * @returns {{
 19:  *   element: HTMLElement,
 20:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
 21:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
 22:  * }}
 23:  */
 24: export function createRoastCard(roast, category) {
 25:   const card = createElement('article', {
 26:     className: 'roastCard ticketStub',
 27:     attrs: {
 28:       'data-roast-id': roast.id,
 29:       'aria-label': 'Roast',
 30:     },
 31:   });
 32: 
 33:   const categoryLine = createElement('p', {
 34:     className: 'tokenLabel',
 35:   });
 36:   categoryLine.textContent = category
 37:     ? `${category.emoji}  ${category.displayLabel}`
 38:     : 'Roast';
 39:   const isFan = Array.isArray(roast.tags) && roast.tags.includes('fan');
 40:   if (isFan) {
 41:     categoryLine.append(
 42:       document.createTextNode(' '),
 43:       createElement('span', {
 44:         className:
 45:           'ml-2 inline-block rounded-sharp border border-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary',
 46:         text: 'Fan roast',
 47:       })
 48:     );
 49:   }
 50: 
 51:   const jokeLabel = createElement('p', {
 52:     className: 'tokenLabel mt-4',
 53:     text: 'The joke',
 54:   });
 55: 
 56:   const headlineElement = createElement('h2', {
 57:     className: 'roastHeadline mt-2 text-displaySm text-text',
 58:   });
 59: 
 60:   const factsGroup = createElement('div', {
 61:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 62:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'facts' },
 63:   });
 64:   const factsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The facts' });
 65:   const factsText = createElement('p', {
 66:     className: 'mt-2 text-base text-text',
 67:     text: roast.explanation,
 68:   });
 69:   factsGroup.append(factsLabel, factsText);
 70: 
 71:   const receiptsGroup = createElement('div', {
 72:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 73:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'receipts' },
 74:   });
 75:   const receiptsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The receipts' });
 76:   const receiptsList = createElement('ul', { className: 'mt-3 space-y-3' });
 77: 
 78:   for (const evidence of roast.evidence) {
 79:     const item = createElement('li', {
 80:       className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surfaceRaised p-3',
 81:     });
 82: 
 83:     const claimEl = createElement('p', {
 84:       className: 'text-sm text-text',
 85:       text: evidence.claim,
 86:     });
 87: 
 88:     const metaEl = createElement('p', {
 89:       className: 'mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-textMuted',
 90:     });
 91: 
 92:     const periodSpan = createElement('span', { text: `Period ${evidence.period}` });
 93: 
 94:     const sourceLink = createElement('a', {
 95:       className: 'text-accent',
 96:       text: evidence.sourceName,
 97:       attrs: {
 98:         href: evidence.sourceUrl,
 99:         target: '_blank',
100:         rel: 'noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc',
101:       },
102:     });
103: 
104:     const accessedSpan = createElement('span', {
105:       text: `Accessed ${evidence.accessedOn}`,
106:     });
107: 
108:     metaEl.append(periodSpan, sourceLink, accessedSpan);
109:     item.append(claimEl, metaEl);
110:     receiptsList.append(item);
111:   }
112: 
113:   receiptsGroup.append(receiptsLabel, receiptsList);
114: 
115:     const mistakeLink = createElement('p', {
116:     className: 'revealTarget mt-3 text-xs',
117:     children: [
118:       createElement('a', {
119:         className: 'text-textMuted underline hover:text-accent',
120:         text: 'Spot a mistake?',
121:         attrs: { href: './about.html#corrections' },
122:       }),
123:     ],
124:   });
125: 
126:   const verifiedEl = createElement('p', {
127:     className: 'revealTarget mt-4 text-xs text-textMuted',
128:     text: `Checked on ${roast.verifiedOn}`,
129:   });
130: 
131:   card.append(
132:     categoryLine,
133:     jokeLabel,
134:     headlineElement,
135:     factsGroup,
136:     receiptsGroup,
137:     mistakeLink,
138:     verifiedEl
139:   );
140: 
141:   return {
142:     element: card,
143:     headlineElement,
144:     hiddenElements: [factsGroup, receiptsGroup, mistakeLink, verifiedEl],
145:   };
146: }

================
File: scripts/lib/siteTools.mjs
================
  1: import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
  2: import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
  3: import { join } from 'node:path';
  4: 
  5: /**
  6:  * Pure helpers for the site build. No file system, no process access, no
  7:  * fetch. Everything here is deterministic and testable in isolation.
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Escape a value for use as XML text.
 12:  * @param {unknown} value
 13:  * @returns {string}
 14:  */
 15: function escapeXml(value) {
 16:   return String(value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)
 17:     .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
 18:     .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
 19:     .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
 20:     .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
 21:     .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
 22: }
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * Trim and normalise a site URL. Only https URLs and http URLs on localhost
 26:  * or 127.0.0.1 are accepted, so the production build can never publish an
 27:  * insecure origin. A trailing slash is stripped. Invalid input becomes an
 28:  * empty string.
 29:  * @param {string} raw
 30:  * @returns {string}
 31:  */
 32: export function normaliseSiteUrl(raw) {
 33:   if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
 34:   const trimmed = raw.trim();
 35:   if (trimmed.length === 0) return '';
 36: 
 37:   let parsed;
 38:   try {
 39:     parsed = new URL(trimmed);
 40:   } catch {
 41:     return '';
 42:   }
 43: 
 44:   const isHttps = parsed.protocol === 'https:';
 45:   const isLocalhost =
 46:     parsed.protocol === 'http:' &&
 47:     (parsed.hostname === 'localhost' || parsed.hostname === '127.0.0.1');
 48: 
 49:   if (!isHttps && !isLocalhost) return '';
 50: 
 51:   return parsed.href.replace(/\/+$/, '');
 52: }
 53: 
 54: /**
 55:  * Replace every __SITE_URL__ token in a string. When siteUrl is empty the
 56:  * token is replaced with an empty string, so the placeholder can never
 57:  * survive to production. The build is expected to warn in that case.
 58:  * @param {string} html
 59:  * @param {string} siteUrl
 60:  * @returns {string}
 61:  */
 62: export function replaceSiteUrl(html, siteUrl) {
 63:   if (typeof html !== 'string') return '';
 64:   const replacement = typeof siteUrl === 'string' ? siteUrl : '';
 65:   return html.split('__SITE_URL__').join(replacement);
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Return the origin of a URL, or an empty string. Never throws.
 70:  * @param {string} url
 71:  * @returns {string}
 72:  */
 73: export function originOf(url) {
 74:   if (typeof url !== 'string' || url.length === 0) return '';
 75:   try {
 76:     return new URL(url).origin;
 77:   } catch {
 78:     return '';
 79:   }
 80: }
 81: 
 82: /**
 83:  * Recursively collect file paths and contents under a directory. `.DS_Store`
 84:  * is skipped. The output is unsorted; the caller sorts it.
 85:  * @param {string} base Base directory.
 86:  * @param {string} [rel] Current relative subdirectory.
 87:  * @param {Array<{ path: string, content: Buffer }>} [out]
 88:  * @returns {Promise<Array<{ path: string, content: Buffer }>>}
 89:  */
 90: async function collectDirectoryFiles(base, rel = '', out = []) {
 91:   const entries = await readdir(join(base, rel), { withFileTypes: true });
 92:   for (const entry of entries) {
 93:     const relPath = rel ? `${rel}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
 94:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
 95:       await collectDirectoryFiles(base, relPath, out);
 96:     } else if (entry.isFile()) {
 97:       if (entry.name === '.DS_Store') continue;
 98:       const content = await readFile(join(base, relPath));
 99:       out.push({ path: relPath, content });
100:     }
101:   }
102:   return out;
103: }
104: 
105: /**
106:  * Hash every file under a directory into a short hex digest. Both the file
107:  * path and the file content are hashed, and files are sorted first, so the
108:  * digest is deterministic: any change to any file (added, removed, renamed,
109:  * edited) produces a new digest. Suitable as a cache-busting directory
110:  * suffix.
111:  * @param {string} directory
112:  * @returns {Promise<string>} Short hex digest, eight characters.
113:  */
114: export async function hashDirectory(directory) {
115:   const files = await collectDirectoryFiles(directory);
116:   files.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
117:   const hash = createHash('sha256');
118:   for (const file of files) {
119:     hash.update(file.path);
120:     hash.update('\0');
121:     hash.update(file.content);
122:     hash.update('\0');
123:   }
124:   return hash.digest('hex').slice(0, 8);
125: }
126: 
127: /**
128:  * Build a sitemap.xml body.
129:  * @param {{ siteUrl: string, paths: string[] }} options
130:  * @returns {string}
131:  */
132: export function buildSitemap(options) {
133:   const { siteUrl, paths } = options || {};
134:   const safeSite = typeof siteUrl === 'string' ? siteUrl : '';
135:   const list = Array.isArray(paths) ? paths : [];
136: 
137:   const entries = list
138:     .map((path) => `  <url>\n    <loc>${escapeXml(`${safeSite}${path}`)}</loc>\n  </url>`)
139:     .join('\n');
140: 
141:   return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n${entries}\n</urlset>\n`;
142: }
143: 
144: /**
145:  * Build a robots.txt body. The Sitemap line is included only when siteUrl is
146:  * known.
147:  * @param {string} siteUrl
148:  * @returns {string}
149:  */
150: export function buildRobots(siteUrl) {
151:   const safeSite = typeof siteUrl === 'string' ? siteUrl : '';
152:   const lines = ['User-agent: *', 'Allow: /'];
153:   if (safeSite.length > 0) {
154:     lines.push('');
155:     lines.push(`Sitemap: ${safeSite}/sitemap.xml`);
156:   }
157:   return `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
158: }
159: 
160: /**
161:  * Build the contents of a _headers file. The format is shared by Netlify and
162:  * Cloudflare Pages.
163:  *
164:  * style-src carries 'unsafe-inline' because the markup uses inline style
165:  * attributes (for example the hero card and the honeypot wrapper). No
166:  * inline scripts are used and no eval is used, so script-src stays at
167:  * 'self' with no 'unsafe-eval'.
168:  *
169:  * @param {{ workerOrigin: string }} options
170:  * @returns {string}
171:  */
172: export function buildHeaders(options) {
173:   const { workerOrigin } = options || {};
174:   const safeWorker = typeof workerOrigin === 'string' ? workerOrigin.trim() : '';
175: 
176:   const connectSrc = safeWorker.length > 0
177:     ? `connect-src 'self' ${safeWorker}`
178:     : `connect-src 'self'`;
179: 
180:   const csp =
181:     `default-src 'self'; ` +
182:     `script-src 'self'; ` +
183:     `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; ` +
184:     `font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; ` +
185:     `img-src 'self' data:; ` +
186:     `${connectSrc}; ` +
187:     `frame-ancestors 'none'; ` +
188:     `base-uri 'self'; ` +
189:     `form-action 'self'; ` +
190:     `object-src 'none'`;
191: 
192:   return [
193:     '/*',
194:     '  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff',
195:     '  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
196:     '  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()',
197:     '  X-Frame-Options: DENY',
198:     `  Content-Security-Policy: ${csp}`,
199:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
200:     '',
201:     '/js.*',
202:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
203:     '',
204:     '/dist.*',
205:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
206:     '',
207:     '/data/*',
208:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
209:     '',
210:     '/favicon.svg',
211:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400',
212:     '',
213:     '/og.png',
214:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400',
215:     '',
216:     '/apple_touch_icon.png',
217:     '  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400',
218:     '',
219:   ].join('\n');
220: }

================
File: scripts/buildSite.mjs
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Production build for The Roast Room.
  3:  *
  4:  * 1. Compiles the Tailwind CSS into dist/styles.css via npm run css.
  5:  * 2. Copies the public pages, the javascript, the json data, the compiled
  6:  *    styles, the favicon and (when present) the social preview images into
  7:  *    a fresh site/ folder.
  8:  * 3. Excludes the developer pages from the deploy.
  9:  * 4. Replaces every __SITE_URL__ token with the detected site URL.
 10:  * 5. Writes sitemap.xml, robots.txt and _headers.
 11:  * 6. Prints a summary and clear WARNINGS (no failures) for a missing site
 12:  *    URL, a missing og.png or apple_touch_icon.png, or an empty
 13:  *    SUGGEST_API_BASE.
 14:  */
 15: 
 16: import { copyFile, mkdir, readFile, readdir, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
 17: import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
 18: import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
 19: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
 20: 
 21: import { SUGGEST_API_BASE } from '../js/suggest/suggestConfig.js';
 22: import {
 23:   buildHeaders,
 24:   buildRobots,
 25:   buildSitemap,
 26:   hashDirectory,
 27:   normaliseSiteUrl,
 28:   originOf,
 29:   replaceSiteUrl,
 30: } from './lib/siteTools.mjs';
 31: 
 32: const excludedPages = new Set(['tokens.html', 'cardlab.html', 'adminlab.html', 'ogimage.html']);
 33: 
 34: const rootDirectory = resolve(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
 35: const siteDirectory = join(rootDirectory, 'site');
 36: 
 37: /**
 38:  * Run the Tailwind CSS build.
 39:  * @returns {void}
 40:  */
 41: function buildCss() {
 42:   console.log('[build] running npm run css');
 43:   execSync('npm run css', { cwd: rootDirectory, stdio: 'inherit' });
 44: }
 45: 
 46: /**
 47:  * Copy a folder recursively, skipping the given file names.
 48:  * @param {string} source
 49:  * @param {string} destination
 50:  * @param {Set<string>} skip
 51:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
 52:  */
 53: async function copyFolder(source, destination, skip, skipDirs) {
 54:   await mkdir(destination, { recursive: true });
 55:   const entries = await readdir(source, { withFileTypes: true });
 56:   for (const entry of entries) {
 57:     const from = join(source, entry.name);
 58:     const to = join(destination, entry.name);
 59:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
 60:       if (skipDirs && skipDirs.has(entry.name)) continue;
 61:       await copyFolder(from, to, skip, skipDirs);
 62:     } else if (!skip.has(entry.name)) {
 63:       await copyFile(from, to);
 64:     }
 65:   }
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Check whether a file exists.
 70:  * @param {string} path
 71:  * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
 72:  */
 73: async function fileExists(path) {
 74:   try {
 75:     const info = await stat(path);
 76:     return info.isFile();
 77:   } catch {
 78:     return false;
 79:   }
 80: }
 81: 
 82: /**
 83:  * Recursively list files ending in .html inside a folder.
 84:  * @param {string} directory
 85:  * @returns {Promise<string[]>}
 86:  */
 87: async function listHtmlFiles(directory) {
 88:   const results = [];
 89:   const entries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
 90:   for (const entry of entries) {
 91:     const full = join(directory, entry.name);
 92:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
 93:       results.push(...(await listHtmlFiles(full)));
 94:     } else if (entry.name.endsWith('.html')) {
 95:       results.push(full);
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98:   return results;
 99: }
100: 
101: /**
102:  * Main build.
103:  * @returns {Promise<number>} Exit code.
104:  */
105: async function main() {
106:   const warnings = [];
107: 
108:   // 1. CSS build.
109:   buildCss();
110: 
111:   // 2. Site URL from environment.
112:   const rawSiteUrl =
113:     process.env.SITE_URL || process.env.URL || process.env.CF_PAGES_URL || '';
114:   const siteUrl = normaliseSiteUrl(rawSiteUrl);
115:   if (siteUrl.length === 0) {
116:     warnings.push(
117:       'No site URL found (checked SITE_URL, URL and CF_PAGES_URL). Absolute URLs will be empty and sitemap.xml will be skipped.'
118:     );
119:   } else {
120:     console.log(`[build] site URL: ${siteUrl}`);
121:   }
122: 
123:   // 3. Fresh site folder.
124:   await rm(siteDirectory, { recursive: true, force: true });
125:   await mkdir(siteDirectory, { recursive: true });
126: 
127:   // 4. Copy the compiled styles, the scripts, the data.
128:   await copyFolder(join(rootDirectory, 'dist'), join(siteDirectory, 'dist'), new Set());
129:   await copyFolder(
130:     join(rootDirectory, 'js'),
131:     join(siteDirectory, 'js'),
132:     new Set(),
133:     new Set(['dev'])
134:   );
135:   await copyFolder(join(rootDirectory, 'data'), join(siteDirectory, 'data'), new Set());
136: 
137:   // 5. Copy the public pages, skipping the developer pages.
138:   const rootEntries = await readdir(rootDirectory, { withFileTypes: true });
139:   for (const entry of rootEntries) {
140:     if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
141:     if (!entry.name.endsWith('.html')) continue;
142:     if (excludedPages.has(entry.name)) continue;
143:     await copyFile(join(rootDirectory, entry.name), join(siteDirectory, entry.name));
144:   }
145: 
146:   // 6. Copy the static assets.
147:   const faviconSource = join(rootDirectory, 'favicon.svg');
148:   if (await fileExists(faviconSource)) {
149:     await copyFile(faviconSource, join(siteDirectory, 'favicon.svg'));
150:   }
151: 
152:   const ogSource = join(rootDirectory, 'og.png');
153:   if (await fileExists(ogSource)) {
154:     await copyFile(ogSource, join(siteDirectory, 'og.png'));
155:   } else {
156:     warnings.push('og.png not found in the repository root. Social previews will 404.');
157:   }
158: 
159:   const iconSource = join(rootDirectory, 'apple_touch_icon.png');
160:   if (await fileExists(iconSource)) {
161:     await copyFile(iconSource, join(siteDirectory, 'apple_touch_icon.png'));
162:   } else {
163:     warnings.push(
164:       'apple_touch_icon.png not found in the repository root. The apple-touch-icon link will 404.'
165:     );
166:   }
167: 
168:   // 6b. Hash the JS and CSS directories and rename them. Any change to a
169:   // file inside produces a new directory name, so browsers treat the files
170:   // as new assets and fetch them fresh.
171:   const jsHash = await hashDirectory(join(siteDirectory, 'js'));
172:   const distHash = await hashDirectory(join(siteDirectory, 'dist'));
173: 
174:   await rename(join(siteDirectory, 'js'), join(siteDirectory, `js.${jsHash}`));
175:   await rename(join(siteDirectory, 'dist'), join(siteDirectory, `dist.${distHash}`));
176: 
177:   console.log(`[build] js hash: ${jsHash}`);
178:   console.log(`[build] dist hash: ${distHash}`);
179: 
180:   // 7. Replace the __SITE_URL__ token in every HTML file in site/.
181:   const htmlFiles = await listHtmlFiles(siteDirectory);
182:   let survivingTokens = 0;
183:   for (const file of htmlFiles) {
184:     let html = await readFile(file, 'utf8');
185:     html = replaceSiteUrl(html, siteUrl);
186:     html = html.split('js/pages/').join(`js.${jsHash}/pages/`);
187:     html = html.split('dist/styles.css').join(`dist.${distHash}/styles.css`);
188:     await writeFile(file, html, 'utf8');
189:     if (html.includes('__SITE_URL__')) {
190:       survivingTokens += 1;
191:     }
192:   }
193: 
194:   // 8. Read the registry so sitemap.xml lists one room URL per live club.
195:   let liveClubs = [];
196:   try {
197:     const registry = JSON.parse(
198:       await readFile(join(rootDirectory, 'data/clubs.json'), 'utf8')
199:     );
200:     liveClubs = Array.isArray(registry.clubs)
201:       ? registry.clubs.filter((club) => club && club.status === 'live')
202:       : [];
203:   } catch (error) {
204:     warnings.push(`Could not read data/clubs.json for the sitemap: ${String(error.message)}`);
205:   }
206: 
207:   // 9. Write sitemap.xml (only when a site URL is known), robots.txt and _headers.
208:   if (siteUrl.length > 0) {
209:     const paths = ['/', '/about.html'];
210:     for (const club of liveClubs) {
211:       if (typeof club.id === 'string' && club.id.length > 0) {
212:         paths.push(`/room.html?club=${encodeURIComponent(club.id)}`);
213:       }
214:     }
215:     const sitemap = buildSitemap({ siteUrl, paths });
216:     await writeFile(join(siteDirectory, 'sitemap.xml'), sitemap, 'utf8');
217:   }
218: 
219:   const robots = buildRobots(siteUrl);
220:   await writeFile(join(siteDirectory, 'robots.txt'), robots, 'utf8');
221: 
222:   const workerOrigin = SUGGEST_API_BASE ? originOf(SUGGEST_API_BASE) : '';
223:   if (!SUGGEST_API_BASE) {
224:     warnings.push(
225:       'SUGGEST_API_BASE is empty, so the suggestion section is hidden and the Worker origin is not added to connect-src.'
226:     );
227:   }
228: 
229:   const headers = buildHeaders({ workerOrigin });
230:   await writeFile(join(siteDirectory, '_headers'), headers, 'utf8');
231: 
232:   // 10. Fail loudly if any token survived.
233:   if (survivingTokens > 0) {
234:     console.error(
235:       `[build] ${survivingTokens} html file(s) still contain the __SITE_URL__ token. This should not happen.`
236:     );
237:     return 1;
238:   }
239: 
240:   // 11. Summary and warnings.
241:   console.log('');
242:   console.log(`[build] site/ written with ${htmlFiles.length} html file(s).`);
243:   if (siteUrl.length > 0) {
244:     console.log(`[build] sitemap.xml, robots.txt and _headers written for ${siteUrl}`);
245:   } else {
246:     console.log('[build] robots.txt and _headers written, sitemap.xml skipped.');
247:   }
248: 
249:   if (warnings.length > 0) {
250:     console.log('');
251:     console.log('[build] WARNINGS:');
252:     for (const warning of warnings) {
253:       console.log(`  - ${warning}`);
254:     }
255:   }
256: 
257:   return 0;
258: }
259: 
260: const exitCode = await main();
261: process.exitCode = exitCode;

================
File: tests/siteTools.test.mjs
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Tests for the pure build and branding helpers. Node test runner only, no
  3:  * extra dependencies.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import test from 'node:test';
  7: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
  8: import { mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
  9: import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
 10: import { join } from 'node:path';
 11: 
 12: import {
 13:   buildHeaders,
 14:   buildRobots,
 15:   buildSitemap,
 16:   hashDirectory,
 17:   normaliseSiteUrl,
 18:   originOf,
 19:   replaceSiteUrl,
 20: } from '../scripts/lib/siteTools.mjs';
 21: import { frittLink } from '../js/brand/frittLinks.js';
 22: 
 23: test('normaliseSiteUrl accepts https and strips a trailing slash', () => {
 24:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('https://example.com/'), 'https://example.com');
 25:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('https://example.com'), 'https://example.com');
 26: });
 27: 
 28: test('normaliseSiteUrl accepts http on localhost only', () => {
 29:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('http://localhost:3000'), 'http://localhost:3000');
 30:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('http://127.0.0.1:8000'), 'http://127.0.0.1:8000');
 31:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('http://example.com'), '');
 32: });
 33: 
 34: test('normaliseSiteUrl rejects garbage', () => {
 35:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl(''), '');
 36:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('not a url'), '');
 37:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl(null), '');
 38:   assert.equal(normaliseSiteUrl('ftp://example.com'), '');
 39: });
 40: 
 41: test('replaceSiteUrl replaces every occurrence and leaves other text alone', () => {

144: test('hashDirectory returns a stable 8 character hex digest', async () => {
145:   const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'roastroom-hash-'));
146:   try {
147:     await writeFile(join(dir, 'a.js'), 'hello');
148:     await writeFile(join(dir, 'b.js'), 'world');
149:     const h1 = await hashDirectory(dir);
150:     const h2 = await hashDirectory(dir);
151:     assert.match(h1, /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/);
152:     assert.equal(h1, h2);
153:   } finally {
154:     await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
155:   }
156: });

160:   try {
161:     await writeFile(join(dir, 'a.js'), 'hello');
162:     const h1 = await hashDirectory(dir);
163:     await writeFile(join(dir, 'a.js'), 'hello!');
164:     const h2 = await hashDirectory(dir);
165:     assert.notEqual(h1, h2);
166:   } finally {
167:     await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
168:   }
169: });

File: worker/src/index.js

  1: /**
  2:  * Cloudflare Worker entry point for The Roast Room suggestions API.
  3:  * Routing and KV access only. All decisions live in logic.js.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   BODY_LIMIT_BYTES,
  8:   BOARD_KEY,
  9:   RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH,
 10:   RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS,
 11:   adminView,
 12:   applySuggestion,
 13:   applyVote,
 14:   constantTimeEquals,
 15:   normaliseBoard,
 16:   pickOrigin,
 17:   publicView,
 18: } from './logic.js';
 19: 
 20: import {
 21:   ROASTS_KEY,
 22:   ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES,
 23:   applyRoastSubmission,
 24:   applyRoastEdit,
 25:   applyRoastApprove,
 26:   applyRoastReject,
 27:   applyRoastRemove,
 28:   adminRoastsView,
 29:   normaliseRoastBoard,
 30:   publicRoastsView,
 31: } from './roastLogic.js';
 32: 
 33: /**
 34:  * Build a JSON response with CORS headers only for allowed origins.
 35:  * @param {unknown} body
 36:  * @param {number} status
 37:  * @param {string} origin Allowed origin, or empty string.
 38:  * @param {Record<string, string>} [extraHeaders]
 39:  * @returns {Response}
 40:  */
 41: function jsonResponse(body, status, origin, extraHeaders) {
 42:   const headers = new Headers();
 43:   headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
 44:   if (origin) {
 45:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
 46:     headers.set('Vary', 'Origin');
 47:   }
 48:   if (extraHeaders) {
 49:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extraHeaders)) {
 50:       headers.set(key, value);
 51:     }
 52:   }
 53:   return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers });
 54: }
 55: 
 56: /**
 57:  * Build an error response shaped { error, message } with no stack traces.
 58:  * @param {string} code
 59:  * @param {string} message
 60:  * @param {number} status
 61:  * @param {string} origin
 62:  * @returns {Response}
 63:  */
 64: function errorResponse(code, message, status, origin) {
 65:   return jsonResponse({ error: code, message }, status, origin);
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Handle a CORS preflight.
 70:  * @param {Request} request
 71:  * @param {string} allowedOrigins
 72:  * @returns {Response}
 73:  */
 74: function handleOptions(request, allowedOrigins) {
 75:   const origin = pickOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin') || '', allowedOrigins);
 76:   const headers = new Headers();
 77:   if (origin) {
 78:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
 79:     headers.set('Vary', 'Origin');
 80:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
 81:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type, Authorization');
 82:     headers.set('Access-Control-Max-Age', '600');
 83:   }
 84:   return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
 85: }
 86: 
 87: /**
 88:  * Hash a client identifier with the salt and truncate to 32 hex characters.
 89:  * @param {string} clientIp
 90:  * @param {string} salt
 91:  * @returns {Promise<string>}
 92:  */
 93: async function hashClient(clientIp, salt) {
 94:   const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${salt}${clientIp}`);
 95:   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
 96:   const bytes = new Uint8Array(digest);
 97:   let hex = '';
 98:   for (const byte of bytes) hex += byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
 99:   return hex.slice(0, RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH);
100: }
101: 
102: /**
103:  * Build a UTC day string in the YYYYMMDD shape used in the rate key.
104:  * @param {Date} date
105:  * @returns {string}
106:  */
107: function utcDay(date) {
108:   const year = date.getUTCFullYear();
109:   const month = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
110:   const day = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
111:   return `${year}${month}${day}`;
112: }
113: 
114: /**
115:  * Read the request body as a JSON object, enforcing the size limit and the
116:  * content type. The body check uses byte length, not character count.
117:  * @param {Request} request
118:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: true, data: Record<string, unknown> } | { ok: false, error: string, status: number }>}
119:  */
120: async function readJsonBody(request, limitBytes) {
121:   const limit =
122:     Number.isFinite(limitBytes) && limitBytes > 0 ? limitBytes : BODY_LIMIT_BYTES;
123:   const contentType = (request.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase();
124:   if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
125:     return { ok: false, error: 'unsupportedMediaType', status: 415 };
126:   }
127:   const text = await request.text();
128:   if (new TextEncoder().encode(text).length > limit) {
129:     return { ok: false, error: 'bodyTooLarge', status: 400 };
130:   }
131:   try {
132:     const data = JSON.parse(text);
133:     if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
134:       return { ok: false, error: 'invalidBody', status: 400 };
135:     }
136:     return { ok: true, data };
137:   } catch {
138:     return { ok: false, error: 'invalidBody', status: 400 };
139:   }
140: }
141: 
142: /**
143:  * Check the admin bearer token against the configured secret in constant time.
144:  * An unset ADMIN_TOKEN rejects every admin request.
145:  * @param {Request} request
146:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
147:  * @returns {boolean}
148:  */
149: function checkAdmin(request, env) {
150:   const configured = env && typeof env.ADMIN_TOKEN === 'string' ? env.ADMIN_TOKEN : '';
151:   if (configured.length === 0) return false;
152:   const auth = request.headers.get('Authorization') || '';
153:   return constantTimeEquals(auth, `Bearer ${configured}`);
154: }
155: 
156: /**
157:  * Read the rate record for a request client.
158:  * @param {Request} request
159:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
160:  * @returns {Promise<{ key: string, record: unknown }>}
161:  */
162: async function readRate(request, env) {
163:   const clientIp = request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP') || 'unknown';
164:   const salt = typeof env.HASH_SALT === 'string' ? env.HASH_SALT : '';
165:   const hash = await hashClient(clientIp, salt);
166:   const key = `rl:${hash}:${utcDay(new Date())}`;
167:   const record = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(key, 'json');
168:   return { key, record };
169: }
170: 
171: /**
172:  * Persist an accepted action. Exactly two writes: rate record then board.
173:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
174:  * @param {string} rateKey
175:  * @param {unknown} rateRecord
176:  * @param {unknown} board
177:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
178:  */
179: async function persist(env, rateKey, rateRecord, board) {
180:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(rateKey, JSON.stringify(rateRecord), {
181:     expirationTtl: RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS,
182:   });
183:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(board));
184: }
185: 
186: /**
187:  * GET /api/suggestions.
188:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
189:  * @param {string} origin
190:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
191:  */
192: async function handleListSuggestions(env, origin) {
193:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
194:   return jsonResponse(publicView(board), 200, origin, {
195:     'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=30',
196:   });
197: }
198: 
199: /**
200:  * POST /api/suggestions.
201:  * @param {Request} request
202:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
203:  * @param {string} origin
204:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
205:  */
206: async function handlePostSuggestion(request, env, origin) {
207:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
208:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
209:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
210:   }
211:   const { name, website } = bodyResult.data;
212: 
213:   // Honeypot: pretend success and write nothing.
214:   if (typeof website === 'string' && website.trim().length > 0) {
215:     return jsonResponse(
216:       { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your suggestion will appear after review.' },
217:       200,
218:       origin
219:     );
220:   }
221: 
222:   const { key: rateKey, record: rateRecord } = await readRate(request, env);
223:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
224:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
225:   const result = applySuggestion({ board, name, rateRecord, now });
226: 
227:   if (result.outcome === 'invalid') {
228:     return errorResponse('invalidName', result.errors.join('; '), 400, origin);
229:   }
230:   if (result.outcome === 'rateLimited') {
231:     return errorResponse('rateLimited', result.errors.join('; '), 429, origin);
232:   }
233:   if (result.outcome === 'full') {
234:     return jsonResponse(
235:       {
236:         status: 'pending',
237:         message: 'The suggestion list is full right now. Try again later.',
238:       },
239:       200,
240:       origin
241:     );
242:   }
243: 
244:   await persist(env, rateKey, result.rateRecord, result.board);
245: 
246:   if (result.outcome === 'voted') {
247:     return jsonResponse(
248:       { status: 'voted', message: 'That club is already on the list. Your vote was added.' },
249:       200,
250:       origin
251:     );
252:   }
253:   return jsonResponse(
254:     { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your suggestion will appear after review.' },
255:     200,
256:     origin
257:   );
258: }
259: 
260: /**
261:  * POST /api/votes.
262:  * @param {Request} request
263:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
264:  * @param {string} origin
265:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
266:  */
267: async function handlePostVote(request, env, origin) {
268:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
269:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
270:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
271:   }
272:   const { slug } = bodyResult.data;
273: 
274:   const { key: rateKey, record: rateRecord } = await readRate(request, env);
275:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
276:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
277:   const result = applyVote({ board, slug, rateRecord, now });
278: 
279:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound' || result.outcome === 'notApproved') {
280:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not available.', 404, origin);
281:   }
282:   if (result.outcome === 'rateLimited') {
283:     return errorResponse('rateLimited', result.errors.join('; '), 429, origin);
284:   }
285: 
286:   await persist(env, rateKey, result.rateRecord, result.board);
287:   return jsonResponse({ status: 'voted', message: 'Your vote was added.' }, 200, origin);
288: }

290: /**
291:  * GET /api/admin/suggestions.
292:  * @param {Request} request
293:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
294:  * @param {string} origin
295:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
296:  */
297: async function handleAdminList(request, env, origin) {
298:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
299:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
300:   }
301:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
302:   return jsonResponse(adminView(board), 200, origin);
303: }

305: /**
306:  * POST /api/admin/approve.
307:  * @param {Request} request
308:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
309:  * @param {string} origin
310:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
311:  */
312: async function handleAdminApprove(request, env, origin) {
313:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
314:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
315:   }
316:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
317:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
318:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
319:   }
320:   const { slug, approved } = bodyResult.data;
321:   if (typeof slug !== 'string' || typeof approved !== 'boolean') {
322:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'slug and approved are required.', 400, origin);
323:   }
324:   const board = normaliseBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json'));
325:   const existing = board.suggestions[slug];
326:   if (!existing) {
327:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not in the board.', 404, origin);
328:   }
329:   const next = {
330:     version: board.version,
331:     suggestions: {
332:       ...board.suggestions,
333:       [slug]: { ...existing, approved, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
334:     },
335:   };
336:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
337:   return jsonResponse({ slug, approved }, 200, origin);
338: }
339: 
340: /**
341:  * POST /api/admin/remove.
342:  * @param {Request} request
343:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
344:  * @param {string} origin
345:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
346:  */
347: async function handleAdminRemove(request, env, origin) {
348:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
349:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
350:   }
351:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
352:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
353:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
354:   }
355:   const { slug } = bodyResult.data;
356:   if (typeof slug !== 'string') {
357:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'slug is required.', 400, origin);
358:   }
359:   const board = normaliseBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json'));
360:   if (!board.suggestions[slug]) {
361:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not in the board.', 404, origin);
362:   }
363:   const next = {
364:     version: board.version,
365:     suggestions: { ...board.suggestions },
366:   };
367:   delete next.suggestions[slug];
368:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
369:   return jsonResponse({ slug, removed: true }, 200, origin);
370: }
371: 
372: /**
373:  * Parse the LIVE_CLUB_IDS var. Falls back to a single manutd club when unset.
374:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
375:  * @returns {string[]}
376:  */
377: function parseLiveClubIds(env) {
378:   const raw = env && typeof env.LIVE_CLUB_IDS === 'string' ? env.LIVE_CLUB_IDS : 'manutd';
379:   return raw
380:     .split(',')
381:     .map((entry) => entry.trim())
382:     .filter((entry) => entry.length > 0);
383: }
384: 
385: /**
386:  * POST /api/roast_submissions.
387:  * @param {Request} request
388:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
389:  * @param {string} origin
390:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
391:  */
392: async function handlePostRoastSubmission(request, env, origin) {
393:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request, ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES);
394:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
395:     return errorResponse(
396:       bodyResult.error,
397:       'That request could not be read.',
398:       bodyResult.status,
399:       origin
400:     );
401:   }
402:   const body = bodyResult.data;
403: 
404:   const honeypot = typeof body.website === 'string' ? body.website : '';
405:   if (honeypot.trim().length > 0) {
406:     return jsonResponse(
407:       { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your roast will appear after review.' },
408:       200,
409:       origin
410:     );
411:   }
412: 
413:   const { key: rateKey, record: rateRecord } = await readRate(request, env);
414:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json');
415:   const result = applyRoastSubmission({
416:     board,
417:     rateRecord,
418:     fields: body,
419:     now: new Date().toISOString(),
420:     liveClubIds: parseLiveClubIds(env),
421:     random: Math.random,
422:   });
423: 
424:   if (result.outcome === 'invalid') {
425:     return errorResponse('invalidFields', result.errors.join('; '), 400, origin);
426:   }
427:   if (result.outcome === 'duplicate') {
428:     return errorResponse('duplicateHeadline', result.errors.join('; '), 409, origin);
429:   }
430:   if (result.outcome === 'rateLimited') {
431:     return errorResponse('rateLimited', result.errors.join('; '), 429, origin);
432:   }
433:   if (result.outcome === 'full') {
434:     return jsonResponse(
435:       {
436:         status: 'pending',
437:         message: 'The submission list is full right now. Try again later.',
438:       },
439:       200,
440:       origin
441:     );
442:   }
443: 
444:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(rateKey, JSON.stringify(result.rateRecord), {
445:     expirationTtl: RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS,
446:   });
447:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(ROASTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.board));
448: 
449:   return jsonResponse(
450:     { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your roast will appear after review.' },
451:     200,
452:     origin
453:   );
454: }
455: 
456: /**
457:  * GET /api/roasts?club=<id>.
458:  * @param {Request} request
459:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
460:  * @param {string} origin
461:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
462:  */
463: async function handleListPublicRoasts(request, env, origin) {
464:   const url = new URL(request.url);
465:   const clubId = url.searchParams.get('club') || '';
466:   if (clubId.length === 0) {
467:     return jsonResponse({ roasts: [] }, 200, origin, {
468:       'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=60',
469:     });
470:   }
471:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json');
472:   const view = publicRoastsView(board, clubId);
473:   return jsonResponse(view, 200, origin, {
474:     'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=60',
475:   });
476: }
477: 
478: /**
479:  * GET /api/admin/roast_submissions.
480:  * @param {Request} request
481:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
482:  * @param {string} origin
483:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
484:  */
485: async function handleAdminListRoasts(request, env, origin) {
486:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
487:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
488:   }
489:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json');
490:   return jsonResponse(adminRoastsView(board), 200, origin);
491: }
492: 
493: /**
494:  * POST /api/admin/roast_submissions/update.
495:  * @param {Request} request
496:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
497:  * @param {string} origin
498:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
499:  */
500: async function handleAdminEditRoast(request, env, origin) {
501:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
502:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
503:   }
504:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request, ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES);
505:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
506:     return errorResponse(
507:       bodyResult.error,
508:       'That request could not be read.',
509:       bodyResult.status,
510:       origin
511:     );
512:   }
513:   const body = bodyResult.data;
514:   if (typeof body.id !== 'string' || body.id.length === 0) {
515:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'id is required.', 400, origin);
516:   }
517:   const board = normaliseRoastBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json'));
518:   const result = applyRoastEdit({
519:     board,
520:     id: body.id,
521:     fields: body,
522:     now: new Date().toISOString(),
523:     liveClubIds: parseLiveClubIds(env),
524:   });
525:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound') {
526:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That submission is not in the board.', 404, origin);
527:   }
528:   if (result.outcome === 'invalid') {
529:     return errorResponse('invalidFields', result.errors.join('; '), 400, origin);
530:   }
531:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(ROASTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.board));
532:   return jsonResponse({ id: body.id, updated: true }, 200, origin);
533: }
534: 
535: /**
536:  * POST /api/admin/roast_submissions/approve.
537:  * @param {Request} request
538:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
539:  * @param {string} origin
540:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
541:  */
542: async function handleAdminApproveRoast(request, env, origin) {
543:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
544:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
545:   }
546:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request, ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES);
547:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
548:     return errorResponse(
549:       bodyResult.error,
550:       'That request could not be read.',
551:       bodyResult.status,
552:       origin
553:     );
554:   }
555:   const { id, checkedSource } = bodyResult.data;
556:   if (typeof id !== 'string' || id.length === 0) {
557:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'id is required.', 400, origin);
558:   }
559:   if (checkedSource !== true) {
560:     return errorResponse(
561:       'notChecked',
562:       'checkedSource must be exactly true.',
563:       400,
564:       origin
565:     );
566:   }
567:   const board = normaliseRoastBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json'));
568:   const result = applyRoastApprove({
569:     board,
570:     id,
571:     checkedSource: true,
572:     now: new Date().toISOString(),
573:   });
574:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound') {
575:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That submission is not in the board.', 404, origin);
576:   }
577:   if (result.outcome === 'notChecked') {
578:     return errorResponse(
579:       'notChecked',
580:       'checkedSource must be exactly true.',
581:       400,
582:       origin
583:     );
584:   }
585:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(ROASTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.board));
586:   return jsonResponse({ id, status: 'approved' }, 200, origin);
587: }
588: 
589: /**
590:  * POST /api/admin/roast_submissions/reject.
591:  * @param {Request} request
592:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
593:  * @param {string} origin
594:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
595:  */
596: async function handleAdminRejectRoast(request, env, origin) {
597:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
598:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
599:   }
600:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request, ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES);
601:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
602:     return errorResponse(
603:       bodyResult.error,
604:       'That request could not be read.',
605:       bodyResult.status,
606:       origin
607:     );
608:   }
609:   const { id } = bodyResult.data;
610:   if (typeof id !== 'string' || id.length === 0) {
611:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'id is required.', 400, origin);
612:   }
613:   const board = normaliseRoastBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json'));
614:   const result = applyRoastReject({ board, id, now: new Date().toISOString() });
615:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound') {
616:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That submission is not in the board.', 404, origin);
617:   }
618:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(ROASTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.board));
619:   return jsonResponse({ id, status: 'rejected' }, 200, origin);
620: }
621: 
622: /**
623:  * POST /api/admin/roast_submissions/remove.
624:  * @param {Request} request
625:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
626:  * @param {string} origin
627:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
628:  */
629: async function handleAdminRemoveRoast(request, env, origin) {
630:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
631:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
632:   }
633:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request, ROAST_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES);
634:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
635:     return errorResponse(
636:       bodyResult.error,
637:       'That request could not be read.',
638:       bodyResult.status,
639:       origin
640:     );
641:   }
642:   const { id } = bodyResult.data;
643:   if (typeof id !== 'string' || id.length === 0) {
644:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'id is required.', 400, origin);
645:   }
646:   const board = normaliseRoastBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(ROASTS_KEY, 'json'));
647:   const result = applyRoastRemove({ board, id });
648:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound') {
649:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That submission is not in the board.', 404, origin);
650:   }
651:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(ROASTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.board));
652:   return jsonResponse({ id, removed: true }, 200, origin);
653: }
654: 
655: export default {
656:   async fetch(request, env) {
657:     try {
658:       return await handleRequest(request, env);
659:     } catch {
660:       return errorResponse('serverError', 'Something went wrong. Please try again.', 500, '');
661:     }
662:   },
663: };
664: 
665: async function handleRequest(request, env) {
666:     const url = new URL(request.url);
667:     const allowedOrigins = typeof env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS === 'string' ? env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS : '';
668:     const origin = pickOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin') || '', allowedOrigins);
669: 
670:     if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
671:       return handleOptions(request, allowedOrigins);
672:     }
673: 
674:     const isPost = request.method === 'POST';
675:     const hasOriginHeader = request.headers.get('Origin') !== null;
676:     if (isPost && hasOriginHeader && !origin) {
677:       return errorResponse('originNotAllowed', 'This origin is not allowed.', 403, '');
678:     }
679: 
680:     const path = url.pathname;
681: 
682:     if (path === '/api/suggestions' && request.method === 'GET') {
683:       return handleListSuggestions(env, origin);
684:     }
685:     if (path === '/api/suggestions' && request.method === 'POST') {
686:       return handlePostSuggestion(request, env, origin);
687:     }
688:     if (path === '/api/votes' && request.method === 'POST') {
689:       return handlePostVote(request, env, origin);
690:     }
691:     if (path === '/api/admin/suggestions' && request.method === 'GET') {
692:       return handleAdminList(request, env, origin);
693:     }
694:     if (path === '/api/admin/approve' && request.method === 'POST') {
695:       return handleAdminApprove(request, env, origin);
696:     }
697:     if (path === '/api/admin/remove' && request.method === 'POST') {
698:       return handleAdminRemove(request, env, origin);
699:     }
700:     if (path === '/api/roast_submissions' && request.method === 'POST') {
701:       return handlePostRoastSubmission(request, env, origin);
702:     }
703:     if (path === '/api/roasts' && request.method === 'GET') {
704:       return handleListPublicRoasts(request, env, origin);
705:     }
706:     if (path === '/api/admin/roast_submissions' && request.method === 'GET') {
707:       return handleAdminListRoasts(request, env, origin);
708:     }
709:     if (path === '/api/admin/roast_submissions/update' && request.method === 'POST') {
710:       return handleAdminEditRoast(request, env, origin);
711:     }
712:     if (path === '/api/admin/roast_submissions/approve' && request.method === 'POST') {
713:       return handleAdminApproveRoast(request, env, origin);
714:     }
715:     if (path === '/api/admin/roast_submissions/reject' && request.method === 'POST') {
716:       return handleAdminRejectRoast(request, env, origin);
717:     }
718:     if (path === '/api/admin/roast_submissions/remove' && request.method === 'POST') {
719:       return handleAdminRemoveRoast(request, env, origin);
720:     }
721: 
722:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That route does not exist.', 404, origin);
723: }
