================
File: README.md
================
  1: # The Roast Room
  2: 
  3: The Roast Room is an interactive football banter site. Supporters pick a rival club and
  4: read funny, embarrassing and painful facts about it. Every published roast is backed by
  5: dated evidence that a human has checked.
  6: 
  7: The site launches with Manchester United live. Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester City,
  8: Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur are listed as coming soon.
  9: 
 10: It is built by the solo web agency Fritt and doubles as a portfolio piece, so the code is
 11: kept small, readable and easy to extend.
 12: 
 13: ## Project status
 14: 
 15: - **Stage 1 (foundations)**: done. Design tokens, theming, club registry, roast schema,
 16:   validation, developer token preview, documentation.
 17: - **Stage 2 (public pages)**: done. Landing page, club picker, roast generator, shuffle
 18:   bag, reveal animation, deep links, category filter, share ready roast URL helper.
 19: - **Stage 3 (share cards)**: done. Branded roast cards, Post and Story formats, canvas
 20:   rendering, system Share, Download image, Copy link, copy fallback, Card lab QA page,
 21:   tests.
 22: - **Stage 4 (next)**: suggestions form and Worker.
 23: - **Stage 5**: branding polish and deployment.
 24: 
 25: ## Pages
 26: 
 27: | Page | Purpose |
 28: | --- | --- |
 29: | `index.html` | Public landing page. Hero, recent roast ticker, how it works, club picker. |
 30: | `room.html?club=<id>` | Roast generator for one live club. Category filter, shuffle bag, roast card with receipts, share panel. |
 31: | `tokens.html` | Developer preview of design tokens and theming. Not linked from public pages. |
 32: | `cardlab.html` | Developer only QA page for share cards. Not linked from public pages. |
 33: 
 34: ## Files added in stage 3
 35: 
 36: ```text
 37: js/share/shareConfig.js      Share host override
 38: js/share/cardFormats.js      Post and Story card dimensions
 39: js/share/textLayout.js       Pure wrap, truncate and fit logic
 40: js/share/shareText.js        Share text, file name and absolute URL helpers
 41: js/share/renderCard.js       Canvas 2D roast card renderer
 42: js/share/actions.js          Blob, download, share and clipboard actions
 43: js/share/sharePanel.js       Share panel controller
 44: js/dev/cardLab.js            Card lab logic
 45: cardlab.html                 Developer only QA page
 46: tests/shareText.test.mjs     Tests for pure share logic
 47: ## Project status (stage 5)
 48: 
 49: - **Stage 5 (launch polish)**: done. Fritt branding and call to action, about and privacy page, 404 page, share card ticket notch fix, social previews, sitemap and robots, `_headers` with a strict CSP, production build pipeline.
 50: 
 51: The site is now ready to deploy on a custom domain.
 52: 
 53: ## Files added in stage 5
 54: 
 55: ```text
 56: js/brand/frittConfig.js       Fritt URLs
 57: js/brand/frittLinks.js        Pure utm tagging helper
 58: js/brand/applyFrittLinks.js   Wires up data-fritt-target anchors
 59: js/pages/about.js             About page entry point
 60: js/dev/ogImage.js             Developer page that draws og.png and apple_touch_icon.png
 61: scripts/lib/siteTools.mjs     Pure build helpers
 62: tests/siteTools.test.mjs      Tests for the build helpers and frittLink
 63: about.html                    About and privacy page
 64: 404.html                      Not found page
 65: ogimage.html                  Developer page for generating the social images
 66: ```
 67: 
 68: ## Launch checklist
 69: 
 70: Before the site goes live:
 71: 
 72: 1. Generate the two social images with `ogimage.html`. Open it in a browser, click **Download og.png** and **Download apple_touch_icon.png**, and save both files into the repository root. Commit them.
 73: 2. Update `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `worker/wrangler.toml` with your production site origin and any preview origins. Run `npx wrangler deploy` from the `worker` folder.
 74: 3. Set `SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE` in `js/share/shareConfig.js` to the production host without a protocol, for example `roastroom.fritt.org`, so shared card footers show the right host before the domain exists.
 75: 4. Keep `about.html` accurate. If you ever add analytics, cookieless or otherwise, update the privacy section on that page before the analytics goes live.
 76: 5. Run `npm run validate` and `npm test` and confirm they pass.
 77: 6. Run `SITE_URL=https://your.domain npm run build` and confirm the summary has no surviving `__SITE_URL__` tokens and no unexpected warnings.
 78: 7. Deploy the `site/` folder.
 79: 
 80: ## Hosting
 81: 
 82: The build is fully static: it compiles the CSS, copies the public pages, the javascript, the json data, the images, then writes `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` and `_headers` into `site/`. Both hosting platforms below are configured the same way.
 83: 
 84: ### Netlify
 85: 
 86: Build settings:
 87: 
 88: - Build command: `npm run build`
 89: - Publish directory: `site`
 90: - Environment variable: `SITE_URL` set to the public URL of the site, for example `https://roastroom.fritt.org`. Netlify also sets `URL`, which the build script falls back to.
 91: 
 92: Custom domain on a subdomain such as `roastroom.fritt.org`:
 93: 
 94: 1. In Netlify, open **Domain management** and add `roastroom.fritt.org` as a custom domain for the site.
 95: 2. In the DNS provider for `fritt.org`, create a `CNAME` record named `roastroom` pointing to the Netlify site address, for example `<yoursite>.netlify.app`.
 96: 3. Wait for DNS to propagate and for Netlify to provision the TLS certificate.
 97: 
 98: ### Cloudflare Pages
 99: 
100: Build settings:
101: 
102: - Framework preset: none
103: - Build command: `npm run build`
104: - Build output directory: `site`
105: - Environment variable: `SITE_URL` set to the public URL of the site. Cloudflare also sets `CF_PAGES_URL`, which the build script falls back to.
106: 
107: Custom domain:
108: 
109: 1. In the Cloudflare Pages project, open **Custom domains** and add `roastroom.fritt.org`.
110: 2. Because `fritt.org` is already on Cloudflare, the CNAME record is created automatically. If the zone is not on Cloudflare, add a `CNAME` record named `roastroom` pointing to `<project>.pages.dev`.
111: 
112: ### After changing the Worker URL
113: 
114: Every time the Worker URL changes:
115: 
116: 1. Paste the new URL into `js/suggest/suggestConfig.js` as `SUGGEST_API_BASE`.
117: 2. Run `npm run build` so the CSP `connect-src` picks up the new origin.
118: 3. Redeploy the `site/` folder.
119: 
120: ### Final QA before launch
121: 
122: - Run the site locally with `npx serve site` and walk through the manual QA checklist.
123: - Open `index.html`, `room.html` and `about.html` and confirm there are no console errors, especially CSP violations.
124: - Share a roast URL in a chat app and confirm the social preview renders.
125: - Submit a suggestion and vote; approve it in `adminlab.html` and reload the landing page.
126: - Run a Lighthouse audit on a phone viewport with mobile throttling. Accessibility, best practices and SEO should each score 90 or above.

File: worker/wrangler.toml

 1: name = "roastroomsuggest"
 2: main = "src/index.js"
 3: compatibility_date = "2025-04-01"
 4: 
 5: [[kv_namespaces]]
 6: binding = "SUGGESTIONS"
 7: id = "c7d1798800ad476598ef3323f31195eb"
 8: 
 9: [vars]
10: # Comma separated list of allowed origins.
11: # Requests with an Origin header that is not on this list are rejected with 403
12: # for POST routes and receive no CORS headers for any route.
13: #
14: # http://localhost:3000              local dev (any dev server on this port)
15: # http://localhost:8000              local dev (python -m http.server)
16: # https://paste_your_netlify_site_here   your Netlify site URL
17: # https://roastroom.fritt.org        production site
18: ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8000,https://the-roast-room.pages.dev,https://roastroom.fritt.org"
19: # Comma separated list of clubs that accept fan roast submissions.
20: LIVE_CLUB_IDS = "manutd"

================
File: js/pages/landing.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Landing page logic.
  3:  * Renders the club picker from the registry, the recent roast ticker and the
  4:  * hero call to action target, all from data files at runtime.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { initSuggestSection } from '../suggest/suggestSection.js';
  8: import { applyFrittLinks } from '../brand/applyFrittLinks.js';
  9: import { DEFAULT_CLUB_ID } from '../config.js';
 10: import { getComingSoonClubs, getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from '../registry.js';
 11: import { clear, createElement, prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 12: import { initScrollBackground } from '../background/scrollBackground.js';
 13: import { backgroundLayersFor } from '../background/layers.js';
 14: 
 15: const liveContainer = document.getElementById('liveClubs');
 16: const comingSoonContainer = document.getElementById('comingSoonClubs');
 17: const tickerSection = document.getElementById('tickerSection');
 18: const tickerTrack = document.getElementById('tickerTrack');
 19: 
 20: /**
 21:  * Point every CTA at the default club from config.
 22:  * @returns {void}
 23:  */
 24: function setCallToActions() {
 25:   const links = document.querySelectorAll('[data-cta-club]');
 26:   for (const link of links) {
 27:     if (link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
 28:       link.href = `./room.html?club=${encodeURIComponent(DEFAULT_CLUB_ID)}`;
 29:     }
 30:   }
 31: }
 32: 
 33: /**
 34:  * Build one live club card linking to its roast room.
 35:  * @param {{ id: string, name: string }} entry Registry entry.
 36:  * @param {number} roastCount Number of publishable roasts in the club.
 37:  * @returns {HTMLAnchorElement}
 38:  */
 39: function renderLiveClub(entry, roastCount) {
 40:   const link = createElement('a', {
 41:     className:
 42:       'block rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-6 no-underline transition-colors duration-fast ease-standard hover:border-primary',
 43:     attrs: { href: `./room.html?club=${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}` },
 44:   });
 45: 
 46:   link.append(
 47:     createElement('p', {
 48:       className: 'font-display text-2xl uppercase text-text',
 49:       text: entry.name,
 50:     })
 51:   );
 52: 
 53:   link.append(
 54:     createElement('p', {
 55:       className: 'mt-2 text-sm text-textMuted',
 56:       text: roastCount === 1 ? '1 roast ready' : `${roastCount} roasts ready`,
 57:     })
 58:   );
 59: 
 60:   return link;
 61: }
 62: 
 63: /**
 64:  * Build one coming soon card. Not a link and marked disabled for assistive tech.
 65:  * @param {{ name: string }} entry Registry entry.
 66:  * @returns {HTMLElement}
 67:  */
 68: function renderComingSoonClub(entry) {
 69:   const wrap = createElement('div', {
 70:     className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4',
 71:     attrs: { 'aria-disabled': 'true' },
 72:     children: [
 73:       createElement('p', {
 74:         className: 'font-display text-lg uppercase text-textMuted',
 75:         text: entry.name,
 76:       }),
 77:       createElement('p', {
 78:         className: 'mt-1 tokenLabel',
 79:         text: 'Coming soon',
 80:       }),
 81:     ],
 82:   });
 83:   return wrap;
 84: }
 85: 
 86: function setupTickerToggle() {
 87:   const toggle = document.getElementById('tickerToggle');
 88:   if (!toggle || !tickerTrack || toggle.dataset.ready === 'true') return;
 89:   toggle.dataset.ready = 'true';
 90: 
 91:   let running = true;
 92: 
 93:   const apply = () => {
 94:     const duration = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches ? '26s' : '40s';
 95:     // Inline `!important` is required: css/base.css sets
 96:     // `* { animation-duration: 1ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; }`
 97:     // under prefers-reduced-motion, which would otherwise kill the ticker even
 98:     // after the user clicks Play.
 99:     tickerTrack.style.setProperty(
100:       'animation',
101:       `tickerScroll ${duration} linear infinite`,
102:       'important'
103:     );
104:     tickerTrack.style.setProperty(
105:       'animation-play-state',
106:       running ? 'running' : 'paused',
107:       'important'
108:     );
109:     toggle.textContent = running ? 'Pause ticker' : 'Play ticker';
110:     toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', running ? 'false' : 'true');
111:   };
112: 
113:   toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
114:     running = !running;
115:     apply();
116:   });
117: 
118:   apply();
119: }
120: 
121: /**
122:  * Render the ticker with the first six headlines.
123:  * Duplicates the items once so the CSS translate loop is seamless; only the
124:  * first copy is exposed to screen readers.
125:  * @param {Array<{ headline: string, clubShortName: string }>} roasts
126:  * @returns {void}
127:  */
128: function renderTicker(roasts) {
129:   if (!tickerTrack || !tickerSection) return;
130: 
131:   clear(tickerTrack);
132: 
133:   if (!Array.isArray(roasts) || roasts.length === 0) {
134:     tickerSection.classList.add('hidden');
135:     return;
136:   }
137: 
138:   const items = roasts.slice(0, 6);
139: 
140:   for (const roast of items) {
141:     tickerTrack.append(
142:       createElement('span', {
143:         className: 'whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-textMuted',
144:         text: `${roast.clubShortName}: ${roast.headline}`,
145:       })
146:     );
147:   }
148: 
149:   for (const roast of items) {
150:     tickerTrack.append(
151:       createElement('span', {
152:         className: 'whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-textMuted',
153:         text: `${roast.clubShortName}: ${roast.headline}`,
154:         attrs: { 'aria-hidden': 'true' },
155:       })
156:     );
157:   }
158: 
159:   tickerSection.classList.remove('hidden');
160:   setupTickerToggle();
161: }
162: 
163: /**
164:  * Show a friendly error inside the picker when the registry cannot load.
165:  * @param {string} message
166:  * @returns {void}
167:  */
168: function showPickerError(message) {
169:   if (!liveContainer) return;
170:   clear(liveContainer);
171:   liveContainer.append(
172:     createElement('p', {
173:       className: 'text-textMuted',
174:       text: message,
175:     })
176:   );
177: }

179: /**
180:  * Load the registry and render every section of the page.
181:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
182:  */
183: async function init() {
184:   setCallToActions();
185:   applyFrittLinks();
186: 
187:   const bgEl = document.getElementById('clubBackground');
188:   if (bgEl) {
189:     initScrollBackground(bgEl, backgroundLayersFor('manutd'));
190:   }
191: 
192:   try {
193:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
194:     const live = getLiveClubs(registry);
195:     const comingSoon = getComingSoonClubs(registry);
196: 
197:     /** @type {Array<{ headline: string, clubShortName: string }>} */
198:     const roastPool = [];
199: 
200:     for (const entry of live) {
201:       try {
202:         const club = await loadClub(entry.id);
203:         if (liveContainer) {
204:           liveContainer.append(renderLiveClub(entry, Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts.length : 0));
205:         }
206:         if (Array.isArray(club.roasts)) {
207:           for (const roast of club.roasts) {
208:             roastPool.push({ headline: roast.headline, clubShortName: String(entry.shortName) });
209:           }
210:         }
211:       } catch (error) {
212:         console.warn('[roastRoom] could not load live club', entry.id, error);
213:       }
214:     }
215: 
216:     if (comingSoonContainer) {
217:       for (const entry of comingSoon) {
218:         comingSoonContainer.append(renderComingSoonClub(entry));
219:       }
220:     }
221: 
222:       renderTicker(roastPool);
223:     } catch (error) {
224:       console.warn('[roastRoom] could not load the registry', error);
225:       showPickerError('Could not load the club list. Serve the site over http and reload.');
226:     }
227: 
228:     initSuggestSection();
229: }
230: 
231: init();

 56: const SESSION_KEY = 'roastroom_session_count';
 57: 
 58: /**
 59:  * Read the roast count for this browser session.
 60:  * @returns {number}
 61:  */
 62: function readSessionCount() {
 63:   try {
 64:     return parseInt(window.sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY) || '0', 10) || 0;
 65:   } catch {
 66:     return 0;
 67:   }
 68: }
 69: 
 70: /**
 71:  * Persist the roast count. Best effort only.
 72:  * @param {number} count
 73:  * @returns {void}
 74:  */
 75: function writeSessionCount(count) {
 76:   try {
 77:     window.sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, String(count));
 78:   } catch {
 79:     // sessionStorage is best effort only.
 80:   }
 81: }
 82: 
 83: let sessionCount = readSessionCount();
 84: 
 85: /**
 86:  * Update the "N roasts served this session" line.
 87:  * @returns {void}
 88:  */
 89: function renderSessionCount() {
 90:   if (!sessionCounterEl) return;
 91:   if (sessionCount === 0) {
 92:     sessionCounterEl.textContent = '';
 93:   } else if (sessionCount === 1) {
 94:     sessionCounterEl.textContent = '1 roast served this session.';
 95:   } else {
 96:     sessionCounterEl.textContent = `${sessionCount} roasts served this session.`;
 97:   }
 98: }

102: function showLoading() {
103:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.remove('hidden');
104:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
105:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
106: }

108: /**
109:  * Show the error state with a friendly message.
110:  * @param {string} message
111:  * @returns {void}
112:  */
113: function showError(message) {
114:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
115:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
116:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
117:   if (errorMessageEl) errorMessageEl.textContent = message;
118:   if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = 'Club unavailable';
119: }
120: 
121: function showRoom() {
122:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
123:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
124:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.remove('hidden');
125: }

127: /**
128:  * Roasts in the current filter.
129:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
130:  */
131: function getFilteredRoasts() {
132:   if (!club) return [];
133:   const roasts = Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [];
134:   if (selectedCategory === 'all') return roasts;
135:   return roasts.filter((roast) => roast.category === selectedCategory);
136: }
137: 
138: /**
139:  * Update the "Roast N of M" line. Nothing is shown before the first serve or
140:  * when the current cycle has already served everything once.
141:  * @returns {void}
142:  */
143: function updateProgress() {
144:   if (!progressEl) return;
145:   if (!bag || !currentRoast || bag.size() === 0) {
146:     progressEl.textContent = '';
147:     return;
148:   }
149:   const size = bag.size();
150:   const remaining = bag.remaining();
151:   const n = size - remaining;
152:   if (n <= 0) {
153:     progressEl.textContent = '';
154:     return;
155:   }
156:   progressEl.textContent = `Roast ${n} of ${size}`;
157: }
158: 
159: /**
160:  * Look up the category metadata for a roast.
161:  * @param {string} id
162:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown> | null}
163:  */
164: function findCategory(id) {
165:   if (!club || !Array.isArray(club.categories)) return null;
166:   return club.categories.find((category) => category && category.id === id) || null;
167: }
168: 
169: /**
170:  * Show a roast in the card area, reveal it, announce it and update the URL hash.
171:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast
172:  * @param {{ animate?: boolean }} [options]
173:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
174:  */
175: async function showRoast(roast, options = {}) {
176:   if (!roast || !roastContainer) return;
177: 
178:   const shouldAnimate = options.animate !== false;
179:   currentRoast = roast;
180: 
181:   const category = findCategory(String(roast.category));
182:   const built = createRoastCard(roast, category);
183: 
184:   clear(roastContainer);
185:   roastContainer.append(built.element);
186: 
187:   const base = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
188:   try {
189:     window.history.replaceState(null, '', `${base}#${encodeURIComponent(String(roast.id))}`);
190:   } catch {
191:     // Ignore history errors, the page still works.
192:   }
193: 
194:   const reelOn = reelToggleEl ? reelToggleEl.checked : !prefersReducedMotion();
195: 
196:   if (shouldAnimate && reelOn) {
197:     const pool = (Array.isArray(club?.roasts) ? club.roasts : [])
198:       .map((entry) => String(entry.headline))
199:       .filter((headline) => headline.length > 0);
200:     await revealRoast({
201:       headlineElement: built.headlineElement,
202:       finalHeadline: String(roast.headline),
203:       reelPool: pool,
204:       hiddenElements: built.hiddenElements,
205:       forceAnimate: true,
206:     });
207:   } else {
208:     built.headlineElement.textContent = String(roast.headline);
209:     for (const el of built.hiddenElements) {
210:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
211:     }
212:   }
213: 
214:   if (liveRegion) {
215:     liveRegion.textContent = String(roast.headline);
216:   }
217: 
218:   if (sharePanel) {
219:     try {
220:       sharePanel.update(roast, category, club);
221:     } catch (error) {
222:       console.warn('[roastRoom] could not update the share panel', error);
223:     }
224:   }
225: 
226:   updateProgress();
227: }
228: 
229: /**
230:  * Rebuild the bag and the filter chips for the current selection.
231:  * @returns {void}
232:  */
233: function rebuildBagAndFilter() {
234:   if (!club) return;
235: 
236:   const filtered = getFilteredRoasts();
237: 
238:   if (bag) {
239:     bag.reset(filtered);
240:   } else {
241:     bag = createShuffleBag(filtered);
242:   }
243: 
244:   if (filterContainer) {
245:     buildCategoryFilter({
246:       container: filterContainer,
247:       categories: Array.isArray(club.categories) ? club.categories : [],
248:       roasts: Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [],
249:       selectedId: selectedCategory,
250:       onChange: handleFilterChange,
251:     });
252:   }
253: 
254:   const isEmpty = filtered.length === 0;
255:   if (roastButton) roastButton.disabled = isEmpty;
256:   if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !isEmpty);
257: 
258:   if (isEmpty) {
259:     clear(roastContainer);
260:     currentRoast = null;
261:     if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
262:     if (sharePanel) sharePanel.hide();
263:   }
264: }
265: 
266: /**
267:  * Handle a filter chip click. Resets the current roast and the bag.
268:  * @param {string} newId
269:  * @returns {void}
270:  */
271: function handleFilterChange(newId) {
272:   if (busy) return;
273:   selectedCategory = newId;
274:   currentRoast = null;
275:   if (roastContainer) clear(roastContainer);
276:   if (liveRegion) liveRegion.textContent = '';
277:   if (sharePanel) sharePanel.hide();
278:   rebuildBagAndFilter();
279: }
280: 
281: async function handleRoastClick() {
282:   if (busy || !bag) return;
283:   const items = getFilteredRoasts();
284:   if (items.length === 0) return;
285: 
286:   busy = true;
287:   if (roastButton) {
288:     roastButton.disabled = true;
289:     roastButton.textContent = 'Roasting…';
290:   }
291: 
292:   try {
293:     const roast = bag.next();
294:     if (roast) {
295:       sessionCount += 1;
296:       writeSessionCount(sessionCount);
297:       renderSessionCount();
298:       burstConfetti({ originX: 0.5, originY: 0.55, count: 36 });
299:       await showRoast(roast, { animate: true });
300:     }
301:   } finally {
302:     busy = false;
303:     if (roastButton) {
304:       roastButton.textContent = 'Roast them';
305:       roastButton.disabled = getFilteredRoasts().length === 0;
306:     }
307:   }
308: }
309: 
310: /**
311:  * Boot the page. Reads the club id, loads the club, wires everything up.
312:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
313:  */
314: async function init() {
315:   showLoading();
316:   applyFrittLinks();
317: 
318:   try {
319:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
320:     const clubs = Array.isArray(registry.clubs) ? registry.clubs : [];
321:     const entry = clubs.find((candidate) => candidate && candidate.id === clubIdParam);
322: 
323:     if (!entry) {
324:       showError(`That club isn't in the registry. Pick one from the picker instead.`);
325:       return;
326:     }
327: 
328:     if (entry.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
329:       showError(`${entry.name} is coming soon. There isn't a roast room for it yet.`);
330:       return;
331:     }
332: 
333:     club = await loadClub(clubIdParam);
334: 
335:     // Merge approved fan roasts without mutating the cached club object.
336:     const cachedClub = club;
337:     const existingIds = (Array.isArray(cachedClub.roasts) ? cachedClub.roasts : [])
338:       .map((roast) => (roast && typeof roast.id === 'string' ? roast.id : ''))
339:       .filter((id) => id.length > 0);
340:     const fanRoasts = await loadFanRoasts(
341:       clubIdParam,
342:       cachedClub.categories,
343:       existingIds
344:     );
345:     if (fanRoasts.length > 0) {
346:       club = {
347:         ...cachedClub,
348:         roasts: [
349:           ...(Array.isArray(cachedClub.roasts) ? cachedClub.roasts : []),
350:           ...fanRoasts,
351:         ],
352:       };
353:     }
354:     applyTheme(club.theme || {});
355: 
356:     // Mount club-specific parallax background.
357:     if (teardownBackground) teardownBackground();
358:     const bgEl = document.getElementById('clubBackground');
359:     if (bgEl) {
360:       teardownBackground = initScrollBackground(bgEl, backgroundLayersFor(clubIdParam));
361:     }
362: 
363:     if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = String(club.name || 'Roast Room');
364:     if (pageHeading) pageHeading.textContent = `${club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room`;
365:     document.title = `${club.shortName || club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room | The Roast Room`;
366: 
367:     const hash = parseRoastHash(window.location.hash);
368:     const deepRoast =
369:       hash && Array.isArray(club.roasts)
370:         ? club.roasts.find((roast) => roast && roast.id === hash) || null
371:         : null;
372: 
373:     selectedCategory = 'all';
374:     rebuildBagAndFilter();
375:     showRoom();
376: 
377:     if (reelToggleEl) {
378:       reelToggleEl.checked = !prefersReducedMotion();
379:     }
380: 
381:     // Fan roast submission form.
382:     const submitSection = document.getElementById('roastSubmitSection');
383:     const submitForm = document.getElementById('roastSubmitForm');
384:     if (submitSection && submitForm) {
385:       try {
386:         createRoastForm({
387:           section: submitSection,
388:           container: submitForm,
389:           clubId: clubIdParam,
390:           categories: Array.isArray(club.categories) ? club.categories : [],
391:         });
392:       } catch (error) {
393:         console.warn('[roastRoom] could not build the roast form', error);
394:       }
395:     }
396: 
397:     if (sharePanelEl && !sharePanel) {
398:       try {
399:         sharePanel = createSharePanel({ container: sharePanelEl });
400:       } catch (error) {
401:         console.warn('[roastRoom] could not create the share panel', error);
402:       }
403:     }
404: 
405:     if (deepRoast) {
406:       await showRoast(deepRoast, { animate: false });
407:     }
408: 
409:     if (roastButton) {
410:       roastButton.addEventListener('click', handleRoastClick);
411:     }
412: 
413:     // Press R to roast, as long as the user is not typing in a field.
414:     document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
415:       if (event.defaultPrevented || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey) return;
416:       const target = event.target;
417:       if (target instanceof HTMLElement) {
418:         const tag = target.tagName;
419:         if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || target.isContentEditable) return;
420:       }
421:       if (event.key === 'r' || event.key === 'R') {
422:         event.preventDefault();
423:         handleRoastClick();
424:       }
425:     });
426:   } catch (error) {
427:     console.warn('[roastRoom] could not open the roast room', error);
428:     showError('We could not load this club. Please try again in a moment.');
429:   }
430: }
431: 
432: init();

File: js/share/sharePanel.js

  1: /**
  2:  * Builds and controls the share panel for one roast.
  3:  */
  4: 
  5: import { CARD_FORMATS } from './cardFormats.js';
  6: import { SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE } from './shareConfig.js';
  7: import { renderRoastCard } from './renderCard.js';
  8: import { absoluteRoastUrl, buildFileName, buildShareText, hostLabel } from './shareText.js';
  9: import { canvasToBlob, copyText, downloadBlob, shareImage } from './actions.js';
 10: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 11: 
 12: function canvasToBlobNow(canvas) {
 13:   try {
 14:     const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
 15:     const binary = atob(dataUrl.split(',')[1]);
 16:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
 17:     for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i += 1) {
 18:       bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
 19:     }
 20:     return new Blob([bytes], { type: 'image/png' });
 21:   } catch {
 22:     return null;
 23:   }
 24: }
 25: 
 26: /**
 27:  * Create the share panel inside a container.
 28:  * @param {{ container: HTMLElement }} options Panel options.
 29:  * @returns {{
 30:  *   update: (roast: Record<string, unknown>, category: Record<string, unknown> | null, club: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
 31:  *   hide: () => void,
 32:  *   show: () => void
 33:  * }} Panel controller.
 34:  */
 35: export function createSharePanel(options) {
 36:   const container = options && options.container ? options.container : null;
 37: 
 38:   if (!container || typeof document === 'undefined') {
 39:     return {
 40:       update() {},
 41:       hide() {},
 42:       show() {},
 43:     };
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   clear(container);
 47: 
 48:   const heading = createElement('h2', {
 49:     className: 'sharePanelHeading',
 50:     text: 'Share this roast',
 51:     attrs: { id: 'sharePanelHeading' },
 52:   });
 53: 
 54:   const formatToggle = createElement('div', {
 55:     className: 'shareFormatToggle',
 56:     attrs: {
 57:       role: 'group',
 58:       'aria-label': 'Card format',
 59:     },
 60:   });
 61: 
 62:   /** @type {Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>} */
 63:   const formatButtons = new Map();
 64: 
 65:   for (const format of Object.values(CARD_FORMATS)) {
 66:     const button = createElement('button', {
 67:       className: 'shareFormatButton',
 68:       text: format.label,
 69:       attrs: {
 70:         type: 'button',
 71:         'aria-pressed': format.id === 'post' ? 'true' : 'false',
 72:       },
 73:     });
 74:     button.addEventListener('click', () => {
 75:       currentFormatId = format.id;
 76:       updatePressed();
 77:       hideFallback();
 78:       setStatus('');
 79:       schedulePreview();
 80:     });
 81:     formatButtons.set(format.id, button);
 82:     formatToggle.append(button);
 83:   }
 84: 
 85:   const previewWrap = createElement('div', { className: 'sharePreviewWrap' });
 86:   const previewCanvas = createElement('canvas', {
 87:     className: 'sharePreviewCanvas',
 88:     attrs: {
 89:       role: 'img',
 90:       'aria-label': 'Roast card preview',
 91:     },
 92:   });
 93:   previewWrap.append(previewCanvas);
 94: 
 95:   const actions = createElement('div', { className: 'shareActions' });
 96: 
 97:   const shareButton = createElement('button', {
 98:     className: 'shareActionPrimary',
 99:     text: 'Share',
100:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
101:   });
102: 
103:   const downloadButton = createElement('button', {
104:     className: 'shareActionSecondary',
105:     text: 'Download image',
106:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
107:   });
108: 
109:   const copyButton = createElement('button', {
110:     className: 'shareActionSecondary',
111:     text: 'Copy link',
112:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
113:   });
114: 
115:   actions.append(shareButton, downloadButton, copyButton);
116: 
117:   const status = createElement('p', {
118:     className: 'shareStatus',
119:     attrs: {
120:       role: 'status',
121:       'aria-live': 'polite',
122:     },
123:   });
124: 
125:   const fallback = createElement('div', { className: 'shareFallback hidden' });
126:   const fallbackLabel = createElement('label', {
127:     className: 'tokenLabel',
128:     text: 'Copy this link',
129:     attrs: { for: 'shareFallbackInput' },
130:   });
131:   const fallbackInput = createElement('input', {
132:     className: 'shareFallbackInput',
133:     attrs: {
134:       id: 'shareFallbackInput',
135:       type: 'text',
136:       readonly: 'readonly',
137:       'aria-label': 'Roast link',
138:     },
139:   });
140:   fallback.append(fallbackLabel, fallbackInput);
141: 
142:   container.append(heading, formatToggle, actions, previewWrap, status, fallback);
143:   container.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'sharePanelHeading');
144: 
145:   if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.share !== 'function') {
146:     shareButton.hidden = true;
147:   }
148: 
149:   const workCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
150: 
151:   let currentRoast = null;
152:   let currentCategory = null;
153:   let currentClub = null;
154:   let currentFormatId = 'post';
155:   let visible = false;
156:   let lastKey = '';
157:   let cachedBlob = null;
158:   let renderBusy = false;
159:   let renderPending = false;
160: 
161:   /**
162:    * Set the live status message.
163:    * @param {string} message Status text.
164:    * @returns {void}
165:    */
166:   function setStatus(message) {
167:     status.textContent = message || '';
168:   }
169: 
170:   /**
171:    * Hide the copy fallback input.
172:    * @returns {void}
173:    */
174:   function hideFallback() {
175:     fallback.classList.add('hidden');
176:   }
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * Update the format button pressed state.
180:    * @returns {void}
181:    */
182:   function updatePressed() {
183:     for (const [id, button] of formatButtons) {
184:       button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', id === currentFormatId ? 'true' : 'false');
185:     }
186:   }
187: 
188:   /**
189:    * Return the selected format.
190:    * @returns {{ id: string, label: string, width: number, height: number, safeTop: number, safeBottom: number }} Format.
191:    */
192:   function currentFormat() {
193:     return CARD_FORMATS[currentFormatId] || CARD_FORMATS.post;
194:   }
195: 
196:   /**
197:    * Build the absolute roast URL.
198:    * @returns {string} Absolute URL.
199:    */
200:   function currentUrl() {
201:     if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return '';
202:     return absoluteRoastUrl(window.location.href, currentClub.id, currentRoast.id);
203:   }
204: 
205:   /**
206:    * Draw the preview once.
207:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
208:    */
209:   async function drawPreview() {
210:     if (!visible || !currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
211: 
212:     const roast = currentRoast;
213:     const category = currentCategory;
214:     const club = currentClub;
215:     const format = currentFormat();
216:     const host = hostLabel(window.location.host, SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE);
217:     const key = `${club.id}|${roast.id}|${format.id}|${host}`;
218: 
219:     if (
220:       key === lastKey &&
221:       previewCanvas.width === format.width &&
222:       previewCanvas.height === format.height
223:     ) {
224:       return;
225:     }
226: 
227:     lastKey = key;
228:     cachedBlob = null;
229:     setStatus('Preparing image');
230: 
231:     const result = await renderRoastCard({
232:       canvas: workCanvas,
233:       roast,
234:       category,
235:       club,
236:       format,
237:       host,
238:     });
239: 
240:     if (!visible) return;
241: 
242:     previewCanvas.width = workCanvas.width;
243:     previewCanvas.height = workCanvas.height;
244: 
245:     // iOS Safari sometimes needs a layout flush between resize and draw.
246:     void previewCanvas.offsetWidth;
247: 
248:     const ctx = previewCanvas.getContext('2d');
249:     if (ctx) {
250:       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, previewCanvas.width, previewCanvas.height);
251:       ctx.drawImage(workCanvas, 0, 0);
252:     }
253: 
254:     previewCanvas.setAttribute('role', 'img');
255:     previewCanvas.setAttribute(
256:       'aria-label',
257:       `Roast card preview for ${String(roast.headline || '')} in ${format.label} format`
258:     );
259: 
260:     if (result.truncated) {
261:       setStatus('Preview ready (some text was shortened)');
262:       const renderedKey = key;
263:       canvasToBlob(previewCanvas).then((blobResult) => {
264:         if (blobResult.ok && lastKey === renderedKey) {
265:           cachedBlob = blobResult.blob;
266:         }
267:       });
268:     } else {
269:         setStatus('Preview ready');
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273:   /**
274:    * Render the preview when the panel is visible.
275:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
276:    */
277:   async function renderPreview() {
278:     if (!visible || !currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
279: 
280:     if (renderBusy) {
281:       renderPending = true;
282:       return;
283:     }
284: 
285:     renderBusy = true;
286: 
287:     try {
288:       do {
289:         renderPending = false;
290:         await drawPreview();
291:       } while (renderPending && visible);
292:     } catch {
293:       setStatus('Could not prepare the image. Try again.');
294:     } finally {
295:       renderBusy = false;
296:     }
297:   }
298: 
299:   /**
300:    * Schedule a preview render.
301:    * @returns {void}
302:    */
303:   function schedulePreview() {
304:     if (!visible) return;
305:     renderPreview().catch(() => {
306:       setStatus('Could not prepare the image. Try again.');
307:     });
308:   }
309: 
310:   /**
311:    * Handle the Share button.
312:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
313:    */
314:   async function handleShare() {
315:     try {
316:       if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
317: 
318:       let blob = cachedBlob;
319:       if (!blob) {
320:         if (previewCanvas.width < 1000) {
321:           setStatus('The image is still being prepared. Try again in a second.');
322:           return;
323:         }
324:         blob = canvasToBlobNow(previewCanvas);
325:       }
326:       if (!blob) {
327:         setStatus('Could not prepare the image. Try Download image instead.');
328:         return;
329:       }
330: 
331:       const fileName = buildFileName(currentClub.id, currentRoast.id, currentFormat().id);
332:       const url = currentUrl();
333:       const text = buildShareText(currentRoast, url);
334:       const result = await shareImage({ blob, fileName, title: 'The Roast Room', text, url });
335: 
336:       if (result.ok) {
337:         setStatus('Shared');
338:       } else if (result.reason === 'cancelled') {
339:         setStatus('Share cancelled');
340:       } else if (result.reason === 'unsupported') {
341:         setStatus('Sharing is not available here. Use Download image instead.');
342:       } else {
343:         setStatus('Could not share. Try Download image instead.');
344:       }
345:     } catch {
346:       setStatus('Could not share. Try Download image instead.');
347:     }
348:   }
349: 
350:   /**
351:    * Handle the Download image button.
352:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
353:    */
354:   async function handleDownload() {
355:     try {
356:       if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
357: 
358:       const blobResult = await canvasToBlob(previewCanvas);
359:       if (!blobResult.ok) {
360:         setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
361:         return;
362:       }
363: 
364:       const fileName = buildFileName(currentClub.id, currentRoast.id, currentFormat().id);
365:       const result = downloadBlob(blobResult.blob, fileName);
366: 
367:       if (result.ok) {
368:         setStatus('Image saved');
369:       } else {
370:         setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
371:       }
372:     } catch {
373:       setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
374:     }
375:   }
376: 
377:   /**
378:    * Handle the Copy link button.
379:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
380:    */
381:   async function handleCopy() {
382:     try {
383:       const url = currentUrl();
384:       if (!url) return;
385: 
386:       const result = await copyText(url);
387: 
388:       if (result.ok) {
389:         setStatus('Link copied');
390:         hideFallback();
391:         return;
392:       }
393: 
394:       setStatus('Could not copy, select the link below');
395:       fallbackInput.value = url;
396:       fallback.classList.remove('hidden');
397:       fallbackInput.focus();
398:       fallbackInput.select();
399:       fallbackInput.setSelectionRange(0, fallbackInput.value.length);
400:     } catch {
401:       setStatus('Could not copy, select the link below');
402:       const url = currentUrl();
403:       fallbackInput.value = url;
404:       fallback.classList.remove('hidden');
405:       fallbackInput.focus();
406:       fallbackInput.select();
407:     }
408:   }
409: 
410:   shareButton.addEventListener('click', handleShare);
411:   downloadButton.addEventListener('click', handleDownload);
412:   copyButton.addEventListener('click', handleCopy);
413: 
414:   /**
415:    * Show the panel.
416:    * @returns {void}
417:    */
418:   function show() {
419:     visible = true;
420:     container.classList.remove('hidden');
421:     container.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
422:     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
423:       requestAnimationFrame(() => {
424:         schedulePreview();
425:       });
426:     });
427:   }
428: 
429:   /**
430:    * Hide the panel.
431:    * @returns {void}
432:    */
433:   function hide() {
434:     visible = false;
435:     container.classList.add('hidden');
436:     container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
437:     hideFallback();
438:     setStatus('');
439:   }
440: 
441:   /**
442:    * Update the panel for a roast.
443:    * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast Roast data.
444:    * @param {Record<string, unknown> | null} category Category metadata.
445:    * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club Club data.
446:    * @returns {void}
447:    */
448:   function update(roast, category, club) {
449:     if (!roast || !club) {
450:       hide();
451:       return;
452:     }
453: 
454:     currentRoast = roast;
455:     currentCategory = category;
456:     currentClub = club;
457:     hideFallback();
458:     setStatus('');
459:     updatePressed();
460:     show();
461:   }
462: 
463:   updatePressed();
464: 
465:   return { update, hide, show };
466: }
